Title: Market Data Engineer
Description:
Location: Potsdam office, hybrid work model, applicants from Berlin and Brandenburg welcome

Language: Fluent in English




Company Description

Index Bakery is a financial technology company building modern infrastructure for the creation, calculation, and publication of financial indices. Our platform combines index engineering, market data processing, and operational tooling to help institutional clients launch and maintain index products efficiently and reliably.




We work at the intersection of finance, data, and software engineering. Our systems are designed to handle complex market data, support robust index calculations, and provide the transparency, auditability, and reliability required in a production financial environment.




As an early-stage company, we are building both the technology and the organization from the ground up. This creates a hands-on environment where engineers can take real ownership, contribute to core product decisions, and help shape how financial index infrastructure should work in the future.




Role Overview

We’re looking for a Market Data Engineer who thrives on transforming complex market data into clean, validated, and production-ready systems. You’ll be responsible for integrating data from multiple vendors, building robust data pipelines, and ensuring that every number can be trusted.




This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, financial market data, and data quality. You do not need to be a financial markets expert from day one, but you should be curious, structured, and eager to learn how market data, instruments, and index calculation processes work in production.




Why Join Us

At Index Bakery, you will work on systems that directly power the creation, calculation, and publication of financial indices used by institutional clients. We are a small and highly technical team where engineers have real ownership, direct impact, and the opportunity to shape both the platform and the company from an early stage.




As the company grows, you will have the opportunity to contribute not only to our systems, but also to the evolution of our data platform, products, and engineering practices.




Responsibilities

Integrate market data from external vendors, exchanges, and internal sources.
Build, maintain, and improve data ingestion pipelines for prices, reference data, FX rates, corporate actions, calendars, and other market data.
Normalize heterogeneous data formats into clean, consistent, and well-documented internal data models.
Implement validation checks, reconciliation logic, and data quality controls to detect missing, stale, inconsistent, or suspicious data.
Work closely with Index Engineering and Index Operations to ensure data is fit for backtesting, daily index calculation, reporting, and publication.
Investigate data issues in production and help identify root causes across vendors, pipelines, storage, and downstream systems.
Design pragmatic solutions for historical data management, versioning, corrections, and auditability of market data.
Contribute to internal tooling, APIs, monitoring, documentation, and operational workflows around market data.
Help shape the Market Data Platform as the company grows, balancing speed, reliability, and simplicity.




Requirements

3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, or a closely related role.
Strong Python skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-oriented code.
Solid SQL skills and practical experience working with relational databases.
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, APIs, or backend services.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Understanding of data quality concepts such as validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, and auditability.
Ability to reason carefully about edge cases, data inconsistencies, and operational failure modes.
Comfortable working in a small team where ownership, communication, and pragmatic decision-making matter.
Fluent English communication skills.




Nice to Have

Experience with financial market data, index data, asset management, trading, exchanges, or data vendors.
Familiarity with instruments such as equities, bonds, ETFs, commodities, FX, derivatives, or crypto assets.
Experience with tools such as Docker, FastAPI, Pydantic, Airflow, Dagster, dbt, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, or similar technologies.
Experience with data historization, slowly changing dimensions, event-based data, or audit trails.
Experience operating production systems, including monitoring, alerting, incident analysis, and debugging.
Interest in financial markets, data modelling, and building systems where correctness matters.




What We Value

We care deeply about the mindset you bring to the team. We are looking for someone who is humble, curious, and eager to improve. Someone who enjoys learning new domains, asks thoughtful questions, and is comfortable saying, “I don’t know yet, but I’ll find out.”




We believe great engineers never stop learning. We value intellectual honesty, ownership, and collaboration. We are less interested in people who always have an answer, and more interested in people who are willing to challenge assumptions, learn from others, and continuously grow.




You should enjoy working through messy real-world data problems with patience and precision. We value people who take ownership without ego, communicate clearly, and want to build reliable systems together with a small, ambitious team.




What You'll Work On

At Index Bakery, market data is a core part of our infrastructure. Your work will directly support the calculation, validation, and publication of financial indices. You’ll help build the data foundation that enables index backtests, production calculations, client reports, operational checks, and future data products.




This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership from the beginning.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Customer Care Analytics
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

In this analytics role, you will be the key analytical partner to Customer Care — the team that supports travelers when things don’t go as planned and protects trust in the GetYourGuide experience. You will work closely with Care leadership, Product, and the broader Analytics organization to ensure Care’s biggest decisions are grounded in rigorous measurement and clear trade-offs.

Care is inherently cross-domain: it spans Traveler (On-Trip), Supplier, and Partner Operations. You’ll be embedded enough to build context and influence, while staying anchored in Analytics to uphold standards, peer review, and alignment with company-wide metrics.

Your mission


Own the analytical problems that matter most for Care — define and drive the strategic Care analytics backlog and turn it into recommendations that shape priorities, policies, and investments.
Build the measurement frameworks Care relies on — create and evolve metrics, models, and dashboards that make efficiency, friction, and outcomes measurable and self-serve.
Deliver deep-dive modeling that unlocks step-change decisions — quantify drivers and trade-offs behind contacts, refunds, CSAT, and channel performance, including LTV-aware policy logic.
Be Care's analytical voice across the company for Travelers, Suppliers and Partners — turn what Care learns from travelers into insights Product, Marketing, and Operations can act on, aligned with On-Trip and Destination growth strategy.
Champion hypothesis-driven decision-making — raise the bar on rigor, evaluation, and impact measurement so Care decisions are consistently defensible and outcome-driven.


Your toolkit


5+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or a data science role
Production-grade SQL and strong working knowledge of Python (e.g., notebooks, modeling, analysis workflows).
Experience with experimentation (statistics, assumptions, and evaluation).
Strong statistical background and proficiency with advanced statistical methods (e.g. causal inference methods, difference-in-differences, regression analysis, propensity score matching)
Strong stakeholder management and the ability to operate with senior leaders in a high-context, ambiguous environment.
Proven ability to turn messy questions into structured analysis, crisp narratives, and decisions with measurable business impact.
Strong customer mindset: you understand user behavior and the “why” behind the numbers.
Excellent communication skills — you can influence without authority and align teams around shared metrics and priorities.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks).


Extras that give you an edge


Experience working in Customer Care within a marketplace.
Familiarity with ETL/orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) and/or big data tooling (e.g., Spark, Hive).
Experience working in agile product teams and cross-functional mission setups.
Exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic), especially for operational tooling or workflow augmentation.
Experience mentoring or managing analysts.


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Title: NGS Data Analyst for Molecular Oncology
Description:
Alacris Theranostics GmbH is a leader in innovative molecular diagnostics, specialising in personalised oncology. Our cutting-edge solutions combine next-generation sequencing (NGS), advanced bioinformatics, and systems biology to transform scientific insights into enhanced cancer diagnostics and more precise treatment decisions. We collaborate closely with leading research institutions, hospitals, and pharmaceutical partners to drive meaningful and lasting improvements in patient outcomes.


Tasks


We are seeking an experienced Bioinformatician / Computational Biologist with a strong track record in next-generation sequencing (NGS) data analysis. The successful candidate will be responsible for processing and analysing NGS datasets - including RNA-Seq, whole-exome sequencing (WES), whole-genome sequencing (WGS), and single-cell sequencing - derived from tumour samples.


Requirements


The ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent programming skills in R and Python, along with proven expertise in NGS data analysis and a solid foundation in human molecular genetics. Knowledge of statistics, high-dimensional data analysis, and cancer genomics is highly desirable.




We are looking for a candidate with a genuine interest in precision oncology, a proactive approach to learning, and a commitment to developing new skills. Strong motivation, a collaborative mindset, and excellent communication skills are essential


Benefits


You will join a multidisciplinary team of bioinformaticians, molecular biologists, and software engineers dedicated to developing innovative analysis pipelines and diagnostic solutions in oncology.




We offer a rewarding and challenging role within a dynamic biotech company based in the vibrant city of Berlin. The position comes with a competitive salary and a stimulating working environment. The appointment is available immediately and will initially be for a two-year term, with the possibility of extension.




How to Apply? Interested candidates should provide a CV, publication list, details of previous research and work experience, and contact details of three referees as a single PDF file, citing reference ALA-NGSA-0426.




The closing date for applications is April 15, 2026.

The successful candidate will be responsible for processing and analysing NGS datasets - including RNA-Seq, whole-exome sequencing (WES), whole-genome sequencing (WGS), and single-cell sequencing - derived from tumour samples.


Requirements

The ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent programming skills in R and Python, along with proven expertise in NGS data analysis and a solid foundation in human molecular genetics. Knowledge of statistics, high-dimensional data analysis, and cancer genomics is highly desirable.


We are looking for a candidate with a genuine interest in precision oncology, a proactive approach to learning, and a commitment to developing new skills. Strong motivation, a collaborative mindset, and excellent communication skills are essential


Benefits

You will join a multidisciplinary team of bioinformaticians, molecular biologists, and software engineers dedicated to developing innovative analysis pipelines and diagnostic solutions in oncology.


We offer a rewarding and challenging role within a dynamic biotech company based in the vibrant city of Berlin. The position comes with a competitive salary and a stimulating working environment. The appointment is available immediately and will initially be for a two-year term, with the possibility of extension.


How to Apply? Interested candidates should provide a CV, publication list, details of previous research and work experience, and contact details of three referees as a single PDF file, citing reference ALA-NGSA-0426.


The closing date for applications is April 15, 2026.

Title: Senior Data & Business Analyst AVM | Real Estate (m/w/d)
Description:
Du verstehst Immobilienbewertung ebenso gut wie Datenmodelle?




Du arbeitest seit vielen Jahren mit R und SQL und fühlst Dich auch in Linux-Umgebungen zu Hause?




Du möchtest Automated Valuation Models fachlich verantworten und für einen marktprägenden Akteur der Immobilienwirtschaft weiterentwickeln?




Dann könnte diese Position sehr gut zu Dir passen.




Für ein führendes Unternehmen im immobilienwirtschaftlichen Datenumfeld suchen wir einen analytisch versierten Kopf mit technischer Tiefe, hoher methodischer Präzision und einem fundierten Verständnis für Immobilienbewertung, Marktdaten und quantitative Entscheidungsmodelle.

Im Zentrum Deiner Tätigkeit stehen die Betreuung, Validierung und Weiterentwicklung von Automated Valuation Models für die datenbasierte Bewertung von Immobilien.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Analytics, immobilienwirtschaftlicher Fachlichkeit und technischer Modellarchitektur. Dabei analysierst Du umfangreiche Datenbestände, hinterfragst bestehende Bewertungslogiken und entwickelst belastbare, nachvollziehbare und skalierbare Lösungen. Die Rolle ist ein hybrid aus Data und Business Analyst.




Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst insbesondere:

fachliche und technische Verantwortung für Automated Valuation Models
Analyse, Strukturierung und Qualitätssicherung immobilienwirtschaftlicher Daten
Weiterentwicklung quantitativer Bewertungsmodelle und methodischer Ansätze
Übersetzung komplexer Fragestellungen aus Immobilienbewertung und Marktanalyse in tragfähige Datenlösungen
Untersuchung von Modellgüte, Datenqualität und fachlichen Abhängigkeiten
strukturierte Dokumentation von Methoden, Prozessen und Ergebnissen
enge Zusammenarbeit mit Experten aus Analytics, Immobilienwirtschaft und Technologie




Was Du mitbringst

mindestens acht Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung mit R und SQL
tiefgehende Linux-Kenntnisse
Erfahrung in anspruchsvollen technischen und datenintensiven Systemumgebungen
belastbare Kenntnisse der Immobilienwirtschaft
Verständnis für Immobilienbewertung, Marktdaten, Valuation-Prozesse oder vergleichbare Bewertungslogiken
ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
ein hohes Maß an Präzision, Eigenverantwortung und Qualitätsbewusstsein
Deutsch auf mind. C1 Niveau




Ein mathematischer, physikalischer oder vergleichbar quantitativer Hintergrund bietet eine sehr gute fachliche Grundlage.




Das erwartet Dich

Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Expertenteam, in dem analytische Tiefe, methodische Substanz und der gemeinsame Anspruch an hochwertige Ergebnisse im Mittelpunkt stehen.

Gesucht wird ein neugieriger und reflektierter Mensch, der komplexe Zusammenhänge gerne durchdringt, etablierte Modelle konstruktiv hinterfragt und Freude daran hat, gemeinsam mit anderen klugen Köpfen anspruchsvolle Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln.




Was die Position besonders attraktiv macht:

90,77 Prozent Remote-Anteil ;)
lediglich zwei Präsenztage pro Monat in Berlin
attraktive Vergütung zwischen 75.000 und 95.000 Euro
hohe fachliche Eigenverantwortung
direkter Einfluss auf marktprägende Immobilienbewertungsmodelle
Freiraum für Ideen und methodische Weiterentwicklung
vertrauensbasierte Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe
langfristige Perspektive in einem hochprofessionellen Datenumfeld

Title: Web Analyst (m/f/d) - Marketing & Data
Description:
We are home24, one of the leading home & living e-commerce platforms in continental Europe. We utilize data to provide personalized recommendations, tips, and inspiration for every home. We are looking for a Web Analyst (m/f/d) to join our team. In this role, you will support our marketing teams by ensuring data quality, maintaining our tracking setup, and delivering actionable insights through data visualization.

Your Responsibilities


You drive the implementation and maintenance of tracking concepts in GA4 and sGTM, refining event structures and debugging discrepancies to ensure delivery of high-quality data e.g. for attribution modeling and the design and evaluation of A/B tests
You evaluate the performance of marketing campaigns across various channels
You don't just deliver numbers, but interpret data to help the team understand trends and optimize ROI
You build and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., in Tableau or Looker) to monitor key marketing metrics, translating business requirements into clear visualizations
You look beyond standard KPIs to investigate the "why" behind the data, conducting ad-hoc deep dives to uncover the root causes of performance shifts and user behavior
You act as a contact person for analytical questions regarding GA4, helping stakeholders understand their data usage needs
You monitor the data flow to ensure accuracy and support the team in identifying and fixing bugs in the tracking landscape


Your Profile


You have professional experience in web analytics, data analysis, or a related field, ideally within an e-commerce environment
You have hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and (server-side) Google Tag Manager (sGTM)
You are proficient in SQL, capable of merging and transforming large-scale datasets from diverse sources. Proficiency in Python is a strong plus for building scalable data solutions
You have a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to comprehend how tracking is implemented
Your mindset combines natural curiosity for new trends with a sharp eye for detail, ensuring your end-to-end thinking always aligns with the bigger picture
You have excellent English skills and can communicate your findings in a clear, structured way
You thrive in cross-functional collaboration, acting as a bridge between marketing, data, and tech teams


What We Offer You

Your impact


The chance to make an impact in a highly motivated team of professionals
An open-minded culture ready to incorporate new and creative ideas


Your growth


Extensive learning opportunities from our home24 academy and external partners
Room for growth and development within your role through regular feedback rounds


Your path


Hybrid working model: you have the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays in our standard working mode. We are in the office together Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays
The possibility to work up to two months per year within Germany or from an EU country
Up to 30 days paid vacation each year to unwind and recharge
City mobility with a subsidized public transportation ticket and our eco-friendly bike leasing program #ridinghome


Your second home


International campus in the heart of Berlin featuring drive-in bicycle garage, outdoor space and lounge areas, fitness facilities, parent and multi-faith rooms close to the Berlin S-Bahn train station Landsberger Allee
Company benefits including a pension scheme, 30 % off the home24 assortment, and employee discounts at partner organizations
You want to learn more about our home24 company culture and what it is like to be a homie? Follow @teamhome24 on Instagram

Title: Finance Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
DEINE AUFGABEN.

Als Finance Data Analyst bist du Teil unseres Teams Finanzdaten- und Systemmanagement. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass Daten aus unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereichen zuverlässig zusammengeführt, fachlich eingeordnet und für Finanzprozesse, Analysen sowie fundierte Entscheidungen nutzbar gemacht werden. Bei uns kannst du folgende Themen anpacken:


Du erschließt, analysierst und verknüpfst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellsystemen und bereitest Finanz- und Buchungsdaten für operative Prozesse, Controlling und Reporting auf.
Entwicklung und Optimierung von Datenaufbereitungen mit Power Query sowie Weiterentwicklung von Abfragen, Transformationslogiken und automatisierten Datenprozessen.
Du unterstützt den Aufbau nachhaltiger Datenstrukturen in Microsoft Fabric sowie Datenimporte, Systemumstellungen und fachliche Tests.
Analyse von Datenabweichungen und Qualitätsproblemen, Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen und Sicherstellung einer nachvollziehbaren Dokumentation von Datenquellen und Transformationslogiken.
Du arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, verstehst die fachliche Bedeutung von Daten und die zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse und stellst durch gezielte Analysen eine hohe Datenqualität sicher.
Aktiver Aufbau eines bereichsübergreifenden Netzwerks sowie Entwicklung tragfähiger und nachhaltiger Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen.


DEINE STÄRKEN.

Du möchtest nicht nur Daten analysieren, sondern auch deren fachlichen Kontext verstehen. Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen. Dabei arbeitest du eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und bringst komplexe Sachverhalte auf den Punkt.


Ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Datenanalyse, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Finanzen oder Controlling oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Berufserfahrung in der Datenanalyse, im Finanzcontrolling, Reporting, Datenmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Tätigkeitsfeld.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel und Power Query sowie gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power BI.
Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Datenmodellen, Berichten und Dashboards sowie gute Kenntnisse in DAX.
Erfahrung in der Zusammenführung, Transformation und Qualitätssicherung von Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen.
Ein gutes Verständnis für kaufmännische Prozesse sowie Finanz- und Controllingdaten.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Deine Vorteile Und Benefits Bei Uns.

WORK-LIFE-BALANCE. Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub | Home-Office-Optionen | Sabbatical | Bis zu 180 Tage Arbeiten im Ausland | Urlaub und Workation in unseren Seminarhäusern in Berlin und Pommritz | Zahlreiche Angebote und Rabatte über Corporate Benefits

GESUNDHEIT. Mache mit bei Firmenläufen | Sport- und Entspannungsangebote mit Voiio | Jobrad | Firmenfitness mit EGYM Wellpass | Yoga-Retreats | Nahrungsergänzungsmittel | Ergonomische Arbeitsplatzausstattung | Coaching- und Beratungsangebote

PERSÖNLICHE ENTWICKLUNG. Bilde dich weiter mit diversen Trainingsangeboten | Drei Weiterbildungstage | Individuelle fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung | LinkedIn Learning | Teamentwicklungen | Leadership Management Programm | Microsoft 365 mit Copilot

Title: Global Business Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Hybrid | Full time | Senior (5+ years)

Sense the Power

Trench Group is a global leader in high-voltage power transmission components and systems. Headquartered in Berlin with over 100 years of experience, the company leads the portfolio of high-voltage power transmission components and systems. With product groups including bushings, coils, and instrument transformers, the company is a system-critical player in the energy transition and sustainable energy future. These intelligent and technologically advanced solutions are used for measurement, protection, and connection within the power grid. We operates globally with more than 2,500 employees across nine factory locations and four regional sales hubs.

Your Mission

As part of our Sales Finance team, you play a key role in creating transparency across global sales performance. You transform complex sales data into meaningful insights for management and actively contribute to improving our reporting landscape.

In this role, you work closely with Finance and Sales teams across HQ, factories, and Sales Hubs worldwide. You support Regional Sales, Key Account Management, and Business Development by providing reliable data, clear analyses, and decision‑ready dashboards.

Your Tasks:


Own Global Sales Reporting: You take end‑to‑end ownership of our Sales Data Cube, ensuring accurate and consistent monthly data flows and acting as the central contact for all global sales reporting topics.
Build Dashboards That Matter: You design and continuously enhance management reports and visualizations using Power BI and Tableau, enabling full transparency on sales performance and trends.
Bridge Sales, Finance & IT: Working at the interface of Sales, Finance, factories, and IT/SAP, you reconcile figures, perform plausibility checks, and ensure all stakeholders operate with one consistent set of numbers.
Drive Pipeline & Partner Reporting: Using Salesforce Reporting, you create pipeline analyses and Business Partner dashboards to support target setting, performance tracking, and management decision‑making.
Shape the Future of Sales Finance: You actively drive digitalization and automation, from implementing new tools (e.g. Offer Management, Contract Revisions) to rethinking how data is collected, processed, and reported globally.



Requirements:


Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a comparable field
Extensive experience in Sales Finance, Controlling, Reporting, or Business Analysis
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to structure and explain complex data
Experience creating management reports and dashboards (Power BI, Tableau)
Confident communicator with senior stakeholders across functions and regions
Fluent in English; German language skills are a plus



We offer:


Growth with Purpose: Join a globally growing energy company with a vision and a bright future in the energy transition
Strong Teams, Big Energy: Work in highly professional, international teams defined by respect, appreciation, and a shared drive to shape the future of energy
Fair Rewards: Competitive pay, monthly vouchers for shopping, well‑being, or personal development, plus subsidized lunch and membership in a corporate benefits program
Personal & Professional Development: Learn and grow in an international environment with hands‑on experience and continuous development opportunities
Modern Working Environment: A modern way of working, 30 days’ vacation, and a tariff agreement combined with contemporary offices, height‑adjustable desks, free fruit & coffee, and regular team events

Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, komplexe Herausforderungen zu meistern – individuell, strukturiert und mit einem klaren Blick für das Wesentliche.

Dafür verbinden wir tiefgehende fachliche Expertise mit methodischem Know-how und einem partnerschaftlichen Beratungsansatz. Unsere Projekte sind vielfältig, verantwortungsvoll und gesellschaftlich relevant – vom Mittelstand bis zu großen Organisationen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern.

Mindestens genauso wichtig wie unsere Projekte sind die Menschen bei HiSolutions. Wir glauben an Eigenverantwortung, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung. Bei uns arbeitest Du in engagierten Teams, mit ausgeprägtem Pioniergeist. Wir fördern fachliches Wachstum ebenso wie persönliche Entwicklung und schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Offenheit, Qualität und gegenseitige Wertschätzung selbstverständlich sind.

Freue Dich auf spannende Aufgaben.


Erhebe komplexe Datenmengen bei unseren Kunden, von vorhandenen Datenquellen (z. B. Inventar/Discovery, Lizenzdaten, Verträge, Procurement, Finance o.ä.)
Bewerte die Daten hinsichtlich Qualität, Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Aussagekraft und dokumentiere Datenmodelle sowie Datenflüsse
Führe Datenanalysen durch (z. B. Nutzung vs. Bereitstellung, Lizenz- und Kostenauffälligkeiten, Hersteller-/Produkt-Abhängigkeiten, Shadow IT-Indikatoren) und leite Erkenntnisse ab, die die digitale Souveränität unterstützen (z. B. Konzentrationsrisiken, Lock-in-Indikatoren, Vertrags-/Nutzungsrisiken, Datenzugänglichkeit)
Bereite Ergebnisse so auf, dass Entscheider sie verstehen: Dashboards, Reports oder Analyse-Berichte


Damit überzeugst Du uns.


Abgeschlossenes Studium sowie 1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Science oder Datenanalyse
Gute Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse-, Reporting- und Visualisierungstools
Analytisches Verständnis, um Komplexität zu strukturieren und Zusammenhänge zu verdeutlichen, sowie hohe Eigenmotivation und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise

Mindestens genauso wichtig wie unsere Projekte sind die Menschen bei HiSolutions. Wir glauben an Eigenverantwortung, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung. Bei uns arbeitest Du in engagierten Teams, mit ausgeprägtem Pioniergeist. Wir fördern fachliches Wachstum ebenso wie persönliche Entwicklung und schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Offenheit, Qualität und gegenseitige Wertschätzung selbstverständlich sind.

Freue Dich auf spannende Aufgaben.

  • Erhebe komplexe Datenmengen bei unseren Kunden, von vorhandenen Datenquellen (z. B. Inventar/Discovery, Lizenzdaten, Verträge, Procurement, Finance o.ä.)
  • Bewerte die Daten hinsichtlich Qualität, Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Aussagekraft und dokumentiere Datenmodelle sowie Datenflüsse
  • Führe Datenanalysen durch (z. B. Nutzung vs. Bereitstellung, Lizenz- und Kostenauffälligkeiten, Hersteller-/Produkt-Abhängigkeiten, Shadow IT-Indikatoren) und leite Erkenntnisse ab, die die digitale Souveränität unterstützen (z. B. Konzentrationsrisiken, Lock-in-Indikatoren, Vertrags-/Nutzungsrisiken, Datenzugänglichkeit)
  • Bereite Ergebnisse so auf, dass Entscheider sie verstehen: Dashboards, Reports oder Analyse-Berichte

Damit überzeugst Du uns.

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium sowie 1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Science oder Datenanalyse
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse-, Reporting- und Visualisierungstools
  • Analytisches Verständnis, um Komplexität zu strukturieren und Zusammenhänge zu verdeutlichen, sowie hohe Eigenmotivation und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Deutsch verhandlungssicher)

Die Liste der Anforderungen ist eine Wunschliste. Bitte bewirb Dich auch dann, wenn Du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, vieles kannst Du während der Arbeit bei uns lernen.

Darüber hinaus haben wir noch viel zu bieten.

  • Grün unterwegs: Wir bezuschussen nicht nur Dein Jobrad, sondern auch Dein ÖPNV-Ticket, sodass die Umwelt und Dein Geldbeutel geschont wird.
  • In Bewegung bleiben: Wir fördern Deine Fitness-Mitgliedschaft und Deine Gesundheitsvorsorge.
  • Maximale Individualität: Wir ermöglichen die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Job nach Deinen Bedürfnissen, mit der Option des Mobilen Arbeitens.
  • Zeit für Erholung: Wir bieten Dir 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr. Nimm Dir mit nur einem Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester frei. Bei einer länger gewünschten Auszeit ermöglichen wir Dir ein Sabbatical.

Title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
Description:
Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.

Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

Data Engineer (m/f/d)

We're looking for a Data Engineer who has hands-on experience integrating databases and external APIs, understands AWS infrastructure, and is comfortable working with tools like DBT to model and transform data. You'll help build and scale our data platform from ingestion through to the warehouse layer, powering AI Agents, BI, and business decisions across the organization.

You will:

Build and maintain data pipelines from ingestion through to storage
Take end-to-end ownership of pipeline components
Model data using data lake and warehouse concepts, and contribute to performance improvements (partitioning, file formats, tuning)
Apply data governance and security practices in your work (least-privilege IAM, encryption, PII handling)
Support the team with data quality, coding consistency and data availability
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders to translate requirements into working data solutions
Identify, formulate, and propose improvements to your own and your team’s practices

The Next Moonfarian:

2–4 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in production
Strong Python and advanced SQL
Basic Scala experience, or a willingness to pick it up
Familiarity with DBT (models, tests, documentation)
Solid working knowledge of AWS or another major cloud provider
Experience with relational databases and data warehouses
Confident in Git, CI/CD, and modern deployment practices
Practical experience with Docker
Solution-oriented, strong attention to detail, and open to feedback and mentorship
Nice to have:

Experience with Apache Spark or a similar distributed processing framework
Working knowledge of K8
Bash scripting
Flyway or similar SQL migration tools

If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

 

Our Values:

Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third - Client-Centric Focus. Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.
We pursue excellence and honor our promises - Commitment to Excellence. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.
We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements - Win together. We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.
We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit - Growth and Merit. We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.

We understand the important role that diversity plays in our success. Different backgrounds, experiences and ideas push us further and raise the bar. We’re committed to developing an inclusive and safe culture where everyone  — regardless of colour, race, religion, sex, origin, sexuality, disability, marital status, citizenship or gender identity — knows that they are an integral part of the team and can bring their full potential to their work.

*Minimum investments vary according to jurisdiction.

Title: Working student – Renewables Strategy & Market Intelligence (f/m/d)
Description:
For our Business Area Wind we are now looking for a

Working student – Data Focus in Renewables Strategy & Market Intelligence (f/m/d)

for our office in Berlin.

The Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore Wind, Offshore Wind and Large-Scale Solar and Batteries. Today we develop, construct and operate wind generation and solar and battery installations mainly in our core markets.

This position is located in the Strategy & Market Intelligence team within the Business Control department, which is responsible for shaping the overall strategic direction of Business Area Wind. The team is proactively identifying and advising on relevant strategic topics to support decision makers in steering Vattenfall’s renewables business.

We require a working student to support the market analysis & strategy work as well as the day-to-day business of the strategy team. The role will involve working closely with the full team as well as exposure to the many different activities happening in BA Wind. A dedicated team member will give guidance and provide feedback.

What do we expect from you as a Working Student in BA Wind Strategy & Market Intelligence?

Key Responsibilities


Conduct market research and analysis by collecting and structuring market information and market data through desk research, studies, participation in webinars, etc.
Prepare deep dives on the research topics, i.e. extract key messages from your research and discard non-relevant information. Present and visualise your research in structured presentations.
Monitor regulatory, competitive and supplier developments, identify emerging market trends and assess their strategic implications for Vattenfall's renewables business.
Communicate market insights to colleagues within Business Area Wind via different channels (Yammer/Viva Engage, newsletters, Teams channels, SharePoint).
Support the preparation and execution of trainings, meetings and workshop activities.
Further develop, maintain and automate our market intelligence deliverables, digital platforms (SharePoint) and collaboration channels (MS Teams, Viva Engage).
Drive innovation by identifying and proposing practical applications of AI to improve team efficiency and enhance the quality of deliverables
Support creation of our AI-powered market intelligence newsletter.
Maintenance of our market intelligence subscriptions and assessment of possible new subscriptions to external data sources.


Qualifications

Your profile


You are studying business or a STEM discipline, including sustainability and energy-related areas, ideally with a focus on strategy and/or renewable energies.
You have a valid “Immatrikulationsbescheinigung” for the full duration of your working period with Vattenfall as of the starting date.
Prior exposure to consulting and market research is a plus.
Your English communication skills are strong, both verbally and written. Knowledge of another European language, especially German, Dutch or Swedish, can be an advantage. 
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) is required.
You are comfortable with data and understand how data-driven insights support strategic decision-making.
Solid understanding of AI tools and strong prompting skills, with the ability to translate use cases into practical applications.
You have a structured way of working and are performance-oriented with ability to prioritise.
You are highly motivated, communicative, proactive and you enjoy working in a team.
You ask for help and guidance when needed and think beyond the task at hand, making suggestions wherever you see room for improvement.


Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information


Start date: as soon as possible.
Working time: 20 hours per week, up to 37 hours during non-lecture periods.
Duration: 1 year target duration with the possibility to extend.


We welcome your application in English, including a short cover letter, CV, current grade reports and your certificate of enrolment. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the position and the recruitment process please don’t hesitate to reach out to the recruiter Alexandra Weitkus via alexandramichelle.weitkus@vattenfall.de

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Title: Analytical Consultant, Digital First
Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Munich, Germany; Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt am Main, Germany; Hamburg, Germany.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, consulting, or financial analysis.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in translating data into business recommendations, creating and delivering appealing insights-based presentations or business cases with clear recommendations and aligned with customers objectives.
Experience in data analyses and visualization (Google Sheets and Slides), scripting (Google SQL), Dashboard development (Looker Studio), and leverage AI for analytics.
Advertising experience from either the advertiser, agency or other media owner side.
Ability to work closely with multiple stakeholder and cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders (internally and externally) across all levels.
Ability to communicate in German fluently as this is a client facing role.


About The Job

Digital First, a sector within LCS, is home to a variety of customers, from Travel, Media and Entertainment and many digital natives like marketplaces, aggregators and comparison websites. Our mission is to drive the success and sustainable growth of our Digital First customers through innovation and a customer-first mindset.

As an Analytical Consultant (AC), you will work with top clients across various industries to optimize their online advertising strategies and help them achieve their business objectives. In your role, you will be the point of contact for large customers on anything around data in the form of analysis and strategic insights and you will be a core consultant to the sales teams helping them drive Google’s business growth. You will dive deep into data to uncover hidden opportunities and commercial insights for customers – analyze their market coverage, Google auction performance, optimize their profitability and branding investments and align their efforts with target audiences. You will share these insights as a trusted consultant with the customers as well as to sales teams internally.

To scale your impact, you will help identify solutions and analyses that other customers and teams would benefit from and work together with a cross-functional team to scale and automate them. You promote data fluency by sharing insightful dashboards to visualize key metrics that support their business objectives as well as educating clients and partners on Google's tools. You collaborate with cross-functional teams to act as a data analyst, strategic advisor, and consultant, ultimately driving commercial value for our clients.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €98000 - €101000 (EUR) + 40% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Conduct comprehensive bespoke analyses for our high-priority customers to uncover hidden opportunities to optimize their online advertising return on investment.
Consult with clients as a strategic consultant, clearly presenting data-driven insights and recommendations that align with their business goals.
Develop engaging narratives to deliver insights at scale for a wider customer base. Streamline processes by developing scalable templates, dashboards and scripts (together with gCare Insights).
Empower clients and partners with guidance on using Google's data tools via trainings and, democratize insights where needed through insightful dashboards and reports.
Work seamlessly with the teams and stakeholders to drive successful outcomes for clients (e.g., measurement and incrementality specialists).

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Title: AI & Data Analytics Internship, Technical Service (m/f/d) - Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg
Description:
What To Expect
Location: Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg

Duration: 6 months

Start date: September / October 2026

Time Type: Full-time

The Technical Service team is dedicated to maximizing the performance and availability of utilities and infrastructure systems, ensuring uninterrupted operations at Gigafactory Berlin. This dynamic team works tirelessly to maintain, enhance, and restore these systems through a combination of preventative and corrective maintenance strategies.

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst Intern to join the Maintenance Planning team. This role sits at the intersection of factory operations and data analytics: you will turn maintenance, asset, and operations data into reports, dashboards, and automation that planners, engineers, and leadership use to make decisions.

You will support strategic initiatives by preparing analytical outputs, tracking KPIs, streamlining reporting processes, and building digital tools that reduce manual effort. Working alongside analysts and maintenance professionals, you will translate business needs from Technical Service teams into functional data solutions: combining hands-on factory analytics with Python, SQL, and modern automation workflows.

What You'll Do
Reporting & analytics

Support planning, tracking, and coordination of analytics initiatives across Technical Service and Intralogistics
Prepare dashboards, status reports, presentations, and documentation for stakeholders
Write and maintain SQL queries; perform data analysis and prepare decision-support briefs
Monitor reporting timelines, data quality, and deliverables
Build and refresh Excel exports for spare parts, preventive maintenance (PM) coverage, consumption, forecasts, and assets



Maintenance operations data

Track KPIs for maintenance orders, PM compliance, missed work orders, and spare parts consumption
Support asset analysis, checklist compliance, and inventory planning
Handle ad-hoc data requests from planners and cross-functional partners



Automation & digitalization

Translate business needs into automation solutions and internal analytics tools
Develop Python/SQL workflows, data pipelines, and automated reporting using Git
Support development of AI solutions such as RAG agents, automated workflows, and reusable skills for maintenance teams
Identify automation and AI opportunities; support adoption through documentation and knowledge-sharing



Collaboration & process

Attend meetings, capture action items, and coordinate with internal teams
Improve analytics processes and reporting templates for efficiency and clarity



What You'll Bring


Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Technology & Management, Operations, or a related field
Strong experience with SQL for data extraction, joins, aggregations, and reporting
Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint) for structured exports, pivot tables, and stakeholder presentations
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a business-first mindset
Excellent written and verbal communication in English; German is a plus
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
Proactive, reliable, and comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously
Self-starter who learns quickly in a fast-paced environment
A team player with a flexible mindset and strong sense of ownership



Preferred


Experience with Python for data analysis, automation, and workflow integration
Familiarity with Git and version control
Understanding of AI/ML concepts, prompt engineering, or workflow design
Familiarity with BI and database tools (e.g., DBeaver, Power BI, or similar)
Demonstrated interest in building digital tools, automations, and data solutions
Familiarity with maintenance, manufacturing, or facilities operations concepts
Hands-on experience with at least one data or automation project used by real users — a portfolio or GitHub repository is highly recommended

Title: Junior AI GTM engineer (m/f/d)
Description:
Your mission

As an Junior AI GTM Engineer at mama health, you will build and own the internal AI tools that power our commercial team. Your mission is to simplify, automate and reinvent how our sales organisation operates. You will:


Own and optimize our commercial tech stack (e.g. HubSpot, Lemlist and other GTM tools), ensuring they are used effectively and continuously improved.
Build AI-powered internal tools that eliminate manual work and make our commercial team dramatically more productive.
Design and develop lightweight internal applications, including our long-term vision of replacing traditional CRM software with custom-built solutions.
Partner closely with the commercial team to understand pain points, gather feedback and rapidly turn ideas into practical AI solutions.
Drive adoption of the tools you build through training, iteration and continuous improvement.


Your profile


Build instead of buying: Help us replace expensive, generic SaaS tools with AI-powered solutions built specifically for our business.
Real ownership: You'll have the freedom to identify problems, build solutions and see your work used every day by the commercial team.
Work at the intersection of AI and business: Build products that directly improve how our sales organisation operates and scales.
Fast learning: Join an AI-first startup where experimentation, rapid iteration and continuous learning are encouraged.
High impact: Your work will shape the future of our commercial infrastructure and directly influence how we grow as a company.
Proof of building is essential: You have independently built an AI-powered application, automation or product you can show us through a link, private walkthrough or live demo. A side project, university project or self-initiated product all count.
AI-native builder mindset: You love creating things from scratch and are constantly experimenting with AI tools and new technologies.
Fast learner: Whether your background is Computer Science or something entirely different, you quickly learn new technologies and enjoy figuring things out independently.
Entrepreneurial problem solving: You move from an unclear problem to a practical solution, take ownership and know when a simple answer is better than a complex one.
Commercial understanding: You are curious about how sales teams operate and can translate their problems into useful systems, workflows and products.
Startup mentality: You're proactive, resourceful and thrive in fast-moving environments with a high degree of ownership.
Berlin office commitment: You are able and excited to work from our Berlin office five days per week. This is a hard requirement.


Why us?


Build instead of buying: Help us replace expensive, generic SaaS tools with AI-powered solutions built specifically for our business.
Real ownership: You'll have the freedom to identify problems, build solutions and see your work used every day by the commercial team.
Work at the intersection of AI and business: Build products that directly improve how our sales organisation operates and scales.
Fast learning: Join an AI-first startup where experimentation, rapid iteration and continuous learning are encouraged.
High impact: Your work will shape the future of our commercial infrastructure and directly influence how we grow as a company.


About Us

mama health’s mission is to build the largest healthcare data platform where patient find answers and healthcare players see how they can improve. We built 2 products:


a Patient App that helps chronic patients find answers to their daily questions - using best in class multi-agent systems and proprietary data
a Patient Journey Analytics Platform to see real time patient needs, roadblock and what needs to be done to improve patients care


Our values


Entrepreneurial spirit: We seek exceptional talent with the drive, passion, and creativity to shape the future of our company. This isn’t a place for those seeking routine tasks or detailed instructions. If you’re eager to influence the future of healthcare with your ideas and contributions, mama health is the place for you.
Results-driven culture: We operate by objectives and reward exceptional performance. Goals are clear and accountability is key. If you miss your targets, we expect you to step up and put in the extra effort. When you achieve them, take the time to recharge and celebrate your success.
Inclusive values: As a company addressing chronic diseases worldwide, we are building an international, diverse team. Our employees bring together a mix of medical, technical, and business expertise, representing over five nationalities.


Our Work Environment And Benefits

At mama health, we work (very) hard but know how to have fun. Most of our team is based in Berlin, with regular trips to our Berlin office for remote team members. We offer a range of benefits, including educational courses, gym memberships, mentoring, and more. We host frequent team events and an annual "workation" where the entire team gathers for a week of collaboration and bonding.

Join us to help transform patient experiences into actionable insights and shape the future of healthcare.

Title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
Description:
Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.

Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

Data Engineer (m/f/d)

We're looking for a Data Engineer who has hands-on experience integrating databases and external APIs, understands AWS infrastructure, and is comfortable working with tools like DBT to model and transform data. You'll help build and scale our data platform from ingestion through to the warehouse layer, powering AI Agents, BI, and business decisions across the organization.

You will:

Build and maintain data pipelines from ingestion through to storage
Take end-to-end ownership of pipeline components
Model data using data lake and warehouse concepts, and contribute to performance improvements (partitioning, file formats, tuning)
Apply data governance and security practices in your work (least-privilege IAM, encryption, PII handling)
Support the team with data quality, coding consistency and data availability
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders to translate requirements into working data solutions
Identify, formulate, and propose improvements to your own and your team’s practices

The Next Moonfarian:

2–4 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in production
Strong Python and advanced SQL
Basic Scala experience, or a willingness to pick it up
Familiarity with DBT (models, tests, documentation)
Solid working knowledge of AWS or another major cloud provider
Experience with relational databases and data warehouses
Confident in Git, CI/CD, and modern deployment practices
Practical experience with Docker
Solution-oriented, strong attention to detail, and open to feedback and mentorship
Nice to have:

Experience with Apache Spark or a similar distributed processing framework
Working knowledge of K8
Bash scripting
Flyway or similar SQL migration tools

If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

 

Our Values:

Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third - Client-Centric Focus. Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.
We pursue excellence and honor our promises - Commitment to Excellence. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.
We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements - Win together. We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.
We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit - Growth and Merit. We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.

We understand the important role that diversity plays in our success. Different backgrounds, experiences and ideas push us further and raise the bar. We’re committed to developing an inclusive and safe culture where everyone  — regardless of colour, race, religion, sex, origin, sexuality, disability, marital status, citizenship or gender identity — knows that they are an integral part of the team and can bring their full potential to their work.

*Minimum investments vary according to jurisdiction.

AI & Automation


Build AI-powered automations and internal tools
Prototype and test new AI use cases across the business
Research emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities
Improve internal processes through AI and automation
Work closely with our Head of IT to turn ideas into reality


Technology Operations


Support technology projects across different teams
Maintain documentation in Confluence
Research software and technology solutions
Help improve internal processes and workflows
Support workshops, meetings and team initiatives when needed


What You Offer Us

We're looking for potential, curiosity and initiative more than a perfect CV.

You'll likely enjoy this role if you:


Are currently enrolled at a German university.
Get excited about new AI tools and love figuring out how they work.
Learn by building, experimenting and trying things yourself.
Take initiative instead of waiting for instructions.
Enjoy solving problems and finding smarter ways of working.
Are organized, curious and comfortable with change.
Speak fluent English and can regularly work from our Berlin office.


Nice to have


Experience with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or GitHub Copilot
Basic programming knowledge (Python, JavaScript or similar)
Experience with APIs or automation tools like n8n, Make or Zapier
Jira or Confluence experience


One last thing

Skip the cover letter.

Instead, when you apply, please answer the following question in 200 words or less:


What's the coolest thing you've built, automated, or experimented with using AI?


It doesn't have to be perfect or technically complex; we're much more interested in your curiosity, creativity, and willingness to experiment than the final result. It can be a side project, a workflow you created, something you automated, or simply an experiment that taught you something new.

What Does Yoshi En Offer


An appealing discount on all of our products.
We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year.
The Urban Sports Club membership, Swapfiets bike rental and a subsidy for the BVG ticket.
Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia.

Title: System Administrator (m/f/d) | Legal AI Tech Scale-Up |Onsite
Description:
Your team

At Noxtua, we’re building Europe’s sovereign Legal AI — and the people building it need internal IT that just works: secure identities, reliable devices, and smooth access to the tools they use every day. We’re looking for a System Administrator to own and run our internal IT environment, keep it secure and well-automated, and be the go-to person for the systems our team depends on.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You’ll administer our Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environment, look after a mixed fleet of macOS and Windows devices, and automate as much of the day-to-day as possible — from identities and access to endpoints — as we scale. Because our team includes developers with their own setups, there’s room to grow the role toward supporting developer machines and infrastructure tooling too.

You’ll join Noxtua’s Engineering organisation and work closely with the people whose day-to-day depends on solid IT — across Engineering, AI, and the wider company. You’ll be the owner of our internal IT systems: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, single sign-on, and our endpoint fleet, collaborating with team leads on access and security and with external providers where needed. It’s a role with a lot of autonomy and visible impact on how effectively the whole company works.

About You


Microsoft 365 & identity: Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID — user lifecycle, groups, licensing, and access management.
Heterogeneous environments: Comfortable supporting a mixed device fleet — macOS and Windows endpoints (including some Windows desktops). Experience with Linux is a nice-to-have (largely developer machines in our case).
Single sign-on (SSO): Solid general understanding of SSO — where to apply it, the concepts behind it, and common integration paths (e.g. SAML / OIDC).
Automation-first mindset: A big part of this role is automating a lot of what would otherwise be manual work— you reach for scripts and tooling before doing things by hand. Scripting experience is important; Python is a nice-to-have.
Configuration management: Experience with Ansible — particularly valuable if the role also supports developer machines and infrastructure setup
Location:Berlin-based, able to be on site as needed for hands-on device and hardware support.


Your Responsibilities


Administer and optimize our Microsoft 365 / Entra ID environment — identities, groups, licensing, and access.
Manage our heterogeneous endpoint fleet (macOS, Windows, and developer Linux machines) — setup, patching, and support.
Own and improve single sign-on — deciding where it applies, and building and maintaining integrations for our tools.
Automate a large share of our IT operations — scripting and tooling (e.g., Python, Ansible) to take manual, repetitive work off the table and eliminate configuration drift. This is central to the role, not an afterthought.
Handle onboarding and offboarding — provisioning accounts, devices, and access, and cleanly revoking them (ideally automated).
Support developers and their machines, and help manage infrastructure tooling where it overlaps with IT.
Support our security and compliance posture — access reviews, MFA, and audit-relevant records (e.g., ISO 27001, C5, TISAX).
Document IT processes and maintain the asset and access inventory.


Our offer to you

Building Europe’s sovereign Legal AI is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work.


Hybrid: Berlin-based role with flexible remote days (some on-site presence needed for hands-on device and hardware support).
Working hours: Flexible working hours.
Vacation: 26 days + December 24th & 31st off, + 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days).
Discounts: e.g., Urban Sports Club membership, depending on location.
Equipment: Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus home-office setup budget (paid with your first salary).


About Us

Noxtua is Europe’s sovereign Legal AI. This legally competent AI covers the entire spectrum of legal text work – from information gathering (research) and analysis of complex issues (understanding) to document creation (drafting). The legally compliant AI meets the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements for lawyers (e.g. Section 203 German Criminal Code, Section 43e German Federal Code for Lawyers), is certified according to BSI C5, TISAX, ISO 27001, 9001, 27018, 27017, and 42001. The tech company Noxtua has formed exclusive partnerships with leading European publishing houses from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia for the Legal AI Workspaces Beck-Noxtua, MANZ-Noxtua, Swiss-Noxtua, Beck-Noxtua Poland, Beck-Noxtua Czech Republic and Beck-Noxtua Slovakia.

Founded in 2017 in the German capital as a result of a research project by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the European legal tech company has many years of experience in developing GDPR-compliant AI solutions and now has offices in Paris, Berlin, Zagreb, and Munich. Strategic partners including Germany’s leading legal publisher C.H.BECK as well as the leading law firms CMS and Dentons have invested around 81 million EURO in the European scaleup as part of its Series B.

We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.

Description:
About us:

At Lufthansa Innovation Hub, we accelerate the NEXT in travel. Founded in Berlin over a decade ago, we bring together entrepreneurial minds and jointly lead progress in shaping the future of the travel industry.




By continuously expanding our footprint in the ecosystem, we actively shape industry conversations and secure valuable partnerships and innovation opportunities.

The NEXT in travel is built today: With focus, ambition, and purpose, we develop solutions to drive and enable (y)our innovation agenda.




Job summary:

The Strategic Intelligence team is leading the charge in accelerating and fortifying LIH’s thought leadership position in Travel and Mobility Tech. If you are already a true TNMT industry expert or are inspired by the thought of becoming one and want to shape the industry’s future, this role is for you!

With the help of cutting-edge research and analysis tools, you will systematically track and screen the global startup ecosystem, observe and interpret media coverage on Travel & Mobility Tech topics, and identify innovation initiatives by major industry stakeholders. You will help synthesize insights and communicate your findings to internal and external audiences.

This role is based in Berlin.




Responsibilities:

Analyze and synthesize statistical data using platforms and tools like Excel, Airtable, and Pitchbook.
Utilize AI tools like LLMs and NLP to aggregate and categorize data.
Support the development of our internal Strategic Intelligence platform by aggregating datasets, working on dashboards, and curating newsfeeds.
Create compelling charts, visualizations, and presentation slides.
Synthesize clear findings from complex information to support article and report creation.
Communicate effectively and in a structured, friendly manner with colleagues internally and in an engaging written way with external audiences.
Contribute to collaborative innovation formats within Lufthansa Innovation Hub, like ideation sessions and trend research events.




Profile:

Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or STEM.
Enjoys working with data and large datasets to create compelling analyses and visualizations.
Competency when working with Excel or other data analysis tools to garner insights from data (pivot tables, basic calculations, categorizations).
Ability to create clean and meaningful charts in Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with advanced data visualization tools like Tableau is welcome but not a must.
Ability to work collaboratively in a results-oriented, fast-paced environment where ownership and impact are highly valued.
Very good English skills, both written and spoken.
Passion for travel, aviation, and related technology trends.
Availability for at least six months.




What we offer:

Be an essential member of a smart, hard-working and constantly growing team developing solutions for the traveler of tomorrow with one of the most iconic brands in aviation.
Gain deep insights into the corporate world as well as the international startup ecosystem.
Work independently and entrepreneurially owning work streams and projects.
Utilize seasoned Lufthanseats and experienced tech talent as supporter and challenger.
Multi-faceted corporate culture in the heart of the Berlin tech ecosystem.
Corporate benefits: A USC membership, and yes, we also do have a fruit basket.

🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time

💼 Level: Entry-Level to Mid-Level

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Research Analyst to conduct research, analyze data, identify trends, and generate insights that support strategic business decisions. This role is ideal for individuals with strong critical thinking skills and a passion for transforming data and information into actionable recommendations.




🎯 Key Responsibilities

• Conduct quantitative and qualitative research using internal and external data sources.

• Gather, analyze, and interpret market, industry, customer, competitor, and business data.

• Prepare research reports, presentations, dashboards, and strategic insights for stakeholders.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

• Ability to interpret complex information and communicate findings clearly.
