Title: Student Assistant - IT Administration (f/m/d)
Description:
Job Description

The Student Assistant in IT Administration supports the smooth operation of Climate Analytics’ IT environment and ensures that staff have reliable access to the tools and systems they need to work efficiently. In close collaboration with our experienced IT Administrator and our external IT service provider, the working student contributes to day-to-day IT support, user onboarding and offboarding, and basic device setup and maintenance. Through this position, the student will gain hands-on experience in IT operations, user support, and system administration — contributing directly to the reliability, security, and efficiency of the Climate Analytics’ IT infrastructure. In addition, you will support IT projects (with supervision), such as documentation and process improvement initiatives - an opportunity to learn new tools and best practices and get hands-on experience in IT operations and user support.

Your Responsibilities


IT Support and Ticket Handling (35–45%)
Assist in managing incoming IT support tickets, helping to diagnose and resolve basic software, hardware, and access issues.
Provide friendly, timely, and solution-oriented support to employees across all departments.
Device Setup and Maintenance (25–35%)
Prepare, configure, and update laptops (primarily macOS, some Windows) for new and existing employees.
Support regular device maintenance tasks such as system updates, security checks, and troubleshooting.
Help maintain an accurate inventory of devices and peripherals.
System and Server Administration (with Supervision) (10–15%)
Support the IT Administration Officer and external IT service provider in monitoring internal servers and hosted tools.
Perform basic maintenance tasks, such as restarting services or checking system status, under guidance.
Help ensure regular backups and data integrity checks are completed.
Documentation and Process Improvement (10–15%)
Contribute to documenting IT procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting guides.
Help identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows or improve user documentation.
Assist in maintaining records related to software licenses and system configurations.
Security and Compliance Support (5–10%)
Follow IT security guidelines and support implementation of best practices (e.g. password policies, device encryption, access control).


Your profile

Essential Criteria

Education and Experience


IT administration / user support: prior hands-on experience in a work context
Fluency in English
Currently enrolled in an IT admin/support related university program with min. 12+ months of enrollment left
Residing in the Berlin area
Open to 100% onsite presence in our Berlin office during probation period and 80% afterwards


Specific Expertise Required


macOS experience, in a work context
Scripting experience, at least basic (needed for our servers)


Desirable criteria

Preferred Experience


Python skills (for scripts, server communication, applications)
Basic experience with Windows
Basic experience with Linux based systems, ideally in a work context (for servers)
Basic understanding of network or server administration concepts (e.g., FTP, SSH, SSL).
Some experience with cloud-based systems or IT ticketing tools.


Desirable Soft Skills


Good communication skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and manage priorities.


Our offer


A job with a purpose. You will work in an international team of highly engaged people and contribute to our work in the field of climate change mitigation.
A positive and inspiring working atmosphere in an international team. Our Berlin office is located near Moritzplatz in the heart of Kreuzberg.
Flexibility to accommodate your university schedule.
Fully funded Germany-wide public transport ticket.
40 € monthly company contribution to Urban Sports Club membership.
Online mental health and wellbeing platform.
Free German language classes.
Bike rental discount.
Optional company pension plan.


Conditions


Application deadline: Open until filled
Start date: As soon as possible
Duration: We are looking for a long-term collaboration. Currently we can offer a fixed term contract for 12 months with the perspective of extension based on performance and funding.
Remuneration: Level 1 Step 1 on our remuneration scale (EUR 1420 gross monthly, based on a 20-hour work week).
Vacation: 29 days paid annual leave for each year worked (pro rata) + one day gifted around Christmas.


Please apply with:


Your CV
Cover letter addressing essential criteria, listing of three references, and include your earliest start date and salary expectations


Please use PDF format exclusively using the application form. Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed.

We are a diverse and inclusive team and welcome your application regardless of your gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect that makes you unique.

About Us

Climate Analytics is a global climate science and policy institute established in 2008 that delivers cutting-edge science, analysis and support to accelerate climate action and keep global warming below 1.5°C. Our international team is composed of roughly 170 staff. Half are based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany, and the remainder work out of our five regional offices in Africa, Australia & Pacific, the Caribbean, South Asia and North America. Title: Data Protection Specialist, Germany
Description:
UNIQLO is a leading brand of the Fast Retailing Group, one of the largest apparel retailers in the world. UNIQLO respects the individuality and lifestyle of all customers and takes pride in creating high quality, long-lasting, innovative clothing at an affordable price.

We are currently recruiting for a Data Protection Specialist to sit within our European Information Security Team. This role will report into the Data Privacy Manager and be based in our offices in Berlin, Germany.

This highly collaborative role will support across our European markets and work closely with internal departments in both Germany and Poland as well as Global and Regional Information Security Officers.

This is an excellent opportunity for a data protection, legal or compliance professional to step into a key subject matter expert role, supporting our teams across Germany and Poland. You will play an important part in providing practical guidance for the business, so we are looking for someone who can communicate clearly, build strong relationships and deliver engaging training and support to colleagues across different functions.

What you will be responsible for:


Supporting data protection and AI programs of the Fast Retailing Group, led by Data Protection Officer (DPO).
Acting as the point of contact of business departments, support functions and management on data protection matters.
Educating and training employees on data protection and AI compliance responsibilities and obligations.
Identifying, raising and addressing risk areas of data protection in internal operations and projects.
Manage data protection related incidents.
Assisting stakeholders to conduct DPIAs. Review and follow up of resulting recommended action plans.
Conduct privacy checks and ensure that the data protection requirements are respected in our internal processes.
Manage the data subjects' rights.
Implement actions to ensure compliance with relevant information management policies and data protection laws.
Collaborate with members of Information Security Office team supporting the business teams to conduct assessments of partners and projects in order to evaluate the risks for our customers and company, assess the gap with our security and privacy policy requirements and follow remediations until completion.



Skills, Experience and Attributes:


More than 4 years' experience in data protection, compliance or legal.
Extensive knowledge of data protection and AI laws and practices.
Ability to reflect legal requirements to activities/operational procedures.
Excellent communication skills: verbal and written German and English are essential, Polish is desirable.
Ability to prioritise work effectively.
Highly motivated self-starter with ability to work independently and within a team.
Strong sense of ownership and driven to manage tasks to completion.
Strong capabilities on reporting activities.
Cyber security technical background is a plus.
Appropriate privacy and technical and/or security certifications preferred. (e.g. CIPP/E, CIPM, AIGP, etc.)



What we can offer you:


30 days holiday allowance
Bi-annual bonus potential
Profit share scheme
Meal allowance/month
Mobility allowance/month
30% Staff Discount
Central Location of stores and office
Hybrid Working potential
Volunteer days - twice a year
Employer-funded pension scheme

Title: Working Student – Product Data & Analytics
Description:
About Redcare Pharmacy:

As Europe's No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision "Until every human has their health". If you're seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values, join us and start your #Redcareer today.

About The Role

As a Working Student - Product Data & Analytics, you will support our RX Product Domain by helping Product Managers make data-driven decisions through analytics, reporting, experimentation, and AI-enabled insights. Working closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, UX Designers, and AI specialists, you will analyse product and customer data, evaluate product performance, and contribute to the development of data-driven solutions that improve our products and customer experience.

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in Product Analytics within one of Europe's leading eHealth companies. You'll work in a collaborative, international, and agile environment where you'll learn from experienced colleagues, develop practical skills in analytics and AI, and make a meaningful impact while balancing your studies.

Job Description

About your tasks


Analyze product and customer data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights.
Build dashboards and reports using Power BI or Tableau to monitor product performance and business KPIs.
Support product experiments by preparing datasets, measuring outcomes, and evaluating feature performance.
Collaborate with Product Managers, Software Engineers, UX Designers, and AI specialists to develop data-driven product improvements.
Explore and apply AI tools, including Generative AI, to improve internal processes and customer experience.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Document analyses, experiment results, and best practices to support continuous improvement.


Qualifications

About you

You are curious, analytical, and eager to learn. You enjoy working with data, solving business problems, and collaborating with others to turn insights into better products.


Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
You have experience analyzing data through university projects, internships, or personal projects.
You have strong analytical thinking with the ability to present data and communicate insights clearly.
You have experience with Excel and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau, as well as an understanding of KPIs and business metrics.
You have an interest in AI technologies and practical experience using tools such as ChatGPT or other Generative AI applications.
You have basic knowledge of Python and SQL is a plus, as is familiarity with Databricks, BigQuery, Jira, or Confluence.
You have Fluent English skills and having German language is a plus


Additional Information

About your benefits:

In order to provide our employees with the best possible support for their individual needs, we offer a wide range of benefits:


Sports: Stay healthy. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, so that you can take advantage of a huge variety of sport offers.
Mental Health: Get quick and professional help from psychologists of Likeminded if you feel overwhelmed in private or professional life. Anonymous and free of charge. 
Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
Mobility: We provide our employees with a fully costed Deutschland Ticket, which can be used at any time. Click here to learn more.
And many more :)

You’ll be joining a supportive team that works closely together, with opportunities to collaborate with payroll consultants, internal stakeholders and wider data teams across Legal & General. We’re looking for someone who enjoys detail, takes pride in accuracy, and is curious about finding better ways to do things.

Managing operational data across cleansing, validation, transformation, integration and mining activities

Maintaining clear audit trails across the full data lifecycle
Supporting and upskilling less experienced team members in new processes
Sharing best practice with wider data teams and identifying better ways of working

Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with detailed data
Experience in data analysis, operational data management or data process improvement
Strong attention to detail and a right-first-time mindset

Title: Data Coordinator – Adult Learning
Description:
Job Description

Do you have experience of managing and analysing data to support service delivery and are you keen to play a key role in supporting Adult Learning programmes that help residents develop new skills and progress in work and learning? If so, you could be the perfect fit for our Adult Learning Data Coordinator role in the Employment and Skills Team at East Sussex County Council.

As Data Coordinator, you will play a central role in maintaining high standards of data quality across Adult Learning programmes. You will support the preparation, validation and submission of learner and programme data, ensuring information is accurate, complete and compliant. Through reporting, analysis and forecasting, you will support performance monitoring and informed decision-making, while identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. Working closely with colleagues and delivery partners, you will support audit and assurance activities and provide line management and support to the Adult Learning Data Officer.

This role is a one-year fixed term contract with the potential for extension, subject to funding.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who


Have experience of working in a data-focussed role involving reporting, data quality and performance monitoring
Can analyse and interpret data to produce accurate information that supports decision-making
Have strong organisational skills and can manage a varied workload to meet deadlines
Can communicate complex information clearly and build positive working relationships with a range of stakeholders.


Please download the job description and person specification for more information.

To apply for this role, please follow the ‘Apply Now’ button above and upload your CV and a Supporting Statement. We will be using your Supporting Statement to shortlist so please be sure to address how you meet all the criteria in the person specification, drawing on any relevant work/life experience, education, or personal interests.

For guidance on how to write an application see our how to apply page and our statement on the use of AI .

Interviews will take place at County Hall in Lewes on Wednesday 19 August 2026. If you are unavailable on this date, please let us know, and we may be able to schedule another time.

Candidates who meet certain criteria are given priority when we shortlist. See our priority status page for details.

This is an excellent opportunity to use your analytical and reporting skills to make a real impact on Adult Learning programmes across East Sussex. You'll join a supportive team, contribute to service improvement and have access to training and development opportunities.

For an informal discussion about this opportunity contact Rebecca Jones, Adult Learning Manager, Rebecca.jonesCS@eastsussex.gov.uk

We offer a diverse range of benefits to help and support you during your employment. More information can be found on our benefits page.

Choose East Sussex!

About Us

Description:
Closing Date

2026-08-28

Job title: Risk Analyst

Location: Hybrid – Sussex area (2/3 days a week in office)

Salary: £50,000 + benefits

Help Shape the Future of Wastewater Risk and Resilience

At Southern Water, we're committed to delivering resilient wastewater services that protect our customers, communities, and the environment. We're looking for a Risk Analyst to play a pivotal role in helping us understand, prioritise, and manage risk across our wastewater assets and operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of our Asset Management function, using data-driven insight to influence investment decisions, improve operational resilience, and support the delivery of our long-term performance commitments.

Working closely with colleagues from Asset Management, Operations, Engineering and Planning, you'll help create a clear picture of risk across our wastewater business and ensure investment is targeted where it delivers the greatest value and benefit.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Asset Risk & Resilience Analyst, you will:


Analyse asset, operational, environmental, customer, and financial data to identify current and emerging risks across the wastewater network.
Develop and maintain a comprehensive view of wastewater asset risk, ensuring risks are accurately recorded, monitored, and tracked.
Support key regulatory and investment planning frameworks, including the Drainage and Wastewater Management Plan (DWMP) and PR29 submissions.
Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Asset Management, and Planning teams to improve risk identification, reporting, and management practices.
Integrate reporting systems, operational intelligence, and subject matter expertise to provide a consistent and robust understanding of risk.
Produce meaningful risk reports, dashboards, and performance insights for a variety of stakeholders, including senior leadership teams.
Monitor trends and identify areas where performance may be outside agreed risk appetite levels.
Support the prioritisation of investment programmes and mitigation activities based on risk, resilience, and value.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk methodologies, reporting frameworks, and analytical processes.
Help drive better decision-making that improves customer outcomes, environmental performance, and asset resilience.


Essential

What We're Looking For


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and turn it into actionable insights.
Experience assessing, analysing, and communicating business, operational, or asset-related risks.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of deliverables.
A proactive mindset with a focus on identifying opportunities for improvement and driving positive change.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and effectively.


Desirable


Experience within the water, wastewater, utilities, infrastructure, or other asset-intensive sectors.
Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, Alteryx, or other data analysis and visualisation tools.
Experience using asset management, risk management, or investment planning systems.
Understanding of resilience planning, investment prioritisation, and regulatory performance frameworks.
Familiarity with wastewater asset management and operational performance reporting.


Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an unparalleled opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at a time of significant change, working alongside a highly skilled leadership team with a clear vision for the future. We offer an environment where senior professionals can make a meaningful impact, influence major strategic decisions, and drive long-term value creation.

"At Southern Water, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. If you’re passionate about making a positive impact and think you can bring value to our team, we’d love to hear from you—even if you don’t tick every box. Your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need."

Our Commitment to Diversity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Kantar is the world’s leading AI-native marketing data and analytics business and an indispensable brand partner to the world’s top companies. We combine the most meaningful attitudinal and behavioural data with deep expertise and advanced analytics to uncover how people think and act. We help clients understand what has happened and why and how to shape the marketing strategies that shape their future.




Why this job is important




We’re known for our data. Help us turn it into insight that makes a real difference.




At Kantar, you’ll join a team that sits at the heart of how data becomes decisions. As a Data Analyst in our Panels Performance & Business Intelligence team, you’ll strengthen the analytical foundations that underpin our panel solutions. Working closely with colleagues across data science, engineering, technology and our Global Delivery Centres, you’ll help ensure our models are robust, scalable and genuinely useful for clients and internal teams alike.




This role is ideal if you enjoy combining analytical thinking with practical delivery – taking models from idea to production, spotting opportunities for improvement, and explaining complex findings in a way that others can act on.




What you’ll be doing

Maintaining and improving analytical models used in day-to-day panel operations
Analysing model outputs to identify performance issues and opportunities to enhance results
Working with global delivery and technology teams to support production-ready data models and BI solutions
Running statistical and exploratory analyses to uncover actionable insights
Communicating analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues







The ideal skills & experience

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a natural curiosity for data
Experience using SQL and at least one analytical language such as Python or R
A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals
Experience working with data transformation or ETL tools (DBT is a plus)
Confidence explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences
A collaborative mindset and comfort working with distributed, cross-functional teams




What’s in it for you

Flexible hybrid working (two to three days in the office)
25 days leave, 2 days paid for volunteering and life event leave
Competitive salary and bonus (bonus dependent on role)
Company pension
Enhanced parental leave
Healthcare options
Wide range of flexible benefits




Please note

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, either at the point of hire or at any point in the future. Applicants should only apply if they have the permanent right to live and work in the UK and will not require employer sponsorship during their employment.




Why join Kantar?

You’ll be joining our Profiles division, home to specialists in survey design, sampling and data science. With the world’s largest audience network (over 170 million people), we’re trusted by many of the world’s leading brands to provide amazing insights from real people.




What about Kantar itself? Well, we shape the brands of tomorrow by better understanding people everywhere. By understanding people, we can understand what drives their decisions, actions, and aspirations on a global scale. And if we combine the expertise of our people with the latest AI technology, we can really help brands discover some amazing insights.




And because we know people, we like to make sure our own people are being looked after as well. Equality of opportunity for everyone is our highest priority and we support our colleagues to work in a way works for them. We encourage applications from all backgrounds and sections of society. Even if you feel like you’re not an exact match, we’d love to receive your application and talk to you about this job or others with us.

Title: Product Analyst - Anti-Cheating
Description:
Office location: Cambridge, UK - This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. However, applicants should be based (or be willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.

Are you a data-driven problem solver who is keen on protecting fair play and improving the player experience in MMO games?

As a Product Analyst focused on anti-cheating at Jagex, you'll play a vital role in safeguarding the integrity of our games by helping us understand and combat cheating, botting, and gold farming. Working as part of our Anti-Cheat team, you'll use data to uncover player behaviours, identify emerging threats, and develop insights that help shape detection systems and preventative measures.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine analytical expertise with game knowledge, working alongside Product, Data Science, Game Analytics, and Engineering teams to protect millions of players and ensure our game worlds remain healthy, balanced, and fair.

What you'll be doing:


Support the day-to-day operation of the Anti-Cheat team, helping ensure key KPIs, SLAs, and player sentiment remain on track.
Analyse large datasets to identify suspicious behaviours, botting activity, and gold farming trends.
Work closely with Game Analytics, Data Science, and Product teams to develop effective anti-cheat strategies and deterrents.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights and practical recommendations that improve game integrity.
Support the development and enhancement of game telemetry by partnering with Engineering and Design teams.
Collaborate with central Data teams to define reporting requirements and improve data products.
Build a deep understanding of game systems, player behaviours, and telemetry to improve the effectiveness of anti-cheat initiatives.
Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping drive informed decision-making across the business.


What we're looking for:


Experience querying and analysing data using SQL, with a strong understanding of data cleansing techniques.
A demonstrable understanding of video game player behaviours, particularly in MMORPGs and preferably in Old School RuneScape and/or RuneScape.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures such as AWS, Snowflake, and OLAP technologies.
Experience creating reports and visualisations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies within large datasets.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical findings in a clear, accessible way.
A proactive approach to problem-solving and a passion for using data to improve player experiences.


What we offer:

When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks & Benefits package including:


Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
Employee Assistance Programme & onsite Counselling.
Life Insurance.
Discretionary annual performance bonus.
Enhanced family leave policies from day 1.
Flexible working hours.
25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more!


Inclusion & Accessibility Statement

We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.

If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you're invited to interview.

This role is only open to applicants who have the permanent right to work in the UK. We are unable to provide or take over visa sponsorship for this position, either now or in the future. Applicants must therefore be able to demonstrate their ongoing eligibility to work in the UK without the need for employer sponsorship.

About Jagex:

We are Jagex: The RuneScape Company- home to one of gaming's most enduring success stories. We create deep, community-powered games with worlds that evolve, inspire, and endure. Our flagship MMORPG franchise, RuneScape has welcomed over 300 million player accounts, inspiring generations of players across PC and mobile for 25 years.

As we begin our 26th year, we are accelerating our strategy to expand RuneScape into a broader ecosystem of forever games and connected experiences, grounded in a renewed commitment to integrity and fair play. This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025 representing a major step in building a multi-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape's history. For more information, visit www.jagex.com.

Headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom, We are home to passionate creators, storytellers, engineers, and even a few dreamers, all united by a single mission- to shape the future of online worlds and empower players to make them their own. We're looking for people to join us who share our ambitions & values - We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences which inspire our communities. Our values guide everything we do: We Embrace Fellowship by collaborating and sharing openly. Power BI Developer

Salary Negotiable DoE

Permanent

Milton Keynes (Hybrid)







Your New Role

We are currently support a globally recognisable brand in securing an ambitious BI Developer. You'll design, develop and maintain engaging Power BI dashboards, semantic models and reporting solutions that support Finance & Controlling. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, define KPIs and reporting logic, build scalable data models using DAX, SQL and modern Azure technologies, and support the migration of legacy Cognos reports into Power BI. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with finance or management information reporting are highly desirable, while previous exposure to Cognos would be beneficial. You'll be a confident communicator who can translate business requirements into intuitive reporting solutions, build strong stakeholder relationships, challenge assumptions where needed, and thrive in a fast-paced Agile environment focused on continuous improvement.







In Return

You'll join an organisation investing heavily in its data and reporting capability, offering the opportunity to work with modern technologies on high-profile transformation initiatives. In return, you'll enjoy a collaborative hybrid working environment, exposure to enterprise-scale BI projects, the chance to influence reporting strategy, mentor emerging talent, and play a key role in delivering data-driven decision making across the business.

You will be accountable for the support in the overview and alignment of our operational performance in networks including its year-on-year improvement in line with our upcoming AMP8 objectives.

You will need to align with internal data teams as well as the different regional capabilities and front-line staff in the creation of a standardized view of performance across Leakage, Interruptions to Supply, CMEX and CRI.

To work within a team to develop strategies and methods to learn from failure, working with our frontline staff; implementing policies and procedures for the net benefit of the organization.


Learning outcomes associated with our commitments

Understand in depth our Outcome Delivery Incentive (ODI) deliverables.
Work through the organisation, from senior management to front line staff.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify root causes and recommend effective solutions.

You will be accountable for the support in the overview and alignment of our operational performance in networks including its year-on-year improvement in line with our upcoming AMP8 objectives.

You will need to align with internal data teams as well as the different regional capabilities and front-line staff in the creation of a standardized view of performance across Leakage, Interruptions to Supply, CMEX and CRI.

To work within a team to develop strategies and methods to learn from failure, working with our frontline staff; implementing policies and procedures for the net benefit of the organization.

  • Learning outcomes associated with our commitments
  • Familiarize, own and adopt business systems to enable analysis and delivery of learning outcomes.

Title: CRM Analytics & Insight Analyst
Description:
Because your new ideas are our way new ways of working.

Evolve, your way.

Digital at Primark

Our digital teams are right at the heart of what we do. Surrounded by some of the best digital specialists in the industry, you’ll bring your own ideas to the business to shape the experience of our customers as part of a forward-thinking team.

Are you a data-driven CRM professional with a passion for customer insights and analytics? Join Primark’s growing Digital Team as a CRM Customer Insight Analyst, where you'll transform customer data into actionable insights that drive CRM performance and business growth. Working closely with CRM and key business stakeholders, you will deliver reporting, analysis, dashboards, and campaign performance evaluations to support data-driven decision-making. You will also identify opportunities to enhance customer engagement through segmentation and customer insights. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in the continued evolution of Primark’s CRM programme while developing your career within a dynamic and fast-paced digital environment.

What You’ll Do as a CRM Analytics & Insight Analyst:

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:


Demonstrate CRM impact and effectiveness through analysis of campaign, customer, transactional, GA4, and app data.
Deliver campaign reporting, post-campaign analysis, and recommendations to improve CRM performance and support planning decisions.
Develop and automate reporting on acquisition performance, enabling ROI tracking and activity prioritisation
Lead the delivery of CRM reporting initiatives, working cross-functionally to ensure accurate, accessible CRM data within Tableau.
Design and maintain KPI dashboards across the CRM funnel, providing actionable insights and clear performance visibility for senior stakeholders.
Analyse customer data to build audience understanding, inform segmentation strategies, and optimise campaign targeting.
Evaluate A/B test results, including target vs. control group analysis, to inform the CRM testing roadmap.
Support ADHOC requests from across Digital, to demonstrate the impact CRM has had on the wider business and commercial objectives
Present analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Promote data literacy by upskilling CRM teams and stakeholders in reporting, insights, and performance measurement.


What You’ll Bring

We want every person in our organisation to feel like they’re making a key contribution. Here are some of the experiences and skills you’ll need for the role:


Proven experience in CRM, customer insights, digital analytics, or marketing analytics, with strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations that drive business outcomes.
Strong CRM and customer analytics expertise, including experience analysing campaign performance, customer behaviour, segmentation, lifecycle analysis, CRM performance metrics, and identifying optimisation opportunities.
Advanced technical skills, including proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis, along with experience working with large customer databases and multiple data sources such as transactional, behavioural, and campaign data.
Experience with reporting and analytics tools, including data visualisation platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools, as well as digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and app analytics data.
Knowledge of testing and measurement methodologies, including A/B test design, performance measurement, results evaluation, and applying insights to improve customer engagement and business performance.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences and work cross-functionally with CRM, Marketing, Digital, Data, and Technology teams.
Highly organised, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a passion for customer insight, continuous improvement, data accuracy, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience within retail, e-commerce, or other customer-focused industries is desirable.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, potential bonus. You will also get 27days of annual leave and bank holidays and you can also buy 5 more. Because primark is all about tailoring to you we offer tax saver ticket, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Hey! We're Huel, and we're pleased to meet you 👋

Our culture thrives on high performance, and we set the bar high for new Hueligans who join us.

We invite you to read the advert below for our new Data Analyst position to understand the role, and explore our 7 Huel values before applying to ensure we have the right working environment for you!




The role

Huel is looking for a Data Analyst to turn raw behavioural and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail teams. You’ll build measurement frameworks, run causal analyses, and create self-serve dashboards, helping the business move fast and make confident, data-driven decisions.




Key responsibilities include:

Owning end-to-end analysis – translate open-ended questions from Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail into clear analytical briefs, run the analysis, and land unambiguous recommendations.
Designing & evaluating experiments – design A/B tests and causal-inference studies (lift analysis, hold-out tests) and communicate results in plain language.
Defining measurement frameworks – set the right KPIs and establish how new initiatives will be measured, ensuring every launch has a clear success metric and data plan from day one.
Scale our data foundations – team up with Engineering to design efficient, accurate data sets and schemas, define requirements for new data feeds, and automate the checks that keep everything running smoothly.
Championing self-serve analytics – develop and maintain live dashboards, document datasets, and run training sessions so non-analysts can answer routine questions without waiting in a queue.
AI & Automation - Champion the adoption of AI-powered analytics, using AI tools to enhance analysis, automate routine activities, uncover deeper insights, and improve productivity, while enabling colleagues to self-serve trusted data and answer business questions independently.
Spotting growth opportunities – combine behavioural and marketing data with commercial metrics to size new products, markets, and campaigns, prioritising by impact and effort.




This role is based at our HQ in Tring, Hertfordshire. We operate a hybrid working model, with office days on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays.




Not yet sure if this is the right role for you? Click HERE to read a more detailed job description.




What we're looking for in you

We’re looking for a confident, curious analyst who’s comfortable working with statistics, behavioural data, and experiment design. You can move seamlessly between SQL, product analytics tools, and storytelling through slides. You’re proactive, independent, and always looking for high-impact opportunities to raise the bar on how we use data. In a fast-paced environment, you adapt quickly and communicate clearly - collaborating with both technical and non-technical teams to get things done.

SQL – you can write quick exploratory queries or optimise a multi-table join on Snowflake without breaking a sweat.
Product analytics – comfortable in platforms such as Heap, Amplitude or Mixpanel and happy to set up events, funnels and cohorts from scratch.
Statistical – solid on A/B testing, experiment design and the basics of causal inference; you know when a result is worth acting on.
Measurement mindset – you’ve built tracking plans and KPI frameworks that let teams see what “good” looks like before they ship.
Data - experience modelling data in dbt (or similar), automating checks and keeping feeds clean and accurate as they scale.




And as always, we’re on the lookout for new Hueligans who love a fast-paced environment and are always striving to be their best. We want people who aren’t afraid to think differently and push boundaries. If you’re all about setting big goals and believe that amazing things happen through creativity and teamwork, you’ll fit right in at Huel!




What do we offer in return?

We know that at times, our teams face demanding pressures, and exceptional effort deserves meaningful rewards. That's why we've created a world-class perks and benefits program designed to support our Hueligans in achieving their best, both professionally and personally, while celebrating the global impact they're making!




🕖 Hybrid working - We spend Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office together. The remaining two days have the option to be worked from home.

🌴 30 days annual leave PLUS bank holidays

🥤 Free Huel to keep you going

🏖️ 2 weeks a year to work remotely from anywhere!

🐾 Dog friendly

🙋 Paid Volunteering Days

🏋️ Free on-site gym with free classes, and we will give you your own nutrition plan

🧘 Free on-site wellness area offering infrared saunas and an ice bath🧘

🧠 Free 1-on-1 therapy provided by Self-Space.

🏥 Private Medical and Health insurance for you and your loved ones, including free life insurance covering up to 4x your salary

⚡ Electric Car Scheme with onsite charging

🚴Cycle to Work Scheme

🤰 Enhanced Family Leave

👪 Workplace Nursery Scheme

🎓 Huel Academy

💸 Paid Employee Referral Scheme

🎉 Biannual events to celebrate success - Have you heard about Huelchella?




We are Hueligans

We know that diversity isn't just important; it’s essential, and it makes us stronger. We're all about embracing our differences, celebrating what makes us unique, and bringing together Hueligans from all walks of life.

Whilst we all share the 7 values of Huel, it’s our individual differences that truly enhance our culture of belonging. We seek out Hueligans from around the world, encouraging authenticity, diverse views, and fresh ideas to create products that our global customers love.

Annual salary: up to £31,101.84

Customer Insight Analyst

Location: Milton Keynes

Salary: £31,101.84 per annum

Hours: 42.5 hours per week

Contract: Permanent, Full Time

Working Pattern: Monday to Friday, Office Based

Be The Voice Behind a Better Customer Experience

Are you passionate about understanding what customers really need?

Do you love turning data into stories, identifying trends, solving problems and influencing positive change?

We're looking for a Customer Insight Analyst to join our team in Milton Keynes. This isn't just a reporting role – it's an opportunity to shape how our customers experience our services every day.

As our Customer Insight Analyst, you'll combine your analytical expertise with your understanding of the customer journey to uncover valuable insights that drive service improvements. You'll work closely with operational teams, leaders and stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve challenges and ensure customer feedback translates into meaningful action.

If you're naturally curious, enjoy digging into data, and are motivated by making a real difference to customers, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing


Championing the voice of the customer by analysing feedback, satisfaction measures and service performance data.
Mapping customer experiences and identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey.
Turning complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support business decisions.
Interpreting Power BI dashboards and reports that help teams understand performance and drive improvement.
Investigating trends, recurring issues and root causes to support problem resolution and service enhancement.
Working closely with operational Supervisors and Managers to understand challenges and identify solutions.
Monitoring customer performance metrics and identifying opportunities to improve service outcomes.
Presenting findings in a clear, meaningful way that drives action and positive change.
Supporting a culture of continuous improvement through evidence-based recommendations.


What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines analytical thinking with a genuine passion for customer experience.

You'll Be


Naturally curious and motivated to understand why things happen.
A confident communicator who can explain data to different audiences.
Passionate about improving customer outcomes.
Comfortable challenging processes and identifying better ways of working.
A team player who enjoys building strong relationships across the business.
Solution-focused, proactive and driven by results.


Essential

Skills and Experience


Experience in data analysis, customer insight, performance reporting or business intelligence.
Strong understanding of customer satisfaction measures and customer experience improvement.
Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, pivot tables and data visualisation.
Working knowledge of dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Ability to analyse large and complex datasets and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
Excellent numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience identifying trends, root causes and improvement opportunities.
Ability to communicate insights clearly and influence decision-making.


Desirable


Experience working within repairs, housing, facilities management or customer service environments.
Experience creating dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Knowledge of customer journey mapping and service improvement methodologies.


What' We Offer You

At Mears, our people make the difference. We believe in creating an environment where colleagues feel valued, supported and empowered to grow.

You'll Benefit From


25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
Private medical care.
Annual Mears Fun Day – our company-wide celebration and thank you event.
Paid Volunteering Leave to support causes that matter to you.
Mears Rewards, offering discounts on groceries, holidays, eye tests and much more.
Share Save Scheme.
Family-friendly policies.
Opportunities to develop your career within a leading provider of housing and property services.


This is your opportunity to take a lead role in a dynamic, purpose-driven team. Join Mears and help us deliver repairs that really make a difference.

All our roles require candidates to have the entitlement to work within the UK, Mears does not currently offer visa sponsorship. To drive a Mears vehicle, you must be aged over 21 have held your licence over 3 months and have less than 9 points. Candidates should be aware that all our roles are subject to relevant DBS/Security checks before commencement of employment.

Apply below or to discuss your application further; contact:

Beth Dunford (beth.dunford@mearsgroup.co.uk)

If you need any help with your application process, we are here to support you. We will be accessible every step of the way.

Title: Data Reporting Analyst
Description:
/Position: Reporting Analyst

/Location: Farnborough HQ (Hybrid options available)




Are you a Reporting specialist with advanced knowledge of SSRS and SQL?




We have an immediate need for a Reporting Analyst to join our team! Reporting and timely data play a critical role in our customers' business operations. As a Reporting Analyst, you will focus on creating, updating, and refining SQL reports tailored to our customer environments. Additionally, you'll utilise Power BI to develop dynamic queries and visually engaging dashboards that provide insightful decision-making for both our organisation and clients




Your role is not only technical but integral in understanding how customers utilise scheduling software. Your expertise in SQL scripting, software report writing, and Power BI utilisation will empower our organisation and clients to make data-driven decisions. You'll be instrumental in crafting informative, visually engaging reports and dashboards using SSRS, Power BI, and SQL.




Your proficiency in software report writing, SQL scripting, and understanding customer software utilisation will be key. Being a self-directed worker is essential, persevering and growing as a technical reporting expert, consistently delivering real value. Your responsibilities encompass creating, refining, and iterating customer-facing reports crucial for key operational decisions. Reporting and timely data are fundamental to our customers' business strategies, making your role indispensable. Your expertise, especially in Power BI, will significantly enhance our customers' experience, enabling them to optimise their operations effectively.




Our culture is extremely important to us, we are looking for an individual who would enjoy working with a talented, friendly and highly collaborative team!




/About us:

We’re a friendly team of experts, optimists, big-thinkers and problem-solvers, and are lucky enough to work with some of the largest and most successful companies in the world. We’ve had an exciting journey so far! Expanding rapidly in response to the success of our products in the market, so we’re on the lookout for more brilliant people to join our team.

myairops is a leader of SaaS products to the aviation industry with customers across the globe with diverse challenges including corporate flight departments, charter brokers, medical providers, military and business aviation operators.




/More about the role:

The Reporting Analyst is part of the Support function, working within our Customer Success Team.




/ Primary Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Report Creation and Design: Build and create a variety of reports in SSRS and Power BI, tailored to customer specifications, ensuring the delivery of meaningful insights.
Data Analysis and Querying: Execute SQL scripts for data analysis, leveraging SQL and SSRS to design and query customer-facing reports, showcasing a keen eye for detail and accuracy.
Documentation and Process Improvement: Create comprehensive documentation and processes, capturing knowledge and lessons learned. Foster a culture of continuous improvement by implementing learnings to prevent recurrence and elevate the customer experience.
Collaboration and Team Focus: Collaborate closely with the wider team to drive continuous improvement initiatives related to reporting and data, leveraging collective expertise for optimal outcomes.
Dynamic Dashboard Creation: Utilise Power BI to create dynamic queries and visually engaging dashboards, aligned with customer requirements, to facilitate insightful decision-making.
Problem Solving and Communication: Tackle data query challenges with tenacity and precision, while confidently communicating with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Customer Value and Relationship Building: Design reports and dashboards with a customer-centric approach, ensuring they add real value to our customers and strengthen relationships, both internally and externally.
Continuous Learning and Adaptability: Stay updated with the latest advancements in reporting tools and techniques, adapting swiftly to changes to maintain efficiency and effectiveness




/Skills, Qualifications and Experience required:




/Essential:

Technical Skills: Proficiency in SSRS, Power BI, and SQL for report creation, data analysis, querying, and dashboard design. With demonstrable professional experience in report creation, data analysis, and dashboard design, preferably in a SaaS software development or related environment
Data Visualisation: Strong understanding of data visualisation principles to create meaningful and visually appealing reports and dashboards. Demonstrated success in creating and delivering impactful reports and dashboards that have added value to customers and contributed to business objectives.
Documentation and Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for documenting processes, creating comprehensive reports, and effectively conveying insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience in creating comprehensive documentation, implementing process improvements, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement within a team or organisation
Problem-Solving and Adaptability: Strong problem-solving skills to tackle data query challenges and adapt quickly to changing reporting tools and techniques.
Collaboration and Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively within a team and with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives and enhance reporting capabilities.
Customer-Centric Approach: Ability to understand customer requirements and design reports and dashboards that add significant value to our customers and strengthen relationships. Experience working collaboratively with diverse teams and a strong focus on meeting customer needs and expectations through reporting and data analysis.




/Advantageous:

Proficiency in Power BI for querying and dashboard design
Evidence of continuous improvement activities, setting and documenting of best practice standards.
Ability to Utilise Power BI to create dynamic queries and visually engaging dashboards, aligned with customer requirements, to facilitate insightful decision-making




/Location

We're based in Farnborough, Hampshire working on a hybrid schedule of 3 days a week in office, 2 days working from home.




/Benefits include:

Competitive Salary
Group Pension Scheme – up to 5% contributions matched
Life Assurance
Income Protection
Travel Insurance
Private Healthcare (after probation)
Discounts at popular retailers




Due to the volume of applications received, only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 20 working days then your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Murphy is recruiting for a Data Analyst delivering major water infrastructure projects in partnership with multiple clients across the UK.

We provide end-to-end services for major water and sewage companies such as Thames Water, Severn Trent Water, Northern Ireland Water, Yorkshire Water and United Utilities, and for several water-only companies including SES Water, Bristol Water and South East Water.

We also provide a full design, build, operate and maintain service for Uisce Éireann and we currently operate over 25 of their facilities, ensuring they run efficiently and comply fully with EPA regulations.

A day in the life of a Murphy Data Analyst:


Working closely with business reporting stakeholders to understanding reporting and analytical requirements to acquire and present relevant datasets.
Handle large and complex datasets from Primavera P6, SAP SuccessFactors and other key construction centric systems.
Verify the integrity of extracted data.
Awareness of, and support embedding and applying revised Data Governance and Information Security standards and best practices.
Applying Murphy best practices to code management, documentation and release.
Help establish good working practices for the work delivered.
Working as part of the Planning and Project Controls Function, alongside the Resource Management Team.
Project work to be allocated as required, during the duration of the project.
Liaising with planners, operational staff and other technical staff.
Assisting with the designing of maintenance procedures and putting them into operation.
Providing user training, support and feedback as required.
Build effective relationships with all relevant stakeholders.
Provide support and guidance to other team members.
Attend sites to assist remote application users as required.
Ad hoc activities as deemed appropriate by the Head of Planning.
Design and develop applications and workflows using POwer apps and Power Automate to streamline and automate business data processes.
Debugging, testing and troubleshooting systems and applications


Still interested, does this sound like you?


Detailed knowledge and practical experience with Primavera P6 and PowerBI, Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse
Experienced with connecting disparate data sources, particularly: Dataverse, Sharepoint, P6
Write and maintain python scripts for data processing, backend logic, API integration and workflow automation
Integrate python processes with Power Platforms solutions
Demonstrable experience with Visual Studio and Azure DevOps toolsets.
Working knowledge of ETL and data ingestion (API knowledge).
Solutions architecture
Understanding of relational databases and data modelling
Experience within construction and/or civil engineering processes and applications.
Happy to travel nationwide across multitude of Murphy projects


What’s in it for you?


27 days holiday, plus bank holidays with the option to buy an additional 2 days holiday each year, holidays increase with length of service
Discretionary annual bonus and annual salary review
Above market rate contributory pension scheme
Life assurance, health screening and enhanced sick pay
Enhanced maternity and paternity pay and a maternity returners bonus
Extra weeks holiday for all employees getting married and a wedding bonus
Subsidised canteen facilities in core locations
Dedicated and continued investment in your professional development
Other Murphy benefits include retail discounts and cashback, discounted gym memberships, cycle to work scheme etc

Murphy is formally recognised as a sector leading employer, Platinum Investors In People accredited along with reported operating profit up 57% on prior year. At Murphy, we are incredibly proud of our diverse workforce. Not only do our people represent over 60 different nationalities, but they also represent a wide range of backgrounds, ethnicities and ages. With a forward order book of £5.8bn and £23m Invested in environmentally friendly plant in 2024 there really is #MoretoMurphy

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
At TUI, we're looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to support the development and delivery of business intelligence solutions by gathering requirements, building reports and dashboards, and analyzing data from multiple sources, within the context of TUI's data transformation journey, so that business users across Markets & Airlines can access timely, accurate, and actionable insights to drive commercial decisions and improve business performance.

About Our Offer


Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.
Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.


About The Job


You'll work in close partnership with Business and Technical teams to analyze, design, and co-create new data products, visualizations, and reporting solutions that are standardized, scalable, and robust to support consistent insight delivery across the business.
You'll develop and maintain Tableau dashboards and reports that meet business requirements and adhere to TUI's design standards and best practices, ensuring standardized metrics and dimensions are used correctly and universally.
You'll write efficient queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from various source systems to support reporting needs across multiple markets.
You'll test and validate data accuracy in reports and dashboards, ensuring quality and consistency across reporting solutions that impact business decisions.
You'll support business users with report interpretation, providing training and guidance on how to effectively use BI tools and dashboards.
You'll collaborate with Data Engineers and Senior Business Intelligence Analysts to understand data structures and implement reporting solutions that align with the overall data architecture.
You'll identify, document and resolve issues with data quality or reporting functionality, proposing solutions and working with the team to implement improvements as part of continuous enhancement initiatives.


About You


You have a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Business Analytics, or equivalent experience in data analytics or business intelligence.
You're proficient in SQL with the ability to write and optimize queries for data extraction and analysis.
You have experience with visualization tools, particularly Tableau, including dashboard creation and report development.
You understand data warehouse concepts and dimensional modelling principles.
You can translate business requirements into technical specifications that meet user needs.
You have analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
You communicate effectively, explaining technical concepts to non-technical users across various business functions.
Knowledge of additional BI tools beyond Tableau and experience with data visualization best practices would be beneficial.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), version control systems, and data governance principles would be advantageous.
You work collaboratively in team environments, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.


From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
The Data Analytics Engineer role sits within the Technology Team at easyJet Holidays, reporting into the Senior Data Analytics Manager. This team works alongside Data Engineering and Data Science to build the analytical pipelines and visualisations that help the wider business make sense of its data. As new products roll out quickly, the team keeps analytical data available and fit for purpose.

In this role, you'll build visualisations and data pipelines that give people across the business access to the data they need. You'll also work closely with stakeholders, turning their goals into practical data products.

You Will Be Responsible For

> Building and maintaining Liveboards and AI Agents using Thoughtspot and Redshift, turning business requirements into clear, accurate visualisations

> Developing Python and SQL based data pipelines within the Dagster and AWS ecosystem, documenting and testing data models through dbt

> Contributing to the DataOps framework and tooling, improving patterns where you can

> Making sure governance and compliance across the data estate meets regulatory requirements

> Mentoring and coaching other Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers and Data Scientists, including supplier based team members

> Carrying out ad hoc analysis and model development as needed

> Working with stakeholders across the business to find new ways to use data, while helping the wider data community build their skills

What You'll Bring To The Team

> A mix of experience across data analysis and data engineering, with a strong grasp of SQL and Python development including Git

> Experience with visualisation and analytics tools such as Thoughtspot, Tableau or Power BI

> Experience setting up and developing ETL/ELT tooling such as Dagster, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Airflow or dbt

> Experience with AWS based data tooling, ideally with some exposure to GCP too

> A logical, methodical approach to problem solving, backed by a strong numerical and analytical background

> A track record of managing complex technical data teams across a variety of disciplines and objectives

> Comfort working with stakeholders to understand their goals and translate them into data products

> The ability to explain complex concepts simply and think laterally about the impact of change

> A high level of attention to detail and the confidence to deliver under pressure

> Comfort working with and influencing a wide range of people

What’s In It For You

In addition to your competitive base salary, we offer an all-inclusive benefits package which includes our company-wide bonus scheme, 7% pension contribution, and private medical insurance. We offer a variety of share options and life assurance, and we have an impressive range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to your needs.

You'll have access to heavily discounted flights for yourself and your loved ones, as well as free easyJet Plus membership, annual holiday vouchers, and a generous annual leave entitlement.

The role is full-time and based at our easyJet holidays HQ near Luton Airport. We operate a hybrid working model of 3 days per week in the office.

How To Apply

Please click on the apply button to complete your application. Occasionally we receive a large volume of applications for our roles and when that happens, we sometimes bring the closing date forward - so please apply promptly to avoid disappointment.

At easyJet, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the diverse customers we serve across Europe. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. If you require specific adjustments or support during the application or recruitment process, such as extra time for assessments or accessible interview locations, please contact us at ma.recruitment@easyjet.com. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to ensure accessibility and accommodation

At British Gas, our mission is to sell it and mend it.

We’ve been powering the UK’s homes and businesses for over 200 years – but supplying energy is just part of what we do. We’re making the UK greener and more energy efficient, getting closer to Net Zero. By using clever tech like thermostats, heat pumps, solar panels and EV chargers, we’re making it cheaper and easier for our customers to reduce their carbon-footprint.

We have a great opportunity for a Portfolio Analyst to play a key role in the Read Journey and Settlement Management Team, providing cross-functional support and expertise to help deliver our obligations under the Balancing and Settlement Code.

Ensuring energy costs across our Business portfolio are accurate and reflect customers’ actual consumption.
Building, maintaining and managing effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Reviewing and resolving electricity industry data exceptions across multiple internal and external processes to allow correct Settlement of consumption from MPAN to MPID level and everything inbetween.
Aligning data across internal systems, industry systems and third parties.
Correcting issues with third-party agent appointments and responding to their enquiries relating to industry data and data quality issues.
Analysing data sets to identify root causes, driving process improvements and implementing appropriate resolutions.
Collaborating with stakeholders and programme developers to deliver a successful migration into Marketwide Half Hourly Settlement.
Supporting delivery of Industry Change Management.
Working with MOPs and DCs to facilitate Engineer or Data Retriever site visits.
Reviewing industry and internal read rejections to identify causation whilst fixing and releasing to DCs.
Validating instances of suspect settlement consumption values and resolving any inaccuracies.
Supporting offshore teams to maximise performance by implementing appropriate controls, governance and quality frameworks.

A proactive, solution-focused mindset with strong analytical and investigation skills.
High levels of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
A collaborative, one-team mindset.
The ability to manage challenging situations with professionalism and resilience.
Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills.

Basic understanding of the UK electricity market.
A basic understanding of electricity data flows and industry processes.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Job Description

Salary Range £53,000 - £65,000

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Your impact

Are you passionate about turning complex data into powerful business decisions? Join our team and help shape the future of data-driven decision-making by delivering advanced analytics, predictive modelling, and business intelligence solutions that influence strategic and operational outcomes across the organisation. This role offers the opportunity to work with diverse stakeholders, modern analytics technologies, and large-scale datasets to unlock valuable insights and drive measurable business impact.

What You Will Do As a Data Scientist

You will play a key role in transforming data into actionable intelligence, helping the business identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and make informed decisions.

Key responsibilities include


Developing and implementing predictive models and machine learning algorithms to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Analysing large volumes of structured and unstructured data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Validating, monitoring, and optimising analytical models to ensure accuracy, reliability, and business value.
Collaborating with stakeholders across product, operations, technology, and business functions to shape and deliver data-driven solutions.
Designing, building, and maintaining interactive dashboards and automated reporting solutions.
Extracting, transforming, and integrating data from multiple sources while ensuring data quality and integrity.
Translating business challenges into analytical approaches, selecting the appropriate methodologies, tools, and techniques.
Delivering descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analysis to support management and business decision-making.
Applying data science and analytics best practices, including documentation, governance, and reproducibility.
