Title: Financial Data Analyst
Description:
Role Summary


Responsibilities: Be the data-driven partner the Finance team relies on. Translate business needs into analytics, deliver Power BI dashboards, and define meaningful KPIs across functions to inform decisions
Salary: £40,000 to £45,000 per annum (please note that we have established salary bands that are determined by your level of educational attainment to ensure a fair and consistent approach for all applicants, eliminating the need for individual negotiations)
Benefits: Discretionary profit share bonuses paid twice per year, hybrid and flexible working options, generous holiday allowance, private medical insurance, critical illness cover, income protection, full funding for external training, and more
Role Type: Full-time, permanent role
Start Date: The role will ideally commence in September or October 2026, and you will be asked to state your availability on your application form
Application Deadlines: The application deadline for this role is August 3rd, 2026
Location: This role is available in our Global Headquarters in Cambridge


About The Role

We are looking for a curious, commercially minded Data Analyst to join our Finance and Operations team and play a key role in how data drives decision-making across the business.

This is more than a reporting role. It's an opportunity to influence strategy, improve performance, and build scalable data solutions that senior leaders rely on.

Key responsibilities:


Analyse financial and operational performance to identify trends, risks and opportunities
Define, track and evolve KPIs and key financial metrics
Communicate insights clearly through strong data story telling
Design and Deliver engaging Power BI dashboards and reports to support business decisions
Support forecasting, budgeting and scenario modelling through robust, data-led insights


You will combine strong analytical thinking with hands-on technical expertise, working across tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL (where relevant) and programming languages like Python or VBA. This includes:


Using advanced Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, automation and scripting to streamline data processes
Applying programming skills to automate workflows, deepen analysis and enhance reporting capabilities
Building scalable data models and continuously improving processes through automation and optimisation


Working closely with Finance and the People team, you'll help transform how data is used to plan, forecast and drive performance across the organisation. A core part of the role will involve:


Bringing together data from multiple systems, including from multiple systems, including data via APIs across different ERP platforms
Creating a single, reliable source of truth to enable consistent and scalable reporting
Driving improvements in governance and automation


You'll also have the opportunity to explore emerging technologies, including agentic AI, using intelligent automation and AI-driven workflows to further enhance insight and efficiency.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across the full data lifecycle and is confident both technically and commercially, from extracting and modelling data through to delivering clear, impactful insights.

About Costello Medical

Costello Medical has grown organically since our foundation in 2008 to become one of the most established independently owned agencies delivering medical communications and health economic services. We work with a wide range of clients, including the industry's most successful pharmaceutical and medical technology companies, patient and public health bodies, and charitable organisations. We have been listed in the Top 100 Best Companies to Work For list since 2017, the Boston Globe's Top Places to Work list in 2025 and were proud to receive B Corporation accreditation in 2022. Learn more about us, our work, and our mission on our website: https://www.costellomedical.com/

Requirements

About You

Essential requirements for the role are:


Degree in a quantitative field (minimum 2:1 or equivalent). We welcome applications from a diverse range of specialisms, including but not limited to; Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Data Science, Data Analytics
A minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in data analytics work in a finance context
Strong Power BI skills, including building and maintaining dashboards/reports
Solid finance/FP&A knowledge, including the ability to define and track KPIs and financial metrics
Data cleaning, validation, and quality assurance with a focus on data accuracy and reliability
Understanding of data governance, security, and privacy best practices
Excellent communication and data storytelling, including the ability to be able to present insights to both finance and non-finance audiences
Proven cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management
Ability to document data sources, transformations, methodologies, and dashboards; maintain data lineage
Strong time management, prioritisation, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment


Desired requirements for the role are:


Experience with a coding tool (e.g Python) for advanced analyses or familiarity with statistical methods
Proficient SQL for data extraction, joining sources and shaping datasets
Advanced Excel skills (Power Query, Power Pivot)
FP&A experience, including budgeting, forecasting, scenario modelling
Experience designing robust data models (star/snowflake schemas) and scalable analytics solutions
Ability to automate/report scheduling and improve dashboard delivery processes
Familiarity with data storytelling frameworks and dashboard usability improvement
Experience within the ‘'big 4'' professional services networks


Benefits

What We Offer

Alongside our award-winning company culture, where every team member is celebrated, respected, and has their voice heard, we are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:


A starting salary of £40,000 to £45,000 per annum, depending on your previous experience, as well as a discretionary profit share bonus paid twice per year. Please note that we have established salary bands to ensure a fair and consistent approach for all applicants, eliminating the need for individual negotiations
25 days' annual leave plus bank and public holidays, as well as a holiday buy and sell scheme
Flexible working hours and the chance to work from home for up to half of your working time after passing probation
Flexible benefits scheme offering cash payments, additional pension contributions and more
Private Medical Insurance which offers comprehensive cover on a "medical history disregard" basis
Paid study leave and funding for external qualifications
Critical Illness Cover, Income Protection and Life Assurance
Paid and unpaid sabbaticals based on length of service


Learn more about our full reward package and the other benefits of working for Costello Medical: https://www.costellomedical.com/careers/working-at-costello-medical/benefits-package-in-china/

Hybrid Working Policy: We believe that having face-to-face time in the office holds many benefits and is central to ensuring that the community we have created, where people have a workplace they belong to and feel part of, is never lost. At the same time, we recognise that homeworking can improve work life balance, reduce commuting times and costs, and provide the opportunity to juggle personal commitments.

Therefore, we offer flexible working arrangements that allow our colleagues who have passed probation to work from home up to half their time, measured across a 2-week rolling period. During your probationary period (normally the first 6 months of the role), you will be able to work from home 1 day per week.

The Application Process

You are required to submit your CV and a cover letter via our online application form. In your cover letter, you must explain why you think you would be suited to the role and why you would like to join Costello Medical, with examples to support both. Your CV should clearly state the dates of all qualifications and grades achieved where applicable.

Then, our recruitment process includes a telephone interview, and a technical assessment for you to complete in your own time. If successful, you will be invited to an on-site interview.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce and, throughout the recruitment process, there are a number of reasonable adjustments we can provide: https://www.costellomedical.com/reasonable-adjustments/

Please note that, whilst we embrace AI to innovate and improve processes, your role may involve working with confidential data that cannot be uploaded to AI. Therefore, it is important for us to assess your own skills and abilities, so we recommend that you do not rely solely on this technology to generate any application materials.

Visa Sponsorship

Dependant on the salary you are offered and due to the Skilled Worker visa regulations, you will only be eligible for visa sponsorship if you meet at least one of the following criteria:


You are classified as a New Entrant, which includes applicants who are under the age of 26, currently studying in the UK or a recent graduate in the UK, amongst other qualifying criteria. Please read more about the New Entrant criteria: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/skilled-worker-visa-caseworker-guidance/skilled-worker-caseworker-guidance-accessible#bookmark63
You have a PhD in a subject that is relevant to the Financial Data Analyst role
You obtained your first Skilled Worker visa in the UK prior to 4th April 2024 and have continuously held a Skilled Worker visa since then (i.e., you will be switching employer)


You will be asked to provide details of your right to work in the UK within your application, which will be used to help assess your eligibility for visa sponsorship.

Please check the following link to read more about the criteria on the UK government website: https://www.gov.uk/skilled-worker-visa/when-you-can-be-paid-less. Please contact recruitment@costellomedical.com should you have any questions.

We're looking for a Service Operations Administrator to join our Service Desk team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong Excel and reporting skills who enjoys working with data, producing insightful analytics and identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

In this role, you'll be responsible for managing warranty claims, analysing service costs, developing reporting and dashboards, and providing valuable business insight through accurate data analysis and continuous improvement.

Managing the end-to-end LLU and Parts Warranty process for Annodata and Kyocera/MCL, including associated reporting
Producing, maintaining and developing service cost analytics, dashboards and management information
Using Excel, Power BI and other reporting tools to provide meaningful insight that supports business decision-making
Proactively identifying anomalies within Vale and other ITSM platforms, working with colleagues across the business to investigate and resolve issues
Supporting the administration and maintenance of tools, knowledge bases and customer documentation used for service cost analysis
Working closely with the Finance team to meet reporting deadlines and ensure financial clarity
Liaising with Field Engineers, Team Leaders and Regional Service Managers to support warranty information retrieval
Highlighting trends, errors and opportunities for improvement across service operations
Supporting warranty claims management and driving continuous improvement initiatives
Undertaking additional duties as required to support the wider Service Desk function

Advanced Excel skills, including experience working with large datasets, analysis and reporting
Experience producing dashboards and management information
Familiarity with Power BI or similar analytical and visualisation tools
Good knowledge of Vale would be advantageous
Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
The ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively under pressure
Confidence communicating technical, service and commercial information to different audiences
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills

You'll be someone who enjoys taking ownership, working collaboratively and finding better ways of doing things. You'll be naturally curious, proactive in identifying issues and passionate about using data to improve operational performance.

Building collaborative relationships
Taking responsibility and ownership
Supporting business goals and objectives
Acting as an ambassador for controls, processes and operational excellence

Pension Scheme
Employee Assistance Programme
Coaching and Mentoring
EyeCare - Access to money off for glasses and sight test

Eligibility for Costco Membership

We are Fyffes, one of the world's leading tropical produce companies. For more than 130 years, we have sourced, shipped and delivered high-quality fresh produce globally. With over 4,000 employees and a strong international network of growers and suppliers, we are committed to shaping wellbeing for the world through sustainable growth, innovation and strong partnerships.

Now we're looking for a Demand Analyst Citrus UK to join our team, turning UK citrus demand into accurate forecasts, insight and planning support.

Here's What You Will Do

Support the commercial team by analysing UK citrus demand and translating orders, forecast trends, promotional activity, seasonality and market dynamics into actionable planning insight. Your work will support service, availability, waste reduction and weekly and seasonal planning.

Analyse UK citrus demand using orders, historical sales, promotions, seasonality, weather impacts and market trends.

Produce demand, forecast, order and service reporting covering accuracy, bias, fill rate, availability, waste and key service drivers.
Support demand reviews, updates and planning inputs, providing clear insight for internal alignment.

Title: Lead Game Analyst - Old School RuneScape
Description:
Office location: Cambridge, UK - This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. However, applicants should be based (or willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.

Are you a data-driven leader who wants to transform player behaviour into meaningful insights that shape the future of one of the world's most iconic MMORPGs?

As Lead Analyst on Old School RuneScape, you'll lead a team of analysts responsible for uncovering the insights that drive better player experiences, smarter product decisions, and long-term business success. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and senior leadership, you'll help shape the roadmap of Old School RuneScape by turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

This is a highly influential role where you'll combine technical expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to ensure data sits at the heart of decision-making across one of gaming's most successful live service titles.

What you'll be doing:


Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Analysts, fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and analytical excellence.
Build strong relationships with Old School RuneScape teams to develop a deep understanding of product strategy, player needs, and business priorities.
Deliver insights and business intelligence that directly influence product strategy, feature development, and roadmap planning.
Transform complex datasets into clear recommendations that support better decision-making across Product, Design, and Leadership.
Query, analyse, and interpret large datasets to uncover opportunities to improve player engagement, retention, and overall game experience.
Partner closely with Engineering and Design teams to develop and enhance game telemetry and data collection.
Collaborate with central Data teams to define data requirements and contribute to the evolution of shared data products.
Develop deep knowledge of Old School RuneScape's gameplay systems, mechanics, and player behaviours to provide meaningful context to analysis.
Champion data-driven thinking across the game team and promote best practices in analytics and reporting.


What we're looking for:


Experience leading or mentoring analysts within an analytics, business intelligence, or data-focused environment.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data cleansing techniques.
A demonstrable understanding of video game player behaviours, particularly in MMORPGs.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures such as AWS, Snowflake, and OLAP technologies.
Experience using data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence decision-making across multiple disciplines.


What we offer:

When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks & Benefits package including:


Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
Employee Assistance Programme & onsite Counselling.
Life Insurance.
Discretionary annual performance bonus.
Enhanced family leave policies from day 1.
Flexible working hours.
25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more!

Description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows.

Title: AI Analytics Specialist
Description:
About Tripadvisor

We believe that we are better together, and at Tripadvisor we welcome you for who you are. Our workplace is for everyone, as is our people powered platform. At Tripadvisor, we want you to bring your unique perspective and experiences, so we can collectively revolutionize travel and together find the good out there.

Tripadvisor is the world’s largest online travel site, visited by 390 million travellers each month, and our Experiences business, Viator, is a fast-evolving and highly data-driven part of the organisation.

At Viator, data is at the heart of how we build great products. We use it to understand our customers, improve decision-making, and drive measurable business impact.

About The Role

The Analytics & ML Marketing team is looking for an AI Analytics Specialist who is, at their core, a data analyst — and who is genuinely obsessed with how AI can change the way companies work with data. Not someone who has read about it, but someone who has been building with it, has opinions on it, and is energized by the idea of applying it at scale inside a real organization.

This role sits at the crossroads of analytical craft, AI fluency, and organizational change. You will not be expected to build every piece of the puzzle alone — but you will be the person who understands how the pieces fit, defines what needs to exist, drives it forward with engineers and data teams, and makes sure the whole organization can actually use it. You will diagnose real pain points, shape the right solutions, and bring both technical and non-technical colleagues along for the transformation.

What You'll Do


Diagnose and fix real friction. Talk to marketing colleagues across performance, CRM, personalization, and incentives. Understand where data access is slow, where workflows are overcomplicated, and where decisions get made without the right information — then define and drive solutions that fix those problems at the root, not the surface.
Make data conversational. Champion and help deploy AI-powered interfaces — natural language querying, automated insight summaries, smart alerting — so that any marketing colleague can interrogate data directly, without writing SQL or raising a ticket.
Shape the semantic layer. Work with data and engineering teams to ensure our metrics are canonically defined, consistently named, and structured in a way that makes self-service reliable and AI tools trustworthy. You will not build it alone — but you will own the vision and drive the standards.
Define agentic workflow opportunities. Identify where agentic analytics systems — pipelines that monitor performance, surface anomalies, and trigger proactive insight — would unlock the most value, and work with the right teams to bring them to life.
Automate what should not need a human. Spot recurring analytical workflows — weekly reports, campaign snapshots, performance reviews — and push to replace manual effort with automated, AI-assisted pipelines through prompt engineering and workflow design.
Build org-wide data literacy. Create the tools, training, and shared frameworks that genuinely shift how the marketing organization works with data — making AI tools and self-service analytics accessible to everyone, not just analysts.


Skills & Experience


A strong analyst first — SQL, data modeling, and structured thinking are your foundation, not just a line on your CV
Genuinely excited about AI: you have been building with it, have explored agentic workflows and conversational analytics tools, and have clear views on where it creates real value versus noise
You see a broken workflow and think about how to fix it — you are drawn to real pain points and you know the difference between solving something and patching it
As comfortable running a data literacy workshop for a marketing team as discussing semantic layer design with a data engineer — you move fluently between both worlds
Structured, self-directed, and delivery-oriented — you bring rigor to an enablement program the same way an engineer brings it to code
Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field required; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent practical experience considered.


Required


3-5 years in analytics or data science, ideally in travel, ecommerce, or a marketplace environment
Strong SQL and hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics tooling (Looker, Tableau, Hex, dbt, or similar)
Proven ability to make analytical complexity accessible and actionable for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Track record of driving adoption of new tools or analytical ways of working across teams
Active, hands-on experience with AI tools — prompt engineering, LLM-powered workflows, or conversational analytics — applied to real problems


Nice to Have


Exposure to agentic analytics concepts or tools, and a view on where they create practical value
Familiarity with semantic layer concepts and tooling (dbt metrics, Cube, LookML, or equivalent)
Understanding of marketing analytics: attribution, funnel analysis, segmentation, and campaign measurement
Python for lightweight automation or tooling
Background in data literacy programs, analytics enablement, or internal CoE initiatives


What Makes This Role Different

Traditional analytics roles are built around depth — owning a domain, producing analysis, answering questions well. This role is built around breadth and leverage: how do you make the whole organization better at using data, not just the analytics team?

AI Analytics Specialist


Makes data questions answerable by anyone
Owns the capability that powers many domains
Redesigns them around AI and self-service
Builds data literacy so colleagues find their own answers
Designs agentic workflows that run end to end
Brings technical and non-technical teams through the change together
Fluent across the AI analytics landscape — semantic layer, conversational tools, automation
Proactively identifies where AI creates the most leverage
Success = decision made faster, without waiting for an analyst


Traditional analytics


Answers data questions
Owns a dashboard or domain
Works with existing workflows
Communicates findings
Automates individual reports
Translates data for stakeholders
Depth in one tool or stack
Reactive to requests
Success = insight delivered


What We Offer


Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.


Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Title: Pathology System Support Analyst
Company: Milton Keynes University Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
Description:
Department: Pathology

Band 5, £32,073 - £39,043 per annum, pro rata

Hours: Fixed Term, Full time, 37.5 per week until 31 Mar 2027 , all MKUH roles will be considered for flexible working

A new opportunity has become available in MKUH Pathology services, we are seeking an engaging and enthusiastic individual to provide IT analytical data support within the pathology systems team working in collaboration across the South Four (S4) network.

'We care We communicate We collaborate We contribute'

Please note: We are unable to offer sponsorship for this role.

Interview date: 17 August 2026

This is a fixed term position to support the additional Pathology IT projects for FY 26/27

The pathology laboratory operates collaboratively as part of the South 4 Pathology Partnership comprising of Oxford University Hospitals, Buckinghamshire hospitals, Milton Keynes University hospital and Great Western Hospitals, a large network employing over 1000 staff generating over 34 million tests per year.

Networking collaboratively with colleagues to improve quality, efficiency and consistency across the network is a key priority for the post holder.

The post holder will: -

Ensure data processing and reporting is performed in a timely and accurate manner and status is reported to relevant stakeholders

To actively seek performance improvements and work with the team in developing and implementing new business intelligence designs in current and future developments

To ensure the successful implementation of the Milton Keynes PCN hubs and their connection to ICE

Milton Keynes University Hospital, in proud partnership with the University of Buckingham, is a University Teaching Hospital committed to advancing patient care through cutting-edge research and education. With a “Good” rating from the CQC and significant investment underway, this is an exciting time to join our team and grow your career.

As a medium sized general hospital, we provide a full range of general medical and surgical services, including a busy Emergency Department, Maternity, and Paediatrics. As the population of our city and surrounding areas continues to grow rapidly, we are expanding and enhancing our facilities to meet rising demand and improve access to care for all our communities.

We are also proud to offer a growing portfolio of specialist services. In January 2025 we opened our state-of-the-art Radiotherapy Centre, bringing advanced cancer treatment closer to home. Our services also include neonatology, specialist surgical care, and a wide range of diagnostics, supported by the new Community Diagnostic Centre at Whitehouse Health Centre. We have just opened the Oak Wards - a new ward block featuring two 24-bed wards.

Further investment is underway, including the recently approved Women and Children’s Centre, set to open by 2030.

Title: Ancillaries Performance Specialist
Description:
As our Ancillaries Performance Specialist, you'll be the data backbone of TUI Airline's ancillary business, transforming raw data into clear, actionable insights that drive commercial growth across our global operations.

About Our Offer


Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams
Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.


About The Job


You'll lead the reporting and analysis of ancillary product performance across all channels and touchpoints, using data to support decision-making and commercial strategy.
You'll develop and maintain dashboards and automated reporting tools to monitor key metrics such as revenue, conversion, customer uptake and margin.
You'll provide data-driven recommendations to improve product packaging, pricing, sales tactics and customer experience across our ancillary portfolio.
You'll conduct deep-dive analyses to uncover patterns in customer behaviour, identify areas of underperformance and support future product development.
You'll work closely with digital, commercial, and finance teams to align on KPIs and performance definitions, ensuring consistent use of data across the business.
You'll continuously improve our reporting environment by implementing process automation, visualization improvements and data structure enhancements.


About You


You have proven experience in a data or performance analyst role, ideally within a commercial, airline or travel context.
You possess strong technical skills in Excel, SQL and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
You have the ability to turn complex data into actionable insight, with a clear focus on commercial impact and usability.
You're familiar with e-commerce, digital platforms and customer behaviour analytics.
You have excellent attention to detail and data accuracy with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and improvement.
You're a strong communicator, confident in presenting findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You're self-motivated, organised and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

SECURITY STATEMENT

At TUI, safety is our top priority. We conduct thorough background checks on all employees who join our Airline. Rest assured; we’ll guide you on the necessary information you need to provide at each stage.

Please note that if you are applying for a role in the UK, you must ensure you can provide a full 5 years referencing, plus a criminal record check for all countries you’ve resided in for more than 6 months in the past 5 years (some costs may apply).

Title: Data Operations Analyst
Description:
Application Deadline: 21 August 2026

Department: Engineering

Location: London



Description

About UsWe are a fast-growing Series A SaaS startup at the forefront of the next big shift in marketing, transforming the way brands connect with audiences in virtual worlds. This is a shift on par with the rise of social media, and we are building the analytics engine to power it. You will be joining a tight-knit, high-impact team of 40 people, including a product team of 3 and an engineering team of 10, meaning your work will directly shape the trajectory of our platform and company.

About the RoleOur platform runs on data, and this role owns the work that keeps it flowing: pulling, validating, importing and quality-checking so the wider team can move quickly and with confidence. Sitting within the product team, you will own the operational data layer: the day-to-day work of getting accurate, trustworthy data into the hands of product, client services and the wider business, fast.

This is a hands-on product & operations role, not an engineering or a pure-analysis one. You are the dependable go-to who unblocks the team's data needs and keeps everything flowing and accurate. You write SQL confidently, lean heavily on AI tools to move quickly, and you are comfortable reading code and data models, but you take your pride from being the person who keeps data reliable and accessible, not from building pipelines or chasing the next engineering project.





Key Responsibilities


Own data access across the product lifecycle: Be the team's first port of call for data requests, pull, shape and deliver data in the format product, CS and sales need.
Validate and quality-check: Sanity-check, validate and QC data across the platform so the team can trust every number. Spot anomalies, chase them down, and keep our data honest.
Manage imports and ingestion ops: Run routine data imports and ingestion tasks, making sure data lands cleanly, completely and on time.
Work AI-first: Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot and similar) to rapidly translate business logic or SQL into complex database queries (including NoSQL / Elastic / Mongo), accelerating repetitive work, and continually improve how the team gets and checks data.
Document and share knowledge: Document data sources, queries and processes so knowledge never sits with just one person. You make the team less dependent on any single individual, including yourself.
Own the long tail: Take ownership of the steady stream of ad hoc requests that keeps the wider team moving.
Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with data engineers and product team, translating between technical data and real business needs.


Skills, Knowledge and Expertise


An operations and service mindset: You take genuine pride in being the reliable go-to who keeps data flowing and accurate. You enjoy solving a team's everyday data needs and you are not looking to use this role as a stepping stone into a pure engineering job.
Data Fluency (SQL & NoSQL): You write and debug SQL confidently, but you are also comfortable navigating non-relational/document databases (like MongoDB and Elasticsearch). You don't need to have raw NoSQL syntax memorized, but you should know how to read nested JSON structures.
AI-first working: You already lean heavily on AI tools to work faster and better, and you are always finding new ways to use them.
Technical literacy: You can read code and data models (including how relational data maps to NoSQL/JSON structures), understand how different systems fit together, and pick up light Python.
Rigour and attention to detail: You are meticulous about data accuracy and quality, and you notice when a number looks off.
Bias for action: You are comfortable in the ambiguity of a Series A startup and happy to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
Clear communicator: You can translate between technical data and business stakeholders without friction.
AI-first working: You already lean heavily on AI tools to work faster and better. Crucially, you possess the critical thinking to audit and validate AI-generated outputs, ensuring code/queries are safe and optimised before running them.
Experience: Around 2–4 years in a data operations, data analyst, BI, revenue/business operations or similar hands-on data role.

Bonus Points
Experience in a data operations, analytics operations or revenue operations function.
Familiarity with the modern data stack and BI tooling.
Background in marketing-related SaaS, virtual environments or gaming.
Familiarity with tools such as Linear and Notion.


Why join us?


Join a business at the forefront of the next big shift in marketing.
Be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, innovative and supportive team.
Be genuinely indispensable, this role unlocks something the whole company depends on, so your impact is visible from day one.
A real, non-engineering growth path: grow into owning our data-quality function, take on ROI and attribution research as the team scales.
25 days holiday as standard, plus a bonus GEEIQ Day to use whenever you choose.
We offer Heka, a monthly wellness allowance you can spend across a wide range of fitness and wellbeing providers, plus a Cycle to Work scheme.
We have a thriving company culture with regular socials, team offsites, and events - quizzes, sports days, Hackathons, Bake Offs, and more. Our eNPS is 52, nearly double the industry average, and it shows, the team genuinely loves working here and learning from each other.

Title: Workforce Management (WFM) Planner
Description:
Job Description

Workforce Management (WFM) Planner

Brighton

Full time - Hybrid 35 hours per week

Salary starting from £35,200 Per annum

We make health happen

The Planning department is an integral part of Operations across our Global portfolio, supporting the function to maintain high quality KPIs and performance standards within budgetary limits.

 

The WFM Planner will be responsible for analysing resource requirements and designing effective scheduling solutions that align with operational goals. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to ensure that plans are not only data-driven but also practical and responsive to the evolving needs of our teams. The holder will monitor performance, carry out analysis of historic data, calculate effects of strategic or procedural changes, forecast work volumes, recommend staffing needs, carry out administrative scheduling activity, identify opportunities to maximise use of resource, provide justification for budget alterations and supply operational performance data.

How You’ll Help Us Make Health Happen


Analyse historical and forecasted data to create and publish short- and long-term resource plans.
Develop and deliver scheduling strategies that support operational performance and service level targets.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to ensure plans meet business needs and reflect how teams work in practice.
Monitor ongoing and operational performance and variance and adjust intra-day schedules to optimise resource utilisation.
Track and report on key metrics including call volumes, handle times, queue times, agent availability, and service level adherence.
Chair regular meetings to review effectiveness of current plan and departmental performance to drive ongoing improved performance and collaboration.
Identify and communicate the impact of external factors on workload volumes.
Escalate system issues and coordinate responses across relevant platforms.
Perform trend analysis to guide strategic decisions and continuous improvement.
Provide clear, actionable insights and updates to operational teams.
Act as a key point of contact for queries related to daily planning and scheduling.
Compare forecasted vs. actual data daily to identify discrepancies.
Communicate actions and updates to affected business areas.


Key Skills/Qualifications Needed For This Role


Extensive familiarity with software applications including: MS Excel
Workforce Management systems (experience with TotalView / NICE IEX preferrable)
Telephony Platforms (experience with Genesys preferrable)
Email Management Platforms (experience with eGain preferrable)
Messaging and Live Chat Platforms (experience with LivePerson preferrable)
Other Workforce Management and telephony systems
Proven experience in resource planning, MI analysis, or workforce management within a customer service or operations environment.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams.
Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable plans.


Benefits


25 days holiday, increasing through length of service, with option to buy or sell
Bupa health insurance as a benefit in kind
An enhanced pension plan and life insurance
Onsite gyms or local discounts where no onsite gym available
Various other benefits and online discounts


Why Bupa

Bupa Global is the international health insurance division of Bupa. We provide customers who want premium international coverage with products and services to access the healthcare they need anytime, around the world, whether at home or when studying, living, travelling or working abroad.

Bupa Global has offices around the world including London and Brighton (UK), Dublin (Europe), Miami (USA), Dubai (UAE, in partnership with OIC), Egypt and Hong Kong (China) as well as regional offices in mainland China, Singapore, the Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Panama, Guatemala and Ecuador.

Full time

Job Area

Administration

Locations:

Victory House, Brighton

Title: Data Operations Officer
Description:
As the Data Operations Officer, your key purpose in post is to ensure efficient, compliant data management, and effective data processes. You will proactively support teams, find improvements, and push for efficiencies to allow Salesforce CRM system users to engage with and effectively manage our supporters. This must be completed with reference to relevant data protection/GDPR laws and within a framework of the most effective data management techniques.




You will play a key role in providing process improvements across teams to enable the further development of an automation programme that speeds up and improves accuracy across imports and exports. You will also be responsible for scoping, defining, and implementing data quality improvements.




Key Responsibilities:




Work with our Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) tool (Clarity Data Transform [CDT]) to bring data into our Salesforce ecosystem. This will include extensive documentation writeup, testing requirements for updates and patches, and a restrained & disciplined approach where quality is more important than speed.
Ensure that any exception files from the CDT automations are triaged and the issues rectified, including escalating issues to the relevant agency, or logging a defect in Jira Software.
Play a supportive role with the development team, completing development work in Salesforce as directed.
Work with the Data Operations Manager to ensure Direct Debit claims and Gift Aid claims are processed accurately and on the agreed schedule.
Carry out more complex data loading processes and act as a point of escalation for issues when raised by the Data Operations Executives.
Critically examine existing processes and drive process improvement across database stakeholders and users.
Support the Data Operations Manager on improvement projects, aimed at both improving the quality of data, and teams’ processes surrounding their use of Salesforce.
Provide second line support for the Data Team ticketing system, ensuring tickets are resolved in a timely manner.
Maintain, enhance, and develop data quality checks and associated processes to improve the integrity and usefulness of our data.
Support the Data Operations Manager in ensuring data management best practice is incorporated into each teams’ processes.
Undertake any other relevant duties and projects in line with the responsibilities of the post.
Other tasks from time to time as identified by the Data Operations Manager




Knowledge, skills and experience needed:

Knowledge of relational databases, CRM systems and/or large datasets.
Knowledge and understanding of ETL tools and practices.
Understanding of data protection/GDPR legislation and its implementation.
Knowledge and understanding of SQL.
Experience of working in the charity sector with charity data.
Experience of using Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
Experience of process improvement and automation.
Experience providing support and training to end users.
Experience using a ticketing system, such as Jira Service Desk.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
A creative, positive, and proactive approach to problem solving.
Logical and process orientated.
Good self-awareness with a willingness to learn new skills.
Excellent internal stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to work to a high standard and with an excellent eye for detail.
Advanced Excel skills.




Additional Information:

Ways of working:

As part of our Agile ways of working you will be required to work approximately 2 days a week from the office, which is subject to the requirements of the role and the business needs. Flexibility on where you work can be split between working from home and our office.

Roles that are classed as part of the Agile ways of working are not able to claim any costs for Mileage/Travel on Public Transport, Accommodation and/or Meals. This includes when attending the office for various meetings/events.




Our Office: Our office is at 3 Riverside, Granta Park, Great Abington, Cambridge, CB21 6AD.

Salary: Circa £32,000 per annum, plus benefits.




Please download the Vacancy Pack on our website for more information.




The closing date for applications is the 9th August 2026, with interviews being arrange once shortlisting has been completed. Please indicate in your covering letter if you are unable to attend an interview on a certain date. We would encourage you to submit your application at the earliest opportunity, as on occasion we may have to bring forward the interview date and/or the closing date based on the needs of the business. Although a possibility, this will only happen in exceptional circumstances. Please indicate in your covering letter if you are unable to attend an interview on a certain date.




We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves and reach their full potential. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, particularly from those in the global majority, those with disabilities, men and those from the LGBTQIA+ community. Any offer of employment is however subject to you having the right to work in the UK.




As part of our commitment to being an inclusive employer and ensuring fairness and consistency in our selection process, we will handle your CV and application with the utmost confidentiality. Should you require any adjustments at either the application or interview stage, please contact us via our website.

Title: Supporter Data & Insights Manager
Description:
Supporter Data & Insight Manager

Location: Remote with monthly travel to Horsham, West Sussex, UK

Salary: £43K per annum

Contract: Permanent, Full-time (35 hours per week)




Join Born Free as their new Supporter Data & Insight Manager and play a pivotal role in helping one of the world's leading wildlife charities make evidence-led fundraising decisions that maximise income, strengthen supporter relationships and ultimately help protect wild animals across the globe.




About Born Free

Born Free is a leading international wildlife charity dedicated to protecting wild animals and ensuring they are treated with compassion and respect. Through conservation, rescuing wild animals from appalling captive conditions, education and campaigning, the charity works around the world to keep wild animals in the wild, protect threatened species and inspire positive action for wildlife.




As fundraising continues to grow, Born Free is investing in its data and insight capability to ensure supporter information drives better decision-making and fundraising performance.




The role

Reporting to the Head of Public Fundraising, you will lead the development and optimisation of Born Free's fundraising CRM, ensuring supporter data is accurate, accessible and used effectively across the organisation.




You will deliver reporting, dashboards and insight that inform fundraising strategy, improve supporter engagement and maximise income, while championing data quality, governance and continuous improvement. Working closely with colleagues across the organisation, you'll provide expert support on Raiser's Edge NXT and help embed an evidence-led approach to fundraising.




Key responsibilities

Lead the ongoing development and optimisation of Raiser's Edge NXT, ensuring it meets the needs of the Fundraising team.
Develop reporting, dashboards and insight to support fundraising strategy and evidence-based decision-making.
Analyse supporter behaviour and campaign performance to identify opportunities to improve acquisition, retention and lifetime value.
Deliver audience segmentation and campaign selections to maximise fundraising effectiveness.
Champion high standards of data quality, governance and GDPR compliance.
Oversee data imports, exports, cleansing, Gift Aid and Direct Debit processing.
Build strong relationships across the organisation and with external suppliers to maximise the value of supporter data and drive continuous improvement.




About you

You are an experienced fundraising data professional with a passion for using insight to improve fundraising performance and supporter engagement. Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, you can turn complex data into clear, actionable insight and build strong relationships across an organisation.




You will have:

Significant experience managing a fundraising CRM, ideally Raiser's Edge NXT.
Experience producing reporting, analysis and insight to inform fundraising strategy.
Strong knowledge of fundraising data management, GDPR and data governance.
Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
A collaborative approach and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Experience of ImportOmatic, Power BI, FastStats, Engaging Networks or similar tools would be advantageous.

As fundraising continues to grow, Born Free is investing in its data and insight capability to ensure supporter information drives better decision-making and fundraising performance.


The role

Reporting to the Head of Public Fundraising, you will lead the development and optimisation of Born Free's fundraising CRM, ensuring supporter data is accurate, accessible and used effectively across the organisation.


You will deliver reporting, dashboards and insight that inform fundraising strategy, improve supporter engagement and maximise income, while championing data quality, governance and continuous improvement. Working closely with colleagues across the organisation, you'll provide expert support on Raiser's Edge NXT and help embed an evidence-led approach to fundraising.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead the ongoing development and optimisation of Raiser's Edge NXT, ensuring it meets the needs of the Fundraising team.
  • Develop reporting, dashboards and insight to support fundraising strategy and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Analyse supporter behaviour and campaign performance to identify opportunities to improve acquisition, retention and lifetime value.
  • Deliver audience segmentation and campaign selections to maximise fundraising effectiveness.
  • Champion high standards of data quality, governance and GDPR compliance.
  • Oversee data imports, exports, cleansing, Gift Aid and Direct Debit processing.
  • Build strong relationships across the organisation and with external suppliers to maximise the value of supporter data and drive continuous improvement.


About you

You are an experienced fundraising data professional with a passion for using insight to improve fundraising performance and supporter engagement. Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, you can turn complex data into clear, actionable insight and build strong relationships across an organisation.


You will have:

  • Significant experience managing a fundraising CRM, ideally Raiser's Edge NXT.
  • Experience producing reporting, analysis and insight to inform fundraising strategy.
  • Strong knowledge of fundraising data management, GDPR and data governance.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
  • Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A collaborative approach and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Experience of ImportOmatic, Power BI, FastStats, Engaging Networks or similar tools would be advantageous.

Title: Insight Analyst
Description:
Location: Milton Keynes – based in office 1-2 days a week (hybrid)

Hours: Full time

Reporting to: Head of People Science

Salary: £33K-£38K

About WorkBuzz

WorkBuzz was founded in 2018, has raised £12.5m funding and has 400 clients, including iconic brands like Five Guys, Butlins and Virgin. Our mission is to lead a new era of employee listening: AI-first, beyond surveys and turning employee voice into competitive advantage.

Our AI-powered platform makes it easy for mid and large-sized companies to gather real-time employee feedback and uncover what truly matters. Our new AI-native product Dialogue launches us into operational listening, putting employee listening in the hands of operational leaders – where decisions are made and change actually happens.

Trusted across industries, we combine smart technology with a human approach - helping leaders make better decisions, faster. We’re growing fast and looking for mission-driven people to join us!

The Role

We're looking for a tech-savvy, AI-forward Analyst to join our People Science team, turning WorkBuzz employee listening data into clear, accurate and useful insight for clients.

This role is for someone who actively seeks smarter ways to work, freeing up time for the deeper analysis, thinking and storytelling that truly adds value. Working closely with our consultants and guided by the Lead Analyst, the role builds expertise in the WorkBuzz platform, employee listening data and analytical methods, developing towards greater ownership of client and broader business insight work over time.

Key Responsibilities

Turn data into insight at pace


Produce accurate analysis, charts, tables and slides from employee survey results for use in client reports and presentations
Ensure standard outputs including demographic cuts, trend comparisons and summary tables, following established templates and methods, and using automation to increase speed and consistency where possible
Support more advanced analysis, such as driver analysis, segmentation analysis and performance linkage with guidance from the Lead Analyst
Ensure appropriate checks to ensure accuracy of all outputs before they're shared


Support great client delivery


Work with People Science Consultants to understand specific client needs, outputs required and delivery timelines
Ensure report decks are populated with well-formatted, accurate data summaries, flagging interesting patterns or anomalies along the way
Respond to ad-hoc analysis requests quickly and reliably, ensuring consultants are equipped to do their best work
Use and help maintain reusable presentation templates, chart formats and analysis approaches to support consistency across client deliverables.


Support improvements in outcomes and efficiencies


Actively use and champion AI tools to accelerate analysis, charting, summarisation and quality checking
Identify repetitive or manual tasks in the reporting workflow in the development of smarter, automated approaches
Help establish and document AI-assisted methods that the wider team can adopt and build on
Follow, and where possible improve, documented methods, quality checks and analytical assumptions to ensure outputs are accurate and consistent with WorkBuzz standards
Contribute to reusable templates, automated workflows and shared knowledge that make the whole team more effective


Platform knowledge


Build a strong working knowledge of the WorkBuzz platform, including survey setup, data mapping, reporting structures and dashboards
Share feedback, recurring issues and improvement ideas from day-to-day analysis work to help improve reporting and workflows.
Support user testing of new reporting and analysis features when required
Keep up to date with platform releases and new reporting or analysis capabilities, applying them in client work where appropriate


Requirements For Role


Some experience in an analyst, insights, research or data-focused role, or a strong academic background with hands-on data analysis experience from placements, internships or project work
Degree in a relevant subject such as psychology, organisational psychology, business, economics, statistics, data science or adjacent
Solid quantitative analysis skills, comfortable working accurately with survey results, trends, demographic cuts and comparisons
Enthusiasm for AI tools and automation; you’re keen to experiment and find better ways to work
Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude or similar, applied to real analytical or reporting tasks
Strong Excel skills including formulas, pivot tables and charting; strong PowerPoint skills to ensure clear and polished client slides
Genuine attention to detail and a critical eye when reviewing outputs
Clear written communication, ensuring complex findings are summarised simply and accurately
Well organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced, client-focused environment
Awareness of data protection, confidentiality and responsible AI use when handling people data


Desirable


Experience working with employee survey, engagement or HR data and an interest in employee engagement, culture and the employee experience agenda
Experience with BI or data visualisation tools
Some experience of producing client-facing reports, charts or presentation materials

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




Office - 5 days a week in London Bridge

Salary - £50-60k




We're looking for an experienced data analyst with strong technical skills to join a small, fast-moving team building and using cutting-edge data tools in support of real-world investigations. This is a hands-on, embedded role - you'll work directly alongside researchers, translating complex data into actionable insight, while helping shape the tools that power that work.




The role

You'll act as the primary interface between a technical data team and the researchers who depend on it. Day-to-day, that means sourcing, analysing and interpreting data to support live investigations, drawing on an existing knowledge base and toolset, and reaching further when new techniques or datasets are needed.




You'll also train colleagues to get more out of the tools available, identify new datasets and analytical approaches worth integrating, and feed researcher needs back into the technical roadmap.




What you'll bring




Essential

At least three years of experience as an OSINT/ Data analyst (or equivalent intelligence discipline)
Deep, demonstrable knowledge of the publicly available OSINT data landscape (open-source intelligence)
Proficiency in Python for scripting and data processing
Experience within defence or related industries such as Fincrime and an interest in this space too!




Nice to have

Experience with Neo4j or another graph database
Familiarity with PostgreSQL or BigQuery
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI




This is a London office-based role.

Title: Pensions Analyst (Accounts & Member Data)
Description:
Pensions Analyst (Accounts & Member Data)

Location: Crawley | Salary: £37,000 - £42,000 (Depending on experience) plus 7.5% bonus | Contract: Permanent | Closing date: 09/08/2026




Are you an analytical pensions or finance professional who enjoys working with complex data, improving controls and turning information into clear insight? UK Power Networks is looking for a Pensions Analyst to join our in-house pensions team and support the accuracy, validity and reporting of member, scheme and financial data.




Reporting to the Pensions Project Manager within the Human Resources directorate, you will play a key role in preparing pension scheme accounts, producing management information and supporting high-quality reporting across member benefit data. You will work with internal teams and external partners including Finance, HR, Payroll, administrators, actuaries, auditors, custodians and investment managers.




You will help prepare quarterly pension scheme management accounts, analyse and validate member data, support actuarial valuations and accounting disclosures, and identify trends, anomalies and opportunities to improve data quality. You will also contribute to governance, regulatory compliance, audit trails, data controls and continuous improvement activity across reporting and reconciliation processes.




This is a great opportunity to apply your pensions, accounting and data analysis experience in a role where accuracy, insight and collaboration really matter. You will be trusted to investigate data issues, present findings to non-technical stakeholders and support decision-making through clear, reliable reporting.

Permanent role based in Crawley, with blended working available after probation: 3 days in the office and 2 days remote.
Salary £37,000 - £42,000 (depending on experience) plus 7.5% bonus.
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
Personal Pension Plan with UK Power Networks contributions of 8% or 10% depending on your contribution rate.
Access to benefits including Cycle to Work, Home & Tech, Green Car Leasing, discounted gym membership, Employee Assistance Programme and retailer discounts.




You will bring experience from pensions, finance, accounting or a related analytical environment, along with advanced Excel skills and the ability to work confidently with large datasets. Knowledge of SQL-based languages, data validation, reconciliation, reporting tools such as Power BI and pension scheme structures will help you succeed. Experience with DB/DC schemes, SAP, Aviary, Pensions Office, APIs or pension scheme accounting requirements would be beneficial.




If you are methodical, proactive and confident turning complex data into meaningful insight, we would like to hear from you. Apply by 09/08/2026 to join UK Power Networks as a Pensions Analyst and help strengthen the quality, integrity and reporting of our pensions data.

For more information and to view the full job description please click apply!




If you have any queries in connection to this vacancy or your application, please contact us at careers@ukpowernetworks.co.uk quoting the vacancy reference number and a member of the team will get in touch with you as soon as possible.

Data Analyst

Overall Ambition

Nando’s is on a journey to Create Lasting Happiness, making a difference to the lives of our people, our customers, and the communities we work in. Originally started in Johannesburg, South Africa, we pride ourselves on creating memorable experiences for everyone involved in Nando’s: from our employees, communities, founders, and suppliers, but most importantly, our customers.

The Data and Analysis Team

Our Values

At Nando’s, our values guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for each other every day:


Pride – We take pride in everything we do, from the quality of our food to the impact of our work.
Passion – We bring energy, enthusiasm, and a love for what we do.
Courage – We speak up, challenge the status quo, and are not afraid to try new things.
Integrity – We do the right thing, act honestly, and build trust with each other.
Family – We care for and support one another, creating a sense of belonging where everyone can thrive.


What We're Looking For

As a Data Analyst you will work across a wide range of domains from financial and operational data, to kitchen tech and stock, helping our teams make better decisions grounded in sound analysis. In this role you’ll work independently across the full data stack, understanding the ‘why’ behind requests before jumping to the ‘what’, and contributing to the translation of business problems into well-defined, actionable work.
