Your impact

Are you passionate about turning complex data into powerful business decisions? Join our team and help shape the future of data-driven decision-making by delivering advanced analytics, predictive modelling, and business intelligence solutions that influence strategic and operational outcomes across the organisation. This role offers the opportunity to work with diverse stakeholders, modern analytics technologies, and large-scale datasets to unlock valuable insights and drive measurable business impact.

What You Will Do As a Data Scientist

You will play a key role in transforming data into actionable intelligence, helping the business identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and make informed decisions.

Key responsibilities include


Developing and implementing predictive models and machine learning algorithms to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Analysing large volumes of structured and unstructured data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Validating, monitoring, and optimising analytical models to ensure accuracy, reliability, and business value.
Collaborating with stakeholders across product, operations, technology, and business functions to shape and deliver data-driven solutions.
Designing, building, and maintaining interactive dashboards and automated reporting solutions.
Extracting, transforming, and integrating data from multiple sources while ensuring data quality and integrity.
Translating business challenges into analytical approaches, selecting the appropriate methodologies, tools, and techniques.
Delivering descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analysis to support management and business decision-making.
Applying data science and analytics best practices, including documentation, governance, and reproducibility.


What You'll Bring

We're looking for a data professional with strong technical and analytical expertise who can transform complex datasets into meaningful business outcomes.

Essential Skills And Experience


Strong experience using SQL and business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis, statistical modelling, and predictive analytics.
Experience developing, deploying, validating, and maintaining predictive models and machine learning solutions.
Strong understanding of ETL processes, data integration, and data quality management.
Experience working with large, complex structured and unstructured datasets.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques and their application to real-world business problems.
Understanding of data architecture principles and the processes required to support effective data delivery and reporting.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
Experience creating dashboards, self-service reporting, and visualisations that support decision-making.


Desirable


Experience with data governance, model management, and analytics best practices.
Professional certifications in data management, analytics, business intelligence, or related disciplines (e.g. DAMA International or equivalent).


This is an excellent opportunity to use advanced analytics and data science techniques to influence business strategy, improve operational performance, and deliver meaningful outcomes across the organisation.

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit https //careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.


Time to Recharge Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
Secure your Future Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
Your Wellbeing Matters Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
Rewarding Performance All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
Never Stop Learning Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
Refer a friend Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
Tailored Perks Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
Flexible working Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Driver Earnings team at Lyft is responsible for managing our suite of driver earnings products, driving top business goals around financial metrics and marketplace performance. The team develops and improves automation & execution of driver earnings products, develops new earnings products, and manages financial performance of these products to manage the growth of the business.

We are looking for an analyst to join the team that is responsible for working with cross-functional stakeholders to analyze and improve existing earnings products and manage the products’ financial outcomes within the broader Marketplace organization. You will influence existing and future strategy with your data analysis, insights, and storytelling to deliver strategic recommendations on experimentation and product improvements. We’re looking for a data & process-driven individual who has extraordinary attention to detail and a track record of analytical problem-solving.

Responsibilities:


Support marketplace operations to provide world-class analysis, product recommendations, and reporting to stakeholders.
Become an expert in marketplace trends and support weekly reporting structures for the Rideshare organization.
Develop domain-specific subject matter expertise in our lever portfolio and support cross-functional initiatives to improve existing products and develop new ones.
Analyze marketplace product & financial levers and provide cross-functional teams with actionable insights on improvements and problem areas.
Operate within Rideshare decision-making frameworks with a critical lens, evaluating areas of improvement and business growth opportunities.
Prepare regular business reviews for leadership, highlighting key areas of focus.
Work with stakeholders and other teams to track, report, and reconcile budget allocation across marketplace programs.
Analyze data, conduct research and synthesize feedback into plans, processes and playbooks.


Experience:


1-3 years of experience in a high growth environment in data and/or financial analytics.
Very strong attention to detail, experience developing processes to remove human error.
Proficient in SQL and quantitative analysis, you can deep dive into large amounts of data, draw meaningful insights, dissect business issues and draw actionable conclusions.
Outcome-driven approach to developing recommendations and demonstrated ability to develop a story and execution plan to support our goals and objectives.
Exceptional communication (listening, written, and oral) skills with the ability to present findings and recommendations targeted to the audience in question.
A drive to understand the core issues along with the determination to uncover the solution.
Excels at dealing with ambiguity and change management.


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Kelly est à la recherche d’un(e) analyste de données Life Cycle Value pour soutenir un fabricant de moteurs d’avion de premier plan. Description:
Our Ontario client is looking for a Data Analyst to help transform field data into meaningful insights that improve decision-making.

This is a full-time perm position. 5 days/week onsite in Newmarket, ON. You will be getting paid hourly. Overtime (Remote) will be expected and compensated.

Reporting to the Lead Data Analyst, you will be responsible for managing data generated through their proprietary mobile applications, ensuring data quality, developing analytics and reporting tools, and supporting continuous improvements to their data environment.

Responsibilities


Manage, validate, and analyze data collected through the proprietary field reporting platform.
Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for both internal teams and utility clients.
Perform quality assurance on incoming datasets and investigate data inconsistencies or anomalies.
Utilize strong analytical analysis, using excel and other methods (excel capabilities are a requirement).
Maintain and optimize reporting databases, data sources, security, and metadata.
Troubleshoot reporting issues and implement improvements to enhance data quality and reporting performance.
Develop and automate data cleansing, validation, and reporting processes.
Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and clients to understand reporting requirements and implement data solutions.
Prepare data extracts and support integrations with external systems, including GIS and enterprise databases.
Train internal staff and clients on reporting tools and dashboard functionality.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes and improve reporting efficiency.


Must Have


Experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas (e.g., XLOOKUP, TEXTJOIN, COUNTIFS), PivotTables, and VBA.
Experience with SQL and database querying.


Nice To Have


Experience with Python, R, Power BI, or other data analysis and visualization tools
Familiarity with SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments

Job Description:

Changing the World, One Kibble at a Time

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Data Analyst to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food crafter with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. From our humble beginnings, founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry.

Our purpose, To Earn Pet Lover Trust Every Day so Pets Thrive for a Lifetime, provides the foundation for our highest aspirations as a company. Being a partner to the communities that surround us – and the environment that sustains us – are top priorities.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here’s The Scoop - Summary

We are looking for a data-driven, detail-oriented Data Analyst, preferably within the pet food or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry.

In this role, you will support end-to-end supply chain operations by providing actionable insights across multiple functions and serve as the centralized resource for supply chain data and KPI governance.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, cross-functional environment and is passionate about using data to enhance operational efficiency and support Champion Petfoods’ commitment to delivering high-quality nutrition to pets worldwide.

The Supply Chain Analyst works out of our Corporate office in Edmonton (AB) or Nashville (TN) and works a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-person.

Key Responsibilities:


Analyze data across supply chain to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvements
Identify supply chain performance gaps through data analysis, proactively engage with relevant stakeholders to understand root causes, and lead cross-functional efforts to develop and implement innovative solutions.
Develop and maintain real-time dashboards, data objects, and reports that track key supply chain metrics
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align analytics outputs with business needs
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels, enabling data-driven decision-making.
Assist in the deployment and continuous improvement of supply chain analytics tools and technologies


Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Experience in supply chain analytics or data analysis, preferably within the food or pet food industry.
Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Python.
Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Experience with data visualization platforms (preferably Power BI).
Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across teams.
Experience with advanced analytics techniques such as machine learning or predictive modeling preferred.
Experience in Generative AI development preferred.
Familiarity with Databricks preferred.
Understanding of E2E supply chain processes preferred.


What can you expect from Champion?


Safety: A strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.
Earnings: Competitive wages, annual bonus eligibility, 401k/RRSP with company matching.
Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision and employee assistance programs to meet your individual or family needs.
Continuing Education: In house & online learning & development, as well as an education assistance program.
Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.
Other Perks: Free bag of premium pet food each month.


What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of your race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other creed, you are wanted here.

Title: Data Analyst, SMB Self-Serve
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data and analytics are at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to support our Self-Serve segment — the fastest-growing part of Lyft's B2B portfolio, serving small and mid-size businesses across North America. This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, dbt) is a plus
Comfortable using AI coding and analytics tools — LLM assistants, agentic SQL/analysis workflows — to accelerate extraction, exploration, and reporting, while reviewing and validating every query, result, and insight before it reaches stakeholders; you own the correctness of the output, not the tool
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data and analytics are at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to support our Self-Serve segment — the fastest-growing part of Lyft's B2B portfolio, serving small and mid-size businesses across North America. This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
  • Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health
  • Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
  • Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
  • Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
  • Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
  • Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences

Experience:

  • Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
  • 3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
  • Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
  • Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
  • Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar
  • Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, dbt) is a plus
  • Comfortable using AI coding and analytics tools — LLM assistants, agentic SQL/analysis workflows — to accelerate extraction, exploration, and reporting, while reviewing and validating every query, result, and insight before it reaches stakeholders; you own the correctness of the output, not the tool
  • A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
  • A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
  • Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion

Benefits:

  • Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Child care and pet benefits
  • Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
  • RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
  • In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
  • Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
  • Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Serving the needs of all families with young children, Carter’s Inc. is the largest North American apparel retailer exclusively for babies and young children, encompassing Carter’s, OshKosh B’gosh, Skip*Hop and Little Planet brands. Meaningful work, constant learning, genuine people, and a community guided by core values that promote inclusion and innovation is in everything we do. There are many reasons to build your career at Carter's.

How You’ll Make An Impact

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst to support better and efficient decision making for the business. This role requires a combination of business acumen, technical skills, and the ability to translate data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in building and maintaining complex dashboards using BI tools used by the company and working with large retail datasets. This role will partner closely with business leaders in Canada as pricing, assortment, planning, and allocation capabilities are implemented and improved.

Planning Operations and Reporting (80%)


Design, develop and maintain reporting and act as a Tableau expert to create complex dashboards, standardized reports and self-service reporting solutions.
Perform data validation, quality assurance, and troubleshooting to ensure accuracy and consistency across reports.
Write and maintain SQL queries for advanced data analysis and data manipulation when needed.
Provide ad hoc reporting to the Planning & Allocation team as needed.
Supports teams with training on Tableau (or any other BI Tool adopted for reporting) and training material.


Relationship Management and Collaboration (20%)


Develop a strong collaboration with the corporate BI team for any added support.
Partners with cross-functional project leads and monitor project timeline at times in partnerships with different functions.
Support Retail senior leadership team with data, insights, and presentation materials on future capabilities and project status updates when required for larger projects, work closely with outside parties to implement solutions.


WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF: Must have:


2-3 Years of Experience in a Data Analyst role.
Advanced knowledge and proficiency in Tableau.
Strong SQL skills for querying large data sets.
Strong communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Skills And Experience


Degree or Diploma in Data Analytics or related field or equivalent work experience.
Exposure to Retail Planning, KPIs and fundamentals.


Our Team Members


Lead Courageously: Have a strong sense of personal values that align with our Company values
Collaborates Broadly: Build cooperation, trust, and thrive in a consensus driven environment
Customer Focus: Proactively seek opportunities to leverage data and fact-based insights to serve customers and/or internal clients
Drive Growth: Set aggressive goals and implement plans precisely
Cultivates Innovation: Respectfully challenge the “we’ve always done it this way” mentality and explore new ways to achieve desired outcomes


Make a Career At Carter’s


Career Development: Success starts from within, and we have several paths from which you can choose to


enhance your career evolution. From Carter’s University to Toastmasters to mentorship programs and more,

we encourage you to utilize these tools to elevate your professional prowess.

Title: Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

At Leadership Connect, we believe that relationships are everything in business and in life. Founded by two former CEOs of S&P 500 companies and a former presidential press secretary, our premier information service is built for developing relationships that impact decisions in government, business, and media. Utilizing deep research expertise and cutting-edge technology, we help our clients win business and influence policy across various specialties and verticals. We are a close-knit team dedicated to helping each of our users make a difference.

Leadership Connect Canada (LCC), a subsidiary of Leadership Connect Inc., is our Canadian entity operating in the province of Quebec.

About The Role

Working within our Data Team, we are seeking an Analyst to conduct and perform research and analysis tasks to develop and maintain our core data assets, people intelligence. The incumbent will actively participate in the development of our data operations activities while ensuring the accuracy and quality of our people intelligence data product. This role is ideal for data enthusiasts and problem solvers, keen on exercising ownership with a passion for empowering users and customers with information solutions that drive sales enablement and improve the collaboration between our customers and the people who are mission-critical to their organization. We embrace a mindset of continuous learning, and if you’re passionate about data collection, analysis, and development, we want to hear from you!

Core Functions Of The Role


Execute comprehensive data collection, development, and analysis supporting operational processes with a focus on relevance, precision, and accuracy
Undertaking in-depth analysis into key entities within our People Intelligence data product ensuring current and accurate data
Employ data analysis techniques to discern patterns, derive insights, and identify data quality discrepancies.
Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to appraise data quality or to develop workflows contributing to enhancements in data completeness
Perform in an agile environment, in an operational context while facilitating subject matter interactions between interdisciplinary teams


About You


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with an interest in people intelligence
1-2 years of experience in data analysis and statistical research
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
Strong organizational and project management skills
Strong time management practices and a proven ability to meet deadlines
Ability to communicate across teams
Proficiency in conducting sophisticated web-based research
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or other data management systems
Practical knowledge of data analytics tools like PowerBI, QuickSight or others is a plus


$40,000 - $55,000 a year

To attract and engage high-level professionals, it is crucial to showcase our expertise, experience, and commitment to fostering valuable connections. We understand the importance of transparency when it comes to salary matters. Our research and analysis of the Quebec market serve as the foundation for determining appropriate salary ranges. However, we also recognize that factors like location, experience, skills alignment, and other compensation considerations may influence these ranges. At Leadership Connect, we place a strong emphasis on open communication and adaptability to ensure fair and competitive compensation. We invite talented individuals to join our team and help us create a workforce that is motivated and empowered to achieve new levels of success.

What Is It Like to Work Here?

We foster an environment that encourages all our team members to excel by offering competitive compensation for top talent. We believe in creating a friendly and enjoyable workplace, with regular team-building events, happy hours, and more. Transparency is key within our company, and we hold monthly town halls led by our CEO to address questions regarding business plans, product direction, and company goals. In addition, we provide flexible PTO policies to ensure you can enjoy your time outside the office and focus on your personal life.

Are you ready to join our dynamic team and build meaningful relationships that make a difference? Apply today!

Benefits/Rewards


Awesome Extended Health Care Plan
Dental Care
Life & Disability insurance
Health spending accounts
Unlimited Vacation Leave
12 Paid Holidays
$3,000 Employee Referral Program
Employer contribution to VRSP
Rewards and recognition programs


If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we still want to hear from you!

Leadership Connect is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce where unique experiences are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute. Research has continuously shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet all of the listed qualifications. We want to help overcome this trend and seek to make space for unique and relevant skills and attributes. So, when applying to Leadership Connect we focus on evaluation based on key competencies needed for success in the position. We look forward to receiving your application!

Leadership Connect is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Data Analyst, Business Intelligence
Description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by the world's top digital marketers. We are looking for a Data Analyst II to join our Business Intelligence team within Advertising Technologies. In this role, you will deliver advanced data analysis and reporting that drives strategic decision-making across product, revenue, and operations teams. You will work with complex datasets, build trusted reporting pipelines, and recommend new KPIs to improve business visibility. This is an excellent opportunity for a data professional who thrives on translating raw data into actionable insights in a fast-paced, AI-augmented environment.

This is a remote-friendly position open to candidates based in Canada.

What You'll Be Doing:
Design, build, and maintain high-quality dashboards, reports, and datasets that support business decision-making across product, revenue, and operations teams.
Write advanced SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy and reliability of reporting outputs.
Identify and recommend new KPIs and metrics that improve business visibility and stakeholder understanding of performance trends.
Manage project plans for new reporting needs, including requirements gathering, milestone tracking, and timely delivery.
Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Revenue, Operations) to clarify data requirements, resolve data quality issues, and support evidence-based planning.
Within your first 6 months, you will own the delivery of regular BI reporting cycles, contribute to at least one new KPI framework, and actively support the team's adoption of AI-assisted workflows using Claude for reporting and coding tasks and Gemini for planning and meeting documentation.
Leverage AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and draft documentation.
What You'll Bring to the Table
2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, with a track record of delivering actionable insights from complex datasets.
Advanced SQL proficiency, including the ability to write complex queries, troubleshoot data issues, and work with data warehouses (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery).
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports using BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar).
Strong project management skills: ability to clarify requirements, set milestones, manage risks, and deliver reporting initiatives independently.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to write effective prompts, critically evaluate AI-generated output, and integrate AI tools into day-to-day workflows.

The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in Ontario, Canada. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location.This range represents base salary only. Title: Data Analyst

Permanent Full Time

We are seeking a highly analytical and solutions-oriented Data Analyst to support Workplace Benefits and Retirement.

This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams and our Field Sales and Service partners. The successful candidate will possess a deep curiosity for understanding data, adept at identifying anomalies, investigating discrepancies, and the ability to design and implement efficient data-driven solutions.

In addition, the Data Analyst will build and evolve analytical reporting using Power BI, Excel, and SQL. By digging into performance results, identifying key trends, and translating complex data into clear insights, the role provides the information needed for data‑driven action to help move our business grow.

What You Will Do


Analyze, interpret, and validate large data volume to identify trends, inconsistencies, and anomalies
Provide technical and functional support on complex compensation programs, support decision-making with sound judgement backed by data, and mentor team
Write and optimize SQL queries to support data retrieval and reporting
Maintain tools and scripts using VB.NET to support business needs
Translate complex datasets into clear, compelling insights and business narratives
Work with stakeholders to improve data availability, quality, and drive automation
Ensure data accuracy and integrity through validation, reconciliation, and quality checks
Help resolve issues, perform analysis, and support application enhancements
Document data flows, models, and solutions to ensure sustainability


What You Will Bring


3+ years of hands-on experience with:
Data modeling concepts and tools
SQL (query development, optimization)
VB.NET
Power Automate
Power Apps
Power BI
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into manageable components
Ability to model, structure, validate, and document complex datasets to support accurate and reliable decision‑making
Experience improving manual operational processes, including the ability to streamline or automate validation workflows
Proven experience identifying errors, inconsistencies, and anomalies in data
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
A proactive mindset — you seek to understand the purpose behind requests and consistently look for opportunities to improve processes and outcomes


The base salary for this position is between $54,700 - $104,700 annually. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Analyst, Data Strategy
Description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Analyst, Data Strategy

As a Data Strategy Analyst, you will report to the Director, Data Strategy and Product Assurance and work closely with the Manager of Data Strategy, playing a crucial role in supporting the organization's data strategy and governance initiatives. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will gather data requirements, assist in developing and implementing comprehensive data strategies, and ensure the alignment of data usage with business goals.

You will leverage your data analytics expertise to help maintain data roadmaps, build process data flows, manage project management tools, support certification of products based on governance standards and help execute overall data strategy. This position will also work in collaboration with the delivery team, and product managers to ensure the analytics program is enabling the overall data strategy.

This role is based in our temporary location of 20 York Mills Rd, then the Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts, Toronto Corporate Office. This role involves interactions with both internal and external stakeholders at various levels.

What You’ll Be Doing


Support the manager in implementing relevant data governance policies and work closely with product owners to ensure data products are certified for use.
Assist in maintaining the data roadmap, ensuring alignment of data usage with evolving business strategies, emerging technologies, and data sources.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with data stewards, product owners, and other key stakeholders to facilitate collaboration and data stewardship.
Facilitation and maintenance of the ongoing data strategy and roadmap.
Support intake of new data products through stakeholder communication, maintenance of templates, and scheduling of oversight and governance meetings.
Collaborate with project managers and delivery teams to support the development and delivery of data products that provide value to the business.
Assist in strengthening the organization’s data foundation through the implementation of effective policies, standards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Work with the manager to create and maintain training materials, playbooks, and reference guides to promote consistent adoption of data governance practices across teams.
Provide ongoing support and training on product certification requirements.
Oversee implementation of data strategy.
Support the manager in tracking and reporting on budget utilization across data and analytics projects, highlighting key variances and potential risks.
Assist in preparing program level budget and spend summaries to inform planning and prioritization.
Collaborate with D&A teams to create initial cost and resource estimates for new project requests.
Program Budget and Performance Tracking.
Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement in data management processes.
Communicate the value of data-driven decision making and foster a data-driven culture by promoting awareness and understanding of the importance of data.
Proactive research and promote use of data to enable FS strategy.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s in a relevant field (e.g. Data Management, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Informatics).
Strong understanding of data governance frameworks and principles.
Experience managing data lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to align data strategy with business goals.
Experience in data strategy development and implementation.
Ability to adapt data strategies to evolving business needs and changing landscape.
Analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, detect anomalies, and translate complex data sets into actionable insights and strategies.
Experience with data governance tools and technologies such as informatica.
Strong knowledge of data protection regulations, and compliance standards.
Applied experience in data governance and / or data management.
Knowledge of industry leading data governance practices.
Familiar with implementation and use various data governance tools and software.
Familiar with DMBOK principles.
Understand of complete data lifecycle and related data governance requirements.
Understanding of GDPR and related legislation.
Ability to manipulate, analyze and transform large datasets to understand trends and patterns.
Working knowledge of cloud computing platforms. MS Azure preferred (Microsoft Synapse, Azure Data factory, Azure Databricks, PowerBI).
Proficient in SQL or other programming languages.
Experience with data visualization and dashboarding (Power BI, Tableau).
Expert in Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
Working knowledge of project management tools such as Monday.com and Jira.


Who You Are

Business / Analytics Skills


Works to understand the business need and how the data will be used to drive decisions into action plans that will grow the business.
Effectively navigates through ambiguity and complexity to provide clarity for the team and the requester.
Works well under pressure and can manage multiple tasks under time constraints.
Strong with process management including the development of processes and procedures.
Familiar with agile methodology and comfortable working in an agile environment.


Communication Skills


Works to understand the requester needs when building the upfront story to ensure clarity and actionability.
Listens carefully to understand requirements and seeks clarity as needed.
Provides well-structured reports and documents to convey analysis and insights that are clear, concise and reader-friendly.
Demonstrates understanding of the importance of storytelling by incorporating visual enhancements into presentations.
Strong interpersonal skills and team player.


Planning / Organizational Skills


Demonstrates the ability to organize and work with high volumes of data.
Establishes clear expectations to ensure smooth execution.
Handles multiple demands and conflicting priorities by quickly re-allocating time and resources.
Organizes self and the team in setting and managing priorities.
Demonstrates a relentlessly high standard for attention to detail and holds others to the same.
Delivers on commitments on time and on budget.


People Engagement


Takes the time to acknowledge the efforts and contributions of others.
Works to build relationships with colleagues to both provide and receive the best support.


Collaboration Skills


Works productively in a matrix environment to move projects along and foster a positive team attitude.
Proactively asks for input and ideas from others to demonstrate the power of the team.


Salary Range: $70,000 – $85,000 CAD

This role will be a Hybrid working model, which will require 3 days per week at our temporary 20 York Mills Road, Toronto, Ontario location with travel, as needed, to our Four Seasons Corporate Office located at 1165 Leslie Street, Toronto, Ontario

Four Seasons is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

You will leverage your data analytics expertise to help maintain data roadmaps, build process data flows, manage project management tools, support certification of products based on governance standards and help execute overall data strategy. This position will also work in collaboration with the delivery team, and product managers to ensure the analytics program is enabling the overall data strategy.

This role is based in our temporary location of 20 York Mills Rd, then the Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts, Toronto Corporate Office. This role involves interactions with both internal and external stakeholders at various levels.

  • Support the manager in implementing relevant data governance policies and work closely with product owners to ensure data products are certified for use.

  • Facilitation and maintenance of the ongoing data strategy and roadmap.
  • Support intake of new data products through stakeholder communication, maintenance of templates, and scheduling of oversight and governance meetings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and delivery teams to support the development and delivery of data products that provide value to the business.

  • Oversee implementation of data strategy.
  • Support the manager in tracking and reporting on budget utilization across data and analytics projects, highlighting key variances and potential risks.
  • Assist in preparing program level budget and spend summaries to inform planning and prioritization.
  • Collaborate with D&A teams to create initial cost and resource estimates for new project requests.

  • Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement in data management processes.

  • Experience managing data lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to align data strategy with business goals.

Business / Analytics Skills

  • Works to build relationships with colleagues to both provide and receive the best support.

  • Works productively in a matrix environment to move projects along and foster a positive team attitude.
  • Proactively asks for input and ideas from others to demonstrate the power of the team.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

3+ years of experience in a data analytics role, with a strong track record of delivering advanced reporting for multiple stakeholder teams

Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) and building client-facing or executive-ready dashboards
Strong communication skills with experience presenting data-driven findings to senior management and cross-functional teams
Demonstrated ability to identify data quality root causes and implement systematic solutions

Title: Data Analyst (Intermediate/Senior), Credit
Description:
About KOHO

We’re on a mission to make financial services better for every Canadian. That means no hidden fees, no predatory interest rates - just financial products designed to help our users spend smart, save more, and build real wealth. We’re a performance organization with a strong heart: we care deeply about outcomes, and everything ties back to our mission - to financially empower a generation of Canadians.

At KOHO, we’re not your average 9-5. We believe real impact comes from people who are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work - without sacrificing their lives to do it. We prioritize work-life integration, not just work-life balance. That means asynchronous collaboration, flexible hours, and a remote-first setup built around autonomy and high trust.

KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in.

About The Role

At KOHO, our Data Analysts work within a centralized data team, partnering closely with Product Managers, designers, and engineers to drive product decisions. You'll be joining a collaborative team that invests in mentorship, peer review, and shared learning.

In this role, you'll be the product analyst for our Credit domain. You'll build the pipelines, dashboards, and analyses that shape how we grow our credit products and help users build credit responsibly. You'll partner closely with the Credit Risk team, product managers, and data science partners.

What You'll Do


Serve as the analytics partner for credit products: build the pipelines and dashboards that power decision making across the full product lifecycle, from feature launch and rollout monitoring through mature product analytics
Design and own dbt models with a focus on performance, scalability, and the nuances of credit data
Build dashboards that go beyond reporting to answer critical product and portfolio questions
Support experimentation across the credit portfolio
Partner with stakeholders to shape requirements, prioritize the highest impact work, and connect analysis back to business outcomes
Proactively identify trends and opportunities, thinking beyond the immediate request
Contribute to team culture: code reviews, peer feedback, and evolving our shared best practices


What You'll Bring


Around 3 years of experience in a data or analytics role
Strong SQL and hands-on dbt experience — these are the foundation of this role
Familiar with Git workflows: branching, clear commits, constructive PR reviews
A clear communicator who adapts the message to the audience
Curious about the business behind the data, and interested in how your work connects to product decisions
You integrate AI tools into your daily workflow


Bonus if You Have


Credit, lending, or consumer finance data experience
A/B testing and experimentation frameworks
Fintech or consumer product background
Redshift and dbt certifications


The budgeted salary range for this role is $85,000 - 130,000 CAD / year.

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.

Concevoir et prendre en charge des modèles dbt en mettant l'accent sur la performance, l'évolutivité et les nuances des données de crédit

Identifier de manière proactive les tendances et les opportunités, en allant au-delà de la demande immédiate
Contribuer à la culture d'équipe : révisions de code, rétroaction entre pairs et évolution des meilleures pratiques communes

Title: Analyst, Performance Analytics & Reporting
Description:
Job ID: 965

Position Type: Union Permanent

Department: Performance Analytics & Reporting

Salary Grade: 6 ($86,210 - $101,349)

Job Posting Close Date: 08/06/2026

The Ontario Energy Board is proud to be recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for four years running.

Our success resides with our people and we take great pride in fostering a workplace culture that attracts top-tier professionals passionate about shaping Ontario’s energy future. Our reputation as a preferred employer reflects our commitment to helping deliver clean, reliable, affordable and secure energy that enables economic growth across the province.

Our One OEB culture promotes a values-driven, collaborative workplace where diverse perspectives come together to deliver regulatory excellence, and where we encourage curiosity and agility in an environment that is grounded in mental health, wellbeing and a foundational commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.

We are the ONTARIO ENERGY BOARD.

Overview

Reporting to the Manager, Performance Analytics and Reporting, the Analyst is responsible for supporting the OEB’s utility performance analysis and reporting activities. This includes working with other OEB groups to manage utility data submission processes and providing analytical insight to assist the Board in policy development and decision making. The Performance Analytics and Reporting department monitors financial and non-financial performance of Ontario’s electricity and natural gas distributors, as well as other regulated entities.

Responsibilities


Initiates and develops plans to achieve, and deliver data analytics based on financial accounting, customer and performance reported by utilities.
Identifies relevant issues and provides in-depth analysis associated with financial and non-financial data for regulated entities.
Provides analytics expertise to internal and external stakeholders regarding data gathered and insights into correlations & trends seen through utility reporting.
Working closely with other departments supports policy implementation through specialized reporting requirements and data analysis.
Conceptualizes and builds analytical models to improve reporting and industry analytics and presents information to both internal and external stakeholders.
Delivers on projects related to performance assessment (e.g., enhancement of utilities scorecard).
Collaboratively works with other team members on analytics best practices and utility operations.
Prepares and/or reviews monthly, quarterly, and annual statistical and project status reports/publications, ensuring information published is accurate and thorough.
Develops and/or enhances new and/or existing policies and procedures.


Qualifications


Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance; Economics; Data Science; Engineering or a related field.
An accounting, engineering or finance professional designation is highly preferred.
3+ years of relevant experience in the energy sector including performance assessment, industry insights, asset management or system planning.
2+ years’ experience translating large data sets into actionable information and valuable insights for decision making purposes.
Experience and knowledge of electric utility performance metrics, including key drivers and challenge.
2+ years’ experience in a utility or regulatory environment is preferred.
Previous working experience with data analytical solutions and tools such as Excel, SQL, VBA, Oracle BI, SAS, R, Tableau, Alteryx.
Knowledge of financial/management reporting.
Practical knowledge supporting projects with interdisciplinary teams, understanding stakeholder expectations, and managing own project timelines / deliverables.
Excellent oral and written communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of the Ontario Energy Board Act, 1998 and related regulatory policies is an asset.
