Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Our client, based in Langley, BC, is seeking a Senior Data Analyst (Data Warehouse & Integration) for an approximately 5-month contract engagement (30 hours/week). Due to the collaborative nature of the project, preference will be given to candidates located in the Lower Mainland who can work closely with internal Finance, Operations, and IT teams, as well as external Sage consultants.




This is a highly technical role focused on data mapping, data transformation, integration, cleansing, and warehousing activities across multiple source systems rather than traditional reporting or dashboard development.




Responsibilities

Analyze and map data from multiple enterprise systems, including financial, operational, HR, fleet management, dispatch, and other business platforms.
Work with Finance, Operations, and IT stakeholders to understand source system data structures and business requirements.
Perform source-to-target data mapping and define transformation rules for warehouse integration.
Cleanse, validate, and reconcile data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
Support the integration of flat-file, database, and API-based data sources into the enterprise data warehouse.
Execute data transformation and validation activities using SQL and related tools.
Collaborate with Sage consultants and implementation partners to support data onboarding into Sage Enterprise Intelligence.
Identify and resolve data quality, data consistency, and integration issues.
Assist with data migration, testing, reconciliation, and user acceptance activities.
Document data flows, mapping specifications, transformation logic, and integration requirements.
Support the continued onboarding of new data sources into the enterprise analytics environment.




Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Data Warehousing, Data Integration, ETL, or related disciplines.
Proven experience working with enterprise data warehouse initiatives and large-scale data integration projects.
Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience querying, validating, transforming, and reconciling data.
Experience integrating data from multiple source systems, including ERP, HRIS, financial, and operational platforms.
Strong understanding of data cleansing, data quality, data governance, and data validation principles.
Experience performing source-to-target mapping and documenting complex data transformations.
Demonstrated ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from databases, flat files, and APIs.
Experience collaborating with technical and business stakeholders across Finance, Operations, and IT teams.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

What You Will Do


Assist the Regional Financial Analyst with the preparation of the monthly financial reports
Work with Excel and PowerBI and SmartView Query reporting tools to develop various adhoc analyses and reports.
Occasional creation of Macros/VBA would be an asset.
Work with the Regional Financial Analyst to help prepare the annual budget
Provide analysis and recommendations to help the Regional financial Analyst to support strategic business decisions
Support the Firm strategy of identifying opportunities to streamline processes and continuously explore opportunities to find efficiencies and improve the services provided


At times, business needs arise, and employees are required and agree to work beyond their normal workday or work week to fulfill the accountabilities required for their job. Likewise, people need extra time to devote to personal matters, and our approach to flexibility provides for this.

What You Bring To The Role


Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Advanced technical skills working with Excel & PowerBI. Experience with SmartView would also be a definite asset.
Ability to organize and prioritize in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
Self-motivated, self-starter displaying high initiative, willingness to learn, and ability to operate independently
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in order to communicate to internal and external stakeholders, and with all levels of the firm
Capability to work in a collaborative environment
MS Office – intermediate to advanced level in Excel


The following software knowledge is ideal


EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) or HFM – (Hyperion Financial Management)
BO for SAP / Hana


KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $55,000 to $82,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Title: Analyst, Data Governance
Description:
What You Will Do


Data Governance Leadership: Support the development, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and enforcement of data governance standards, policies, procedures, and controls to ensure adherence to privacy, compliance, risk, regulatory, and legal requirements. This includes AI Governance to ensure ethical use and compliance with regulatory standards for AI-driven processes.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with leadership, IT departments, business units, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk teams, data producers and consumers, and IT data platform teams to align on data governance goals and support the operationalization of a robust data governance framework.
Promote data literacy by developing materials and conducting training on best practices.
Policy Development: Assist in the creation and enforcement of data management policies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Contribute to shaping the data governance accountabilities and operating model and enable data stewardship.
Data Quality Assurance: Contribute to the enhancement and implementation of robust data quality frameworks and conduct regular audits to maintain high data standards.
Support the development and evolution of data governance metrics and KPIs; monitor & measure the overall efficacy of the data governance program.

Title: Senior Digital Data Analyst
Description:
About the Role

Bounteous is a premier end-to-end digital transformation consultancy dedicated to partnering with ambitious brands to create digital solutions for today’s complex challenges and tomorrow’s opportunities. With uncompromising standards for technical and domain expertise, we deliver innovative and strategic solutions in Strategy, Analytics, Digital Engineering, Cloud, Data & AI, Experience Design, and Marketing.




Our Co-Innovation methodology is a unique engagement model designed to align interests and accelerate value creation. Our clients worldwide benefit from the skills and expertise of over 4,000+ expert team members across the Americas, APAC, and EMEA. By partnering with leading technology providers, we craft transformative digital experiences that enhance customer engagement and drive business success.




We are looking for a Senior Digital Data Analyst to help shape how we measure, understand, and improve digital performance across our web experiences. This is a senior individual contributor role for an analyst who combines technical fluency, strong business judgment, and sharp problem-solving skills.




In this role, you will support day-to-day digital analytics needs across website tagging, reporting, analysis, and data-driven personalization and experimentation. You will partner with stakeholders across digital, marketing, content, and optimization to ensure data is reliable, insights are actionable, and measurement supports better business decisions.

This role is best suited for someone who is thoughtful, curious, and highly self-directed. We are looking for an analyst who can work through ambiguity, spot issues before they become problems, and make sound decisions without needing step-by-step direction. You should be comfortable asking hard questions of the data, validating your own work, and adapting your approach when the situation does not fit a familiar pattern.




What You’ll Do

Support digital analytics across websites and digital experiences, including reporting, ad hoc analysis, and measurement planning.
Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into clear measurement approaches, reporting structures, and analytical frameworks.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reporting, KPI definitions, and insight-driven analyses.
Create, organize, and maintain analytics documentation in SharePoint, including measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, implementation notes, reporting logic, and process guidance.
Identify trends, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities, then turn findings into clear recommendations.
Serve as a strong practitioner in Adobe Analytics, including segmentation, calculated metrics, attribution, workspace analysis, and data interpretation.
Review data critically, investigate anomalies, reconcile discrepancies, and catch errors before work is shared.
Support day-to-day website tagging operations by helping define requirements, reviewing requests, validating implementation, and strengthening QA and governance processes.
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure digital measurement is aligned with reporting, analysis, and optimization needs.
Support personalization and experimentation efforts with audience analysis, measurement planning, test readouts, and insight generation.
Help ensure testing and personalization decisions are grounded in a disciplined, data-driven approach.
Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to automate repeatable work, improve workflows, and strengthen analytics practices.
Support evolving measurement needs tied to organic growth, content performance, and emerging AI-driven traffic sources.




Required Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in digital analytics, web analytics, marketing analytics, or a related field.
Deep hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics.
Strong experience in reporting, segmentation, analysis, and digital performance measurement.
Working knowledge of website tagging concepts, analytics QA, and data governance.
Experience supporting experimentation, personalization, or optimization initiatives.
Proven ability to solve problems independently and work effectively in ambiguous situations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.




Preferred

Familiarity with SEO measurement, content performance analysis, and digital growth strategies.
Experience in environments that are automating parts of the analytics workflow.
Exposure to measuring and interpreting emerging traffic patterns, including AI-driven traffic sources.
Experience evaluating or working with analytics tagging QA tools.
Power BI experience is preferred.

We are seeking a meticulous and insightful Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. This is a Full-Time, remote position based in Winnipeg, Canada. Interpret data and analyse results using statistical techniques to provide ongoing reports.

Identify, analyse, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets.
Collaborate with management to prioritise business and information needs.

Ensure data integrity and accuracy across all reporting and analysis activities.
Work closely with finance and product teams to understand and define new data-driven opportunities.

Proven working experience as a Data Analyst or Business Data Analyst.
Strong knowledge of and experience with reporting packages, databases (SQL etc.), and programming (XML, Javascript, or ETL frameworks).
Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organise, analyse, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About The ALDO Group

Specializing in stylish and accessible footwear, handbags, and accessories, the ALDO Group has been around for more than 50 years. With over 1,500 stores in more than 100 countries, we operate under two signature brands, ALDO and Call It Spring, and we are the core footwear partner for Sperry in North America. The ALDO Group is also an industry-recognized wholesale licensed partner, specializing in the design, sourcing, and distribution of fashion footwear, handbags, and accessories. Our diverse portfolio includes household brands such as ROXY, Brooks Brothers, Ted Baker, Hunter, and G.H.BASS. In addition to our head office in Montreal, the ALDO Group maintains international offices in Europe and Asia. For more information, visit www.aldogroup.com .

Enjoy meaningful recognition, flexible work options, great on‑site perks, generous discounts, and the pride of being part of a brand that leads with people, the planet, and its partners at heart.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst / AWS QuickSight Administrator & Developer to join our Supply Chain Central Ops team.

This hybrid role combines BI platform administration and dashboard development with advanced analytical responsibilities.

The successful candidate will support the individual Supply Chain teams — including Inbound, Distribution Center, Demand & Supply Management, and Outbound Transport — to understand, document, and translate their business requirements into impactful analytical solutions. The successful candidate will also be responsible for surfacing insights and helping answer questions on trends and cost-saving opportunities to support these teams, within a fast‑paced retail environment.

Key Responsibilities


Administer and evolve the AWS QuickSight platform, including user management, security, governance, and cost optimization.
Design, develop, and maintain high ‑ quality interactive dashboards in AWS QuickSight.
Create, manage, and optimize analytical datasets from multiple data sources.
Meet with the Supply Chain teams (Inbound, Distribution Center, Demand & Supply Management, Outbound Transport) to gather requirements, document functional needs, and ensure alignment with delivered solutions.
Perform in ‑ depth analyses to identify trends, insights, and cost ‑ saving opportunities to support the Supply Chain teams, particularly in a retail and omnichannel context.
Communicate insights clearly using effective data storytelling techniques tailored to business audiences.
Collaborate closely with Data Engineers, Product Owners, IT teams, and Supply Chain partners.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of BI standards, analytical practices, and visualization guidelines.


Required Skills & Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Analytics, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in analytics, BI, and data visualization.
Strong hands ‑ on experience with AWS QuickSight (both administration and development).
Advanced SQL skills; Python is an asset.
Proven experience in the retail industry (sales, inventory, margins, promotions, e ‑ commerce, or omnichannel analytics).
Supply chain operations experience is a strong asset.
Demonstrated ability to work directly with business teams and translate business needs into analytical solutions.
Strong understanding of data visualization and user ‑ centric dashboard design.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.
Experience working in Agile environments.


Building a culture of belonging

We firmly believe that the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and identities is a fundamental strength of the ALDO Group. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are committed to providing a safe, respectful, and equitable work environment where everyone can reach their full potential and find their fit.

Title: Market Data Analyst
Description:
**Please note this is a hybrid role out of Markham**

Scope Of Position

The Market Data Analyst serves as the central data and reporting resource for Used Vehicle Sales Operations and Remarketing. The role is responsible for extracting, validating, and managing data from multiple internal and external sources, and transforming raw data into clear, actionable insights. The position ensures delivery of timely, accurate reporting and dashboards that support decision-making across the organization. Success is measured by the quality, consistency, and usability of reporting outputs that enable stakeholders to identify trends, optimize strategies, and drive business performance. 

Principal Functional Responsibilities


Extract, validate, and manage market, sales, and operational data to ensure accuracy, reliability, and availability for reporting and analysis. 
Develop, maintain, and enhance standardized and ad hoc reports and dashboards to provide visibility into key performance metrics and trends. 
Analyze vehicle pricing, residual values, and market conditions to identify risks and opportunities across the portfolio. 
Translate complex data findings into clear, concise insights and recommendations for business stakeholders. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand reporting needs and refine analytics requirements. 
Maintain data integrity through quality checks and adherence to governance standards. 
Automate and optimize reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. 
Document data sources, reporting methodologies, and workflows to ensure consistency and scalability. 


Position Profile And Qualifications


Minimum College Diploma required; University degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, or related field preferred. 
1–3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or analytics roles (co-op/internship experience considered). 
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data manipulation). 
Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) considered an asset. 
Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets accurately. 
Ability to translate technical data into clear, business-friendly insights. 
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to manage multiple reporting requests in a fast-paced environment. 


Relationship Responsibilities


Collaborates with Sales, Remarketing, Credit, and Risk teams to support reporting needs and data-driven decision-making. 
Supports senior leadership through delivery of reporting, dashboards, and insights for business reviews. 
Works with brand teams to provide data and analysis on program performance and market trends. 
Partners with IT teams to support data sourcing, issue resolution, and reporting enhancements. 


ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS

Working Conditions

Normal

Physical Effort

Normal

Mental Stress

Normal

HIRING PRACTICES

The salary range for this position is $72,921–$86,593 CAD annually. Individual salaries within this range are determined by a variety of job-related factors, including education, experience, knowledge, and skill set.

On-Site Occasional Work-from-Home: This is an on-site with occasional work-from-home position that requires employees to work on-site four days per week with the opportunity to work-from-home one day per week (with a dedicated workspace at the assigned company office).

Title: Junior Data & AI Analyst
Description:
You live, We Care!




Redion, part of Generali Group, is looking for a forward-thinking Jr. Data & AI Analyst to join our IT team in Canada.




Join our dynamic, fast-moving, international group and help shape the future of care.

If you are the kind of person people turn to in times of need, we want to meet you. We are looking for people who truly care: who are willing to roll up their sleeves to help others and are energized by being there when it matters most. If you think fast, are open to change, and strive to be the best you can be, this is the place for you.




We are a company driven by cutting-edge technology and a culture of care. We design insurance solutions and deliver assistance services that make a real difference to people’s lives.

And just as we are always there for our customers, we are always there for you too. We will help you build a meaningful career full of purpose, pace and possibility.

Reporting directly to the Head of IT, with dotted line to the Lead Data & Business Analyst, you will play a key role in building our local operations by managing and optimizing data flows across our hybrid cloud environment.




About our company:




We are the world’s premier care partner, providing the world’s leading institutions and their customers and employees with insurance, assistance and prevention services that free them to make the most of every moment.

Our roots in assistance, and long history in insurance, have shaped a culture of care and innovation that sets us apart. Unlike major insurers, we are a fast-paced, agile and growing organization. We empower our people at all levels to act with confidence and authenticity. We believe it helps them take initiative, make quicker decisions, and build real, enduring relationships and effective solutions. We keep our structure streamlined and deploy industry-leading technology so our people can act faster, and with greater agility, to help our customers.

Care is at the heart of who we are and extends far beyond just our customers. We are one, international team — shaped and enhanced by the many cultures and perspectives we represent. We are committed to ensuring everyone that works with us feels valued and equipped to flourish. And we also care for our planet: taking pride in our industry-leading initiatives towards building a sustainable business.




The position is based in Toronto, and the working environment is a mix of in-office and remote work, though always in close collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders.




Responsibilities Include:

End-to-End Data Engineering: Support the automated movement and lifecycle of data from source systems (Policy/Claims) into AWS Redshift and Microsoft Fabric. Use AWS Glue and Dataflow Gen2 to build robust ETL pipelines.
Semantic Modeling & DAX: Assist in the design and optimization of high-performance Power BI Semantic Models. Use DAX and Power Query to ensure accurate, high-impact reporting.
Visual Analytics & Insights: Create and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and advanced Excel reports. Analyze complex datasets to identify actionable trends, patterns, and operational insights.
AI & Model Support: Utilize AWS SageMaker and Fabric’s integrated AI tools to assist in training and deploying predictive models aimed at improving operational efficiency.
KPI & Strategic Reporting: Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and provide data-backed recommendations to leadership to drive process improvements and organizational performance.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to explain data lineage and translate complex technical findings into clear, concise insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.




Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Education: University or College Degree in the field of Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Data Science or related field.
Cloud Architecture: High interest or foundational experience in AWS (Redshift, Glue) and Microsoft Fabric (Dataflow Gen2).
Technical Proficiency: Strong command of SQL, Power BI (DAX focus), and Advanced Excel (Pivot tables, complex formulas).
Programming: Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy) is highly preferred for data manipulation within SageMaker or Fabric Notebooks.
Industry Context: A foundational understanding of insurance concepts (underwriting, claims, risk assessment) is highly valued.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with the ability to map out and explain complex data flows through various systems.




Language Requirement: Fluency in English

Hours of Work: Monday to Friday

Work Location: Toronto

Total Compensation: $60k – 70k (plus 8% bonus)

Vacancy: 1 full time position (new role)




Redion supports all accommodation requests from applicants with disabilities; please contact Human Resources at careers@redion.com if any accommodation is required. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.




Artificial Intelligence (AI) Usage Disclosure: Please note that our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to assist in screening, assessing, and selecting applicants. These technologies are used to enhance efficiency, ensure consistency, and support fair decision-making. All AI-assisted evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable privacy and employment regulations.

We thank all applications for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Description:
Join one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies and be part of something extraordinary – welcome to goeasy! At goeasy, our people and culture are at the heart of everything we do, and we’re proud to be recognized for it. We’ve earned prestigious accolades such as Waterstone Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures and Canada’s Top Growing Companies. We’re also honoured to be named a Greater Toronto Top Employer and recognized by Great Place to Work® as having the Best Workplaces for Women & Most Trusted Executive Teams, and included on TIME Magazine’s 2025 list of Canada’s Best Companies.  These honours reflect our commitment to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where talent thrives and innovation drives us forward.

As one of Canada’s leading alternative consumer lenders, we’re passionate about helping everyday Canadians create a brighter future. Our vision is to provide a path to a better tomorrow, today. We offer a full range of products, including non-prime leasing, unsecured and secured loans, and point-of-sale financing through easyhome, easyfinancial, and LendCare.

If you're seeking an exciting, high-growth environment where your contributions truly matter, we want to hear from you! Join us, and together, let's create a future of financial empowerment.

At goeasy, we're continually evolving, finding new ways to serve our customers, improve how we operate, and use data to make smarter decisions. We are seeking a curious, analytical, and highly motivated Insights Analyst to join our team and help drive meaningful business outcomes through data-driven insights.

In this role, you'll do more than build reports. You'll partner with leaders across the organization to solve complex business challenges, uncover opportunities, identify trends, and influence strategic decisions. The successful candidate will combine strong quantitative skills with business acumen, leveraging data visualization and storytelling techniques to translate complex information into clear, compelling narratives that inspire action.

What will you be doing?


Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights that support strategic and operational decision making.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that enable leaders to make informed decisions quickly and effectively.
Translate complex data into clear, compelling stories and recommendations that drive business action and measurable results.
Partner with Operations, Data, and Technology teams to solve business challenges and deliver data-driven solutions.
Monitor key business and customer performance metrics, proactively identifying opportunities to improve outcomes, efficiency, and overall performance.
Present insights, findings, and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization with clarity and confidence.
Support strategic initiatives through analysis, problem solving, performance measurement, and data-driven decision making.
Identify and communicate opportunities that enhance customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business performance.
Demonstrate curiosity, critical thinking, and strategic thinking to uncover root causes, challenge assumptions, and drive continuous improvement.
Build strong relationships with stakeholders and serve as a trusted partner in leveraging data to achieve business objectives.


What experience do you have?


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
0 to 3 years of experience in analytics, business analysis, consulting, finance, or a related field.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to work through complex business challenges.
Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
Experience with SQL and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Ability to translate data into meaningful insights and actionable business recommendations.
Experience building dashboards, performance reporting, and data visualizations that support business decision making.
Exposure to financial services, fintech, operations, strategy, product analytics, or a similar business environment is considered an asset.
Knowledge of statistical analysis, experimentation, predictive analytics, AI-enabled tools, Python, R, or other analytical programming languages is considered an asset.


We offer a Flexible Work Program that provides you the ability to work three days onsite per week, from our Mississauga office.

Internal Applicants: please apply through the link and provide written endorsement from your current manager.

$70,400.00 – $88,000.00 CAD (includes base salary and bonus)

We’re committed to attracting and rewarding top talent. Our compensation ranges are thoughtfully designed to reflect market competitiveness, internal equity, and the experience and impact each candidate brings to the role.

At goeasy, we believe transparency fosters trust — and that rewarding performance with fair, competitive pay and meaningful growth opportunities is key to our success.

Should your total compensation expectations fall above the posted range, we still encourage you to apply. If selected for an interview, you’ll have the opportunity to discuss this with our recruitment team, as there may be flexibility based on your background and overall fit. Total compensation includes base salary and bonus.

This posting is for an existing vacancy within our team.

Why should you work for goeasy?

Financial Benefits

In keeping with our mission to create better tomorrows for our employees, each year goeasy commits to continuously enhancing its total rewards. Here are some of the perks we offer:


RRSP matching and Employee Share Purchase Plan programs.
Annual bonus that rewards your hard work and dedication.
Employee discounts on furniture, electronics, and appliances.
MAT & PAT leave top-up.
Expand your financial knowledge through engaging Financial Literacy Learning opportunities.


Health And Lifestyle


Enjoy company-paid volunteer days to give back to the community.
Access 24/7 healthcare with Virtual Doctor Appointments.
Personalize your benefits with a flexible modular benefits package.
Stay fit and energized with exclusive access to our on-site private gym at our head office.


Employee Perks


Fuel your growth with the Tuition Assistance Program.
Double the impact of your generosity with Company Matched Charitable Donations.
Internal development training programs and platforms including job-specific training, career coaching, leadership excellence, mentorship, and many others.
Enjoy a state-of-the-art office space with perks like a games room, a healthy snack program, a fitness studio, free gated parking, and more!


Diversity, Inclusion, And Equal Opportunity Employment

At goeasy, we believe that we can only be the best when people are able to bring their best selves to work every day. goeasy is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. By learning from each other’s differences, we gain strength through our people and our perspectives. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process. Please let the talent acquisition team know if you require an accommodation during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.

Keep current with emerging technologies
Perform other related duties as assigned

Considerable experience related to the duties above, normally acquired through a diploma or degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Considerable experience in medium- to large-sized corporate environments working with enterprise data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and complex SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling, and report publishing.
Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise systems, such as scheduling, fare, asset management, ERP, and GIS platforms.
Experience writing scripts to automate data retrieval.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with staff, stakeholders, and the public.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment, while managing multiple priorities.

35 hours per week, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Flexibility is a requirement of this position based on departmental needs to attend events and/or meetings. This position is eligible for hybrid and flexible work arrangement options (as per current corporate policy).

Job Description

What is the opportunity?

As Data & Insights Analyst, Employee Onboarding, you will be responsible for measuring, monitoring, and reporting on onboarding performance across the employee lifecycle. You will transform operational data into actionable insights, helping stakeholders understand onboarding effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and track progress against key business outcomes.

What will you do?

Performance Measurement & KPI Management


Define and maintain onboarding performance metrics and KPIs.
Establish baseline measurements and performance targets for the Employee Onboarding team.
Monitor onboarding outcomes and identify emerging trends.
Measure employee readiness, fulfillment timelines, and experience outcomes.
Develop scorecards, executive reporting, and dashboards that leverage automation and reduce manual effort where possible.


Dashboard & Reporting


Build and maintain automated dashboards and reporting solutions.
Develop operational, tactical, and executive-level reporting views.
Improve accessibility and transparency of onboarding performance data
Reduce manual reporting activities through automation.
Ensure reporting accuracy and consistency


Analytics & Insights


Analyze onboarding data to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Conduct root cause analysis for onboarding issues and delays.
Support prioritization decisions using quantitative insights.
Develop Recommendations based on trends and performance data.
Translate complex data into actionable business insights.


Data Governance & Quality


Establish reporting standards and data definitions
Validate data quality across onboarding systems and platforms.
Partner with tech teams to improve data availability and integrity.
Maintain KPI definitions and measurement methodologies.


Continuous Improvement Support


Measure benefits realization for onboarding initiatives.
Support business case development and prioritization exercises
Monitor adoption and effectiveness of new capabilities
Provide analytical support for process improvement initiatives.


What do you need to succeed?

Must-have Experience


2-5 years of experience in analytics, reporting, business intelligence, data analysis, or operational reporting.
Building dashboards and performance reporting.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
Ability to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences.


Nice-to-have Experience


SN Performance analytics
Power BI, tableau, or similar tools
Employee experience, service management, HR or Tech ops
SQL and data visualization experience.
Supporting transformation programs.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Changing the World, One Kibble at a Time

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Data Analyst to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food crafter with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. From our humble beginnings, founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry.

Our purpose, To Earn Pet Lover Trust Every Day so Pets Thrive for a Lifetime, provides the foundation for our highest aspirations as a company. Being a partner to the communities that surround us – and the environment that sustains us – are top priorities.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here’s The Scoop - Summary

We are looking for a data-driven, detail-oriented Data Analyst, preferably within the pet food or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry.

In this role, you will support end-to-end supply chain operations by providing actionable insights across multiple functions and serve as the centralized resource for supply chain data and KPI governance.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, cross-functional environment and is passionate about using data to enhance operational efficiency and support Champion Petfoods’ commitment to delivering high-quality nutrition to pets worldwide.

The Supply Chain Analyst works out of our Corporate office in Edmonton (AB) or Nashville (TN) and works a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-person.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze data across supply chain to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvements
Identify supply chain performance gaps through data analysis, proactively engage with relevant stakeholders to understand root causes, and lead cross-functional efforts to develop and implement innovative solutions.
Develop and maintain real-time dashboards, data objects, and reports that track key supply chain metrics
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align analytics outputs with business needs
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels, enabling data-driven decision-making.
Assist in the deployment and continuous improvement of supply chain analytics tools and technologies


Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Experience in supply chain analytics or data analysis, preferably within the food or pet food industry.
Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Python.
Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Experience with data visualization platforms (preferably Power BI).
Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across teams.
Experience with advanced analytics techniques such as machine learning or predictive modeling preferred.
Experience in Generative AI development preferred.
Familiarity with Databricks preferred.
Understanding of E2E supply chain processes preferred.


What can you expect from Champion?


Safety: A strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.
Earnings: Competitive wages, annual bonus eligibility, 401k/RRSP with company matching.
Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision and employee assistance programs to meet your individual or family needs.
Continuing Education: In house & online learning & development, as well as an education assistance program.
Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.
Other Perks: Free bag of premium pet food each month.


What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of your race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other creed, you are wanted here.

Title: Data Management Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Management & Process Coordinator

Contract Length: 13 months and 17 days
Location: Calgary, Alberta




Raise is currently hiring a Senior Data Management & Process Coordinator on behalf of our client. They’re expanding their team to meet growing needs, making this a unique opportunity to work with an industry leader. Our Client, is one of North America's leading energy infrastructure companies with operations in natural gas, oil and power industries throughout Canada, the United States, and Mexico




Note: The primary pay rate is based on T4 classification; however, we will also consider applications from candidates interested in an INC classification, where applicable.




Description

The Senior Data Management & Process Coordinator with over 10 years of experience will manage advanced data entry, process optimization, and reporting workflows. This role bridges high-volume, precision data administration with modern digital solutions. You will leverage tools like MS Forms and Power Apps alongside traditional databases to streamline data intake, generate actionable reports, and support project management initiatives. Additionally, you will play a key role in developing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and providing guidance to junior team members while handling sensitive, confidential corporate information.




Responsibilities

Advanced Data Processing & Accuracy: Perform complex alphanumeric data entry across multiple enterprise systems, ensuring 100% accuracy and completeness through rigorous visual inspection and proofing.
Process Automation & App Development: Utilize MS Forms and Power Apps to design, build, and maintain simple automated workflows, data capture forms, and digital intake tools.
Database & Report Generation: Query databases (including MS Access) to compile, analyze, and generate scheduled and ad-hoc data reports for departmental decision-making.
Process Standardization (SOPs): Document operational workflows and create clear, simple Standard Operating Procedures for ongoing and new data entry tasks.
Project & Workflow Management: Independently prioritize, organize, and schedule workload demands to support broader project management objectives and deadlines within the department.
Data Integrity & Confidentiality: Maintain strict confidentiality and compliance standards when managing sensitive internal and operational data.
Team Guidance & Support: Serve as a subject matter expert, offering onboarding support, peer training, and operational guidance to staff once established in the role.
Basic Operational Adjustments: Make simple mechanical and system feature adjustments (e.g., switching control configurations, set switching) to maintain data tool performance.




Qualifications

10+ years of progressive experience in high-volume data entry, data management, or administrative project coordination.
Proficiency in MS Forms and Power Apps is required. Experience with MS Access is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to key 10,000 keystrokes per hour (KPH) with exceptional speed and accuracy.
Hands-on experience operating a 10-key adding machine for numeric entry and audit balancing.
Strong practical mathematical skills and proven item-processing capabilities.
Working knowledge or prior experience within project management frameworks to align daily output with project milestones.
Core Competencies
Strong ability to make sound decisions within position scope, including independent planning, task coding/sorting, and time management.
Meticulous visual proofing skills to catch, track, and correct data discrepancies independently.
High degree of discretion and integrity when handling sensitive corporate information.
Ability to clearly explain processes, author simple SOPs, and mentor team members effectively.
Education and Certifications
High School Diploma required; Post-Secondary education (degree or diploma in Business Administration, Information Management, or a related field) preferred.

Title: Data Conversion Specialist
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Conversion Specialist based in Canada.

This remote role offers the opportunity to support customers by transforming complex data from multiple systems into accurate, reliable solutions. You will play a key part in implementation projects by analyzing business requirements, developing conversion strategies, and ensuring successful data migrations. Working closely with project teams and customers, you will help deliver high-quality outcomes while solving technical challenges. The role combines database expertise, analytical thinking, and customer collaboration in a fast-paced environment. You will contribute to improving processes, maintaining data quality, and supporting successful software deployments. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys technology, problem-solving, and meaningful client interactions.

Accountabilities


Perform data conversions for new customer implementations and support additional data-related activities for existing customers.
Analyze business rules, data structures, and customer requirements to determine effective conversion approaches.
Work directly with customers to understand data conversion needs, resolve issues, and ensure project milestones are achieved.
Create data mapping documentation, project estimates, and conversion-related documentation.
Participate in defining project scope and contribute to implementation planning activities.
Develop data conversion scripts focused on accuracy, efficiency, and reusability.
Build strong knowledge of software functionality, data structures, and system requirements to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Collaborate with Project Managers and implementation teams to monitor timelines, identify risks, and support successful delivery.
Manage multiple concurrent projects while following established processes and recommending improvements where applicable.
Maintain knowledge of industry best practices, technical tools, and data conversion methodologies.
Work with technical support teams to deliver tested and approved data conversions into customer testing and production environments.
Provide excellent customer service throughout the implementation lifecycle.


Requirements


Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Advanced expertise in MS SQL, including complex queries and writing data conversion scripts.
Experience working with database systems, data transformation, and migration processes.
Ability to interpret business requirements and recommend practical technical solutions.
Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve data-related issues.
Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage deadlines and multiple priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-focused mindset.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and handle project pressure.
Positive, proactive attitude with strong ownership and problem-solving capabilities.
Experience with MS SQL Reporting Services or equivalent reporting tools is an asset.
Experience with ESRI ArcGIS or similar geographic information systems is an asset.
Experience with local government applications or comparable enterprise software solutions is an advantage.


Benefits


Fully remote work opportunity across Canada.
Competitive salary range of $55,000-$75,000 CAD per year based on experience.
Opportunity to work on impactful software implementation and data transformation projects.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Supportive and collaborative work environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
Exposure to modern technologies, industry best practices, and complex customer environments.
Opportunity to contribute ideas and improvements within a growing technology team.

Join a Challenger

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving? The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

We can’t wait to get to know you!

The Analyst, Credit Risk, reports to the Director, Credit Risk Management, and supports the leadership team with respect to the management of credit risk across the Bank.

Core Responsibilities

Portfolio Analytics:


Monitor the credit card loan portfolio and perform analytics for identifying relevant trends, insights and provide ad-hoc credit risk reports to members of senior management and to support quarterly board reporting
Assisting in the development and implementation of strategic risk management initiatives
Collaborating cross-functionally to provide valuable insights supporting decision-making processes

Title: Project Administrator
Description:
POSITION SUMMARY




The Project Administrator provides coordination and documentation support to ensure the efficient delivery of construction and infrastructure projects. Operating within the project delivery team, this role maintains accuracy, organization, and compliance across all project records, including onboarding, financial documentation, and client reporting.




The Project Administrator acts as the administrative backbone between the field and office, ensuring that safety, payroll, quality, and project documentation meet company and client standards. This position requires a strong understanding of construction documentation processes, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced project environment.




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES




Project Documentation & Administration

Maintain organized project files, correspondence, and document transmittals in accordance with company document control procedures.
Support onboarding and credential verification for employees, contractors, and subcontractors.
Prepare weekly progress reports and assist with project cost tracking in collaboration with the project team.
Coordinate with payroll and finance teams to process timesheets, purchase orders, invoices, and other project-related documentation.




Compliance & Record Management

Track and maintain training, safety, and inspection documentation (e.g., Working at Heights, WHMIS 2015, First Aid).
Ensure permits, drawings, specifications, and quality documentation are current, complete, and readily available for audits or project needs.
Maintain confidentiality and data integrity within project management and document control systems (e.g., Viewpoint, Procore, SharePoint).




Project Support & Communication

Assist Project Managers and Project Coordinators with meeting scheduling, agenda preparation, minutes, and action item tracking.
Liaise with field personnel, clients, subcontractors, and internal departments to ensure timely communication and information flow.
Provide administrative support for project reporting, workforce training records, and other project documentation as required.




Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Promote and support a strong safety culture by adhering to company policies and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.
Contribute to process improvements that enhance project administration efficiency and documentation quality.




ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS




Education & Experience

Diploma in Business Administration, Construction Administration, or a related field.
2–4 years of administrative experience supporting construction, industrial, utilities, energy, or infrastructure projects.
Experience with project documentation, document control, and project administration is considered an asset.




Skills & Abilities

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, and project management/document control platforms (e.g., Viewpoint, Procore, SharePoint).
Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a collaborative, customer-focused approach.
Knowledge of applicable occupational health and safety legislation and general construction project workflows.
Valid Class 5/G driver's licence (or provincial equivalent). Working at Heights and WHMIS certifications are considered assets and may be required prior to site access, depending on project requirements.

Title: Sr. IT Support Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. IT Support Analyst based in Canada.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced IT professional to take on a senior technical support role within a fast-paced managed services environment. You will serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues while contributing to infrastructure projects, system maintenance, and continuous service improvement. Working with modern cloud and enterprise technologies, you will help ensure reliable IT operations for a diverse client base while mentoring junior team members and promoting technical excellence. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys troubleshooting challenging environments, collaborating across teams, and delivering exceptional customer service with a proactive mindset.

Accountabilities


Act as the primary escalation point for complex hardware, software, networking, and infrastructure issues, delivering advanced troubleshooting and timely resolution.
Manage and prioritize support requests in accordance with established service level agreements while maintaining clear communication with clients throughout the resolution process.
Monitor client systems using remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools, proactively addressing alerts, performance issues, software updates, and system health.
Perform server administration tasks including patch management, vulnerability remediation, performance tuning, and ongoing maintenance.
Contribute to client infrastructure projects such as cloud migrations, server upgrades, network deployments, and office technology rollouts.
Create, maintain, and improve technical documentation, knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.
Analyze ticket trends, identify recurring issues, and recommend process improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
Mentor and support Level 1 technicians through coaching, documentation reviews, and technical knowledge sharing.
Participate in an on-call rotation to provide after-hours support for critical production incidents when required.


Requirements


College diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Minimum of 3 years of hands-on IT support or help desk experience in a technical support environment.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft 365, and Windows-based enterprise environments.
Experience supporting servers, end-user devices, networking technologies, and common business applications.
Familiarity with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V, networking fundamentals, VoIP, backup solutions, and infrastructure management.
Working knowledge of PowerShell scripting for automation and administration tasks.
Experience using help desk ticketing systems, RMM platforms, and technical documentation tools.
Understanding of ITIL principles and willingness to obtain ITIL Foundation certification within six months of employment.
Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment is highly desirable.
Microsoft, Azure, CompTIA, virtualization, or ITIL certifications are considered strong assets.
Excellent analytical, communication, documentation, customer service, and mentoring skills.


Benefits


Competitive salary of $65,000-$75,000 plus eligibility for a discretionary bonus.
Comprehensive health and dental coverage, including a flexible Health Spending Account (HSA).
Group RRSP matching program to support long-term financial planning.
Continuing education, professional development, and tuition assistance opportunities.
Flexible work-from-home options where applicable.
Employee recognition and rewards program.
Collaborative, inclusive, and supportive team culture.
Opportunities to work on innovative client projects with modern cloud and infrastructure technologies.
Casual dress code, free snacks and beverages, on-site parking, and company-sponsored lunches.
Regular team events and social activities that encourage collaboration and connection.
Additional compensation or time off for participation in the on-call support rotation.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Our Ontario client is looking for a Data Analyst to help transform field data into meaningful insights that improve decision-making.

This is a full-time perm position. 5 days/week onsite in Newmarket, ON. You will be getting paid hourly. Overtime (Remote) will be expected and compensated.

Reporting to the Lead Data Analyst, you will be responsible for managing data generated through their proprietary mobile applications, ensuring data quality, developing analytics and reporting tools, and supporting continuous improvements to their data environment.

Responsibilities


Manage, validate, and analyze data collected through the proprietary field reporting platform.
Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for both internal teams and utility clients.
Perform quality assurance on incoming datasets and investigate data inconsistencies or anomalies.
Utilize strong analytical analysis, using excel and other methods (excel capabilities are a requirement).
Maintain and optimize reporting databases, data sources, security, and metadata.
Troubleshoot reporting issues and implement improvements to enhance data quality and reporting performance.
Develop and automate data cleansing, validation, and reporting processes.
Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and clients to understand reporting requirements and implement data solutions.
Prepare data extracts and support integrations with external systems, including GIS and enterprise databases.
Train internal staff and clients on reporting tools and dashboard functionality.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes and improve reporting efficiency.


Must Have


Experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas (e.g., XLOOKUP, TEXTJOIN, COUNTIFS), PivotTables, and VBA.
Experience with SQL and database querying.


Nice To Have


Experience with Python, R, Power BI, or other data analysis and visualization tools
Familiarity with SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Established in 1973, Roots is a proudly Canadian lifestyle brand that celebrates authenticity, quality, and community. Inspired by the great outdoors, we create timeless, sustainable apparel and leather goods designed for comfort and everyday adventure. At Roots, we believe in fostering a culture of inclusivity, creativity, and teamwork – where every team member plays a role in shaping our brand’s legacy. If you bring passion to everything you do, lead with integrity, and believe in the power of collaboration to drive growth, we’d love to have you on our journey!

Nature & Scope → Your Role at Roots

As an Analytics Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics, turning raw retail data into trusted, scalable assets and the insights that bring them to life. As a collaborative member of our data team, you'll contribute to the data models that power solutions across the Roots business and help build the data products, semantic layers, and self-service tools that empower every team at Roots to access trusted data independently. Our data team is small and collaborative, meaning you'll wear multiple hats and have broad exposure across the business.

Key Responsibilities → How You’ll Make An Impact


Support end-to-end data transformation, converting raw omnichannel source data (POS, e-commerce, inventory, CRM, and marketing) into clean, structured layers within Snowflake.
Contribute to the design and build of components of the Snowflake data mart, applying dimensional modelling best practices including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions, to help create reliable, performant data products that serve ad hoc analysis, BI dashboards, and AI data solutions.
Support Power BI report development end-to-end, from semantic model design to polished, publish-ready reports, giving commercial, merchandising, marketing, and finance teams self-service access to trusted data without analyst dependency.
Perform ad hoc analysis using SQL and Python directly in Snowflake to help answer pressing business questions, uncover trends, and deliver timely insights that inform planning, buying, and operational decisions.
Assist in maintaining data quality standards, including testing frameworks, pipeline alerting, and documentation, to help ensure the data mart is trustworthy and well-understood across the business.
Support the development and maintenance of Gen AI data solutions, including natural language interfaces enabling any business user to query the data mart in plain English.
Partner cross-functionally with merchandising, planning, marketing, and commercial teams to understand analytical needs and help translate them into scalable data products.
Participate in the continuous improvement of our data platform, contributing ideas around new tools, patterns, and AI capabilities that keep Roots ahead of the curve.


Qualifications & Experience → The Skills You Bring


3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or an equivalent data analytics role.
Strong SQL proficiency and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
Hands-on experience with ELT/ETL platforms, with Matillion or a similar cloud-native transformation tool preferred.
Proficiency building data models and dashboards with Power BI.
Solid understanding of dimensional modelling methodologies including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions.
Experience with version control using Git.
Familiarity with data quality practices including testing, documentation, and pipeline monitoring.
Exposure to Gen AI solutions such as Snowflake Cortex or Microsoft Fabric Copilot is preferred.
Retail or apparel industry experience across omnichannel environments is an asset.
Python proficiency for data transformation, ad hoc analysis, or automation is a plus.


At Roots we appreciate that skills and expertise are cultivated through a range of experiences. We are committed to reflecting Canada's diverse landscape in our products, team, and workplace culture. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. Accommodations are available for applicants throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Roots uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. These tools may be used to help review applications, assess qualifications, and support interview documentation. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by our Talent team and key leaders involved in the recruitment process.

The posted salary range is intended to reflect the competitive market value of this role and is provided to support transparency in our hiring process. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to internal equity, relevant skills, demonstrated knowledge, experience, and overall fit for the position.

Title: Transportation Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description




Position: Transportation Data Analyst

Type: Full-Time | Hybrid

Location: Brampton, ON

Reports to: Senior Manager, Inbound Transportation




About Us

Pet Valu is Canada’s leading pet specialty retailer, dedicated to strengthening the bond between dedicated pet lovers and their pets. With 50 years of animal care expertise, we operate over 800 stores across Canada under several banners, including Pet Valu, Bosley’s, Total Pet, Paulmac's Pet, Tisol & Chico. Guided by our mission to deliver products, care, expertise, and memorable moments, Pet Valu is a place where people build meaningful careers while making a positive impact on pets and communities.




What will you do?

Pet Valu’s supply chain has grown significantly as the company has expanded, supported by a $100M investment in supply chain technology and facilities. As part of this investment, Pet Valu launched Manhattan Active Transportation Management to improve network planning, centralize transportation data, and strengthen reporting and operational visibility. Pet Valu’s transportation team is responsible for the movement of all collect inbound freight to the company’s three distribution centres across Canada, and outbound to 800+ stores.

The Transportation Data Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and cost-effectiveness of inbound and outbound transportation data and spend. This role oversees transportation data within the TMS, supports freight audit activities by validating carrier charges and logistics metrics, and develops reporting and KPI insights that drive data-based decision-making. The analyst also helps maintain system configurations, support cost allocation processes, identify opportunities to improve transportation performance and reduce expenses, and partner closely with internal supply chain and IT teams, as well as external freight carriers, to maintain efficient and effective transportation operations across Canada.




Responsibilities

Data Management and Governance

Own the data for the transportation management system by being the subject matter expert for all TMS data, working with IT teams on data flows, and implementing technical business rules, including maintenance carrier, lane, and rate data
Developing and maintain KPI reports for supply chain, and communicate performance results and insights to stakeholders
Manage setup, collection, and analysis of bid data for carrier RFPs




Data Analysis and Reporting

Conduct in-depth data analysis to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for optimization. Develop and maintain comprehensive, automated reports and dashboards using advanced data visualization tools. Present complex data insights to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner
Develop common metrics and data processes that drive business outcomes. Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices in data management and analytics, and recommend innovative solutions to improve data-driven decision-making.




Freight Invoice Audit & Validation

Review and audit outbound freight invoices to ensure accuracy against contracted rates, routing guides, and shipment details
Identify and resolve discrepancies such as incorrect rates, accessorial charges, or duplicate billing
Approve validated invoices for payment processing




Training and Support

Provide training and support to end-users on TMS data tools and best practices. Mentor junior analysts and other team members to enhance their analytical and technical skills.
Vacation / sick time coverage as necessary




Qualifications & Experience

Minimum of 4 years' experience in supply chain / logistics activities
Experience with TMS, WMS, optimization tools, or network modeling preferred
Experience with Excel, PowerBI, Access, Cognos, Snowflake, and other database and analytics tools
Experience with data analysis and building KPI tools




Compensation

The targeted salary range for this position is $65,000-$75,000 annually. The final offer will be based on factors such as market location, relevant skills, experience and internal equity.




Ready to join the team?

We’re looking for passionate people who bring strong skills and live our core values of safety, compassion, expertise, and efficiency every day. If you’re energized by doing meaningful work, taking pride in what you deliver, and making a real impact for pets, people, and communities, you’ll feel right at home here. Join us and build a career where purpose, care, and excellence come together - because love lives here™.




About

At Pet Valu, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We’re passionate about creating an environment where you feel supported, included, and empowered to grow - both personally and professionally. Some of the perks of working with us include:




Hybrid, Flexible Work Options
Comprehensive health and dental benefits
Employee Share Purchase Plan with company matching
Learning and Development support tailored to you
An inclusive, collaborative culture where your voice matters
Fun company events that keep us connected
Preferred rates for car rentals, hotels, phone plans and gym discounts
Generous employee discounts on our products




Pet Valu is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusion and accessibility. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process, in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA).




At Pet Valu, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Pet Valu may use AI enabled technology to assist in the recruitment process for positions. The use of AI helps us ensure we are providing an equitable and streamlined recruitment experience for all applicants. While AI tools support our recruitment process, all decisions throughout the process are made exclusively by Pet Valu’s hiring team. At no stage does AI determine recruitment outcomes.

We are seeking a highly analytical and solutions-oriented Data Analyst to support Workplace Benefits and Retirement.

This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams and our Field Sales and Service partners. The successful candidate will possess a deep curiosity for understanding data, adept at identifying anomalies, investigating discrepancies, and the ability to design and implement efficient data-driven solutions.

In addition, the Data Analyst will build and evolve analytical reporting using Power BI, Excel, and SQL. By digging into performance results, identifying key trends, and translating complex data into clear insights, the role provides the information needed for data‑driven action to help move our business grow.

Analyze, interpret, and validate large data volume to identify trends, inconsistencies, and anomalies
Provide technical and functional support on complex compensation programs, support decision-making with sound judgement backed by data, and mentor team
Write and optimize SQL queries to support data retrieval and reporting
Maintain tools and scripts using VB.NET to support business needs
Translate complex datasets into clear, compelling insights and business narratives
Work with stakeholders to improve data availability, quality, and drive automation
Ensure data accuracy and integrity through validation, reconciliation, and quality checks
Help resolve issues, perform analysis, and support application enhancements
Document data flows, models, and solutions to ensure sustainability


What You Will Bring


3+ years of hands-on experience with:
Data modeling concepts and tools
SQL (query development, optimization)
VB.NET
Power Automate
Power Apps
Power BI
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into manageable components
Ability to model, structure, validate, and document complex datasets to support accurate and reliable decision‑making
Experience improving manual operational processes, including the ability to streamline or automate validation workflows
Proven experience identifying errors, inconsistencies, and anomalies in data
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
A proactive mindset — you seek to understand the purpose behind requests and consistently look for opportunities to improve processes and outcomes

Title: Data Scientist, Analytics (Remote, Canada)
Description:
Data Scientist, Analytics

(Remote, Canada)

Events in recent years have made us all too familiar with the havoc that natural disasters can wreak, and the increasing frequency and intensity with which they are occurring. Despite record levels of losses, conventional methods of risk modeling continue to paint at best an incomplete picture of these threats.

ZestyAI uses novel data gathering and data science methods to produce higher quality information about the risks to property from catastrophes like storms and wildfires. While AI alone may not be able to thwart these disasters, it can help us become more prepared for them, and ultimately that will lead to better outcomes.

As a Data Scientist, Analytics, you will work closely with product, engineering, and machine learning teams to apply data science to complex product and business problems.You will use diverse data sources to evaluate product performance, generate actionable insights, and support evidence-based decision-making across ZestyAI's products.You will also help establish the analytical processes, monitoring frameworks, and best practices needed to maintain product quality and scale the organization. You thrive in a collaborative, creative environment that moves fast and are comfortable implementing structures and processes to help the company scale.

The Opportunity:


Translate product management, engineering, and business questions into structured analytical approaches, applying appropriate statistical, experimental, and data science methods to measure product performance and guide decision-making
Own data quality of ZestyAI data products
Spearhead product monitoring and quality assurance by designing and owning dashboards and KPIs
Develop automated ETL and data workflows
Iterate rapidly on everything; all of the above happens in a fast-paced business-driven environment that you must be comfortable with


What You Bring to the ZestyAI Team:


BA / BS degree in Math, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Economics
MS or Ph.D. is certainly a bonus
2–3 years of experience in analytics, data science, or related roles, including experience building data workflows, defining metrics, and developing dashboards or monitoring tools
Strong organizational and management skills with past experiences implementing best practices and processes
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous, cross-functional questions
Proficient in SQL
Proficient in programming language (Python or R)
Experience working with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, etc)
Must be legally eligible to work in Canada

Nice to Have:


1 - 2 years of experience working with imagery and/or geospatial data
Working knowledge of modeling framework and performance metrics
Familiarity with, or an interest in, experimental design, causal inference, and applied statistical methods
DBT Experience
Prefect (or another workflow tool like Airflow) Experience
Data Visualization Experience


Why ZestyAI:


Be part of a well-funded growth-stage company
Market competitive comp and equity incentives to give you a stake in our future
Comprehensive health care plan
Flexible Time Off
An upbeat and collaborative work culture
Company-sponsored outings and offsites
