Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Title: Transportation Optimization Analyst
Description:
Pival International Inc. is a global logistics and supply chain management company with a comprehensive menu of warehousing logistics solutions and transportation solutions, including time sensitivity (land and air), FTL, LTL, intermodal.

Our work is guided by three core values that define who we are and how we operate:


Integrity – We act with honesty, transparency, and respect in every interaction.
Commitment – We take ownership, follow through on our responsibilities, and strive for excellence.
Curiosity – We embrace learning, asking questions, and seeking continuous improvement.


These values are central to how we deliver quality, collaborate as a team, and support our customers. They are reflected in every role across the organization and guide our decisions, behaviors, and growth.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, the incumbent of this role will primarily work in conjunction with Sales (Business Development and Customer Success), Transportation Operations, Warehouse Operations, Finance, and IT to manage and oversee financial, business and supply chain analyses. The incumbent will be a solid communicator capable of analyzing clients’ supply chain data (DC network, shipment data profile, inventory levels, etc.) to recommend improved Supply Chain solutions and present findings to senior level internal stakeholders and/or high-profile clientele. Success in the role will be defined by the efficient use of analytical and operational expertise of the incumbent to drive financial performance and enhance profitability within the company.

Role Responsibilities

Pricing and Contract Support:


Supports company’s internal RFP process with Transportation and Distribution pricing solutions; Provides pricing and profitability analyses for prospective opportunities
Reviews, writes, distributes and documents all contracts for new customers
Supports the customer onboarding process from a financial standpoint - including customer set-up, billing set-up, contract management, contract compliance, etc.
Supports company’s competitive bid efforts in all external Transportation and Warehousing partners’ RFP/RFQ opportunities


Others (Routine)


Prepares and presents monthly revenue reports – Distribution Centers, Distribution & Transportation Customers
Maintains monthly KPIs and create Performance Dashboards for Sales, Distribution, Transportation and Finance to be presented to leadership during monthly S&OP meetings
Maintains and updates standard rate cards in response to market demands and PiVAL operations
Collaborates with Finance and IT to ensure existing and new Transportation contracts (Carrier cost rates and client sell rates) are accurately captured in the TMS
Assists Transportation Operations in streamlining end-to-end transportation needs to deliver the required Transportation service at the optimal cost.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Serving the needs of all families with young children, Carter’s Inc. is the largest North American apparel retailer exclusively for babies and young children, encompassing Carter’s, OshKosh B’gosh, Skip*Hop and Little Planet brands. Meaningful work, constant learning, genuine people, and a community guided by core values that promote inclusion and innovation is in everything we do. There are many reasons to build your career at Carter's.

How You’ll Make An Impact

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst to support better and efficient decision making for the business. This role requires a combination of business acumen, technical skills, and the ability to translate data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in building and maintaining complex dashboards using BI tools used by the company and working with large retail datasets. This role will partner closely with business leaders in Canada as pricing, assortment, planning, and allocation capabilities are implemented and improved.

Planning Operations and Reporting (80%)


Design, develop and maintain reporting and act as a Tableau expert to create complex dashboards, standardized reports and self-service reporting solutions.
Perform data validation, quality assurance, and troubleshooting to ensure accuracy and consistency across reports.
Write and maintain SQL queries for advanced data analysis and data manipulation when needed.
Provide ad hoc reporting to the Planning & Allocation team as needed.
Supports teams with training on Tableau (or any other BI Tool adopted for reporting) and training material.


Relationship Management and Collaboration (20%)


Develop a strong collaboration with the corporate BI team for any added support.
Partners with cross-functional project leads and monitor project timeline at times in partnerships with different functions.
Support Retail senior leadership team with data, insights, and presentation materials on future capabilities and project status updates when required for larger projects, work closely with outside parties to implement solutions.


WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF: Must have:


2-3 Years of Experience in a Data Analyst role.
Advanced knowledge and proficiency in Tableau.
Strong SQL skills for querying large data sets.
Strong communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Skills And Experience


Degree or Diploma in Data Analytics or related field or equivalent work experience.
Exposure to Retail Planning, KPIs and fundamentals.


Our Team Members


Lead Courageously: Have a strong sense of personal values that align with our Company values
Collaborates Broadly: Build cooperation, trust, and thrive in a consensus driven environment
Customer Focus: Proactively seek opportunities to leverage data and fact-based insights to serve customers and/or internal clients
Drive Growth: Set aggressive goals and implement plans precisely
Cultivates Innovation: Respectfully challenge the “we’ve always done it this way” mentality and explore new ways to achieve desired outcomes


Make a Career At Carter’s


Career Development: Success starts from within, and we have several paths from which you can choose to


enhance your career evolution. From Carter’s University to Toastmasters to mentorship programs and more,

we encourage you to utilize these tools to elevate your professional prowess.

Description:
Work Location Type: Hybrid

As a leading industrial distributor with operations primarily in North America, Japan and the United Kingdom, We Keep The World Working® by serving more than 4.5 million customers worldwide with products delivered through innovative technology and deep customer relationships. We’re dedicated to providing value for customers, fostering an engaging culture for team members and driving strong financial results.

Our welcoming workplace enables you to learn, grow and make a difference by keeping businesses running and their people safe. As a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company, we’re looking for passionate people to join our team as we continue leading the industry over our next 100 years.

Compensation

The base salary for this role ranges between $73,520 - $101,090, with eligibility for an incentive target of 5% which is contingent upon achieving both individual and company performance objectives.

The pay range above is not a guarantee of compensation but reflects the potential total compensation for this role at the time of this posting based on the assigned job grade. Actual compensation will vary depending on factors such as geographic work location, relevant experience and individual skills. The stated range is a reasonable estimate and may change over time; final compensation may fall above or below the range provided. Grainger reserves the right to amend, modify, or discontinue its compensation and benefits programs at any time, in accordance with applicable law.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

Position Summary

The Pricing Analyst is responsible for developing contract and non‑contract pricing program strategies and supporting the execution and analysis of WFS overall pricing approach. Reporting to the Business Intelligence Manager, this role will conduct detailed pricing and financial analyses and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive profitable growth.

The role supports the implementation of pricing and discounting strategies by providing analysis, modeling, and insights that inform execution across the business.

The successful candidate brings a deep understanding of competitive dynamics and business economics and knows how to bring pricing strategies to life across multiple channels.

This position partners with business leaders to support and advance pricing strategies and plans through rigorous analysis, modeling, and insights that inform decision-making.

Job Responsibilities (You Will)


Pricing Strategy & Analysis
Develops contract and non-contract pricing strategies using customer, financial, and market data.
Evaluates competitive pricing activity and recommends responses based on quantified business impact.
Modeling & Advanced Analytics
Builds and maintains pricing, forecasting, and financial impact models.
Applies statistical and data modeling techniques to transactional data to inform pricing recommendations.
Execution & Enablement
Supports pricing execution through QRP price-point maintenance and post-implementation analysis.
Partners with cross-functional teams to ensure pricing decisions are operationalized effectively.
Insight & Communication
Synthesizes complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders.
Conducts post-implementation reviews and recommends continuous improvements.
Process & Governance
Contributes to the improvement of pricing tools, processes, and governance frameworks.

Education/Experience (You Have)


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
3–5 years of experience in pricing, analytics, or a data-focused analytical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL; experience working with large, complex datasets.
Strong financial and analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights.
Experience with Snowflake and Power BI.
Experience with R or Python.
Exposure to pricing, commercial analytics, or revenue management.
Experience partnering with cross-functional business teams.


Rewards And Benefits

Our programs provide choice and flexibility to meet your individual needs. Check out some of the benefits available to you with Grainger (may vary based on hours worked):


Medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
Paid time off (PTO) and up to 12 company holidays per year (dependent on home province)
Life insurance coverage, including spousal and dependent life insurance.
Employee Family Assistance Program to help team members with physical, emotional, mental, financial and other concerns
Registered Retirement Savings Plan & Defined Contribution Pension Plan to help you save for your financial future
Educational & Professional Membership Fee Assistance program
Employee discounts, team member perks and more!

We aspire to create a culture where everyone is comfortable being who they are, can learn and grow to realize their full potential, and is recognized and rewarded for their impact.

All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disability. Should you need a reasonable accommodation during the application and selection process, please advise us so we can provide appropriate assistance.

Pre-employment background checks are required for all external candidates. Internal candidates undergo a background check when they move from a non-driving role to a driving role.

Title: Quality Improvement Decision Support Specialist
Description:
Together, we do amazing things every day.




Imagine a supportive employer, a career that fits your lifestyle, and many learning opportunities. With the Hamilton Family Health Team, you can have all of that, and more. We work hard to create an innovative and diverse workplace that values the contributions of our employees. No matter what your role, working with us is about making a difference – every day!




Your Opportunity:

The Quality Improvement Decision Support Specialist (QIDSS) is responsible for supporting primary care practices across the Hamilton Family Health Team (HFHT). Facilitates development and implementation of quality improvement plans/initiatives, and engaging teams in the use of data to support quality improvement goals and clinical process change.




Roles and Responsibilities:

• Collaborate closely with teams engaged in quality improvement to identify, performance measurement information and data quality needs,

• Support the development and implementation of quality improvement plans,

• Support decision making by developing, generating, analyzing and interpreting extracted health information,

• Ensure high quality data is available for extraction by developing and implementing systems to identify, tract, correct and prevent errors,

• Identify gaps in data availability, and define and implement solutions to close the gaps,

• Provide consultative and analytical support regarding the collection, interpretation, analysis and presentation of data to teams,

• Act as a change agent and coach to teams on data management and performance measurement,

• Provide guidance and support to teams regarding the collection, interpretation, analysis and presentation of data to improve patient care and align with best practice,

• Facilitates the development of effective working relationships with diverse teams,

• Take leadership roles in connecting teams and spreading best practices,

• Contribute actively to local and provincial quality improvement initiatives,




Qualifications and Skills:

• A university degree in a related discipline (E-Health /Health Informatics, Business Administration, Statistics, Health Sciences or Information Management), where possible combined with clinical experience in primary care or equivalent education and experience,

• Highly effective communication, presentation and interpersonal skills and a proven ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with partners, Working knowledge of adult education theory and methods,

• Experience creating a positive and inclusive learning environment,

• Understanding of the importance of vision and enthusiasm in creating and promoting change,

• Knowledge of primary care practice and demonstrated interest in the use of data for quality improvement,

• Ability to handle a variety of concurrent assignments and to work independently,

• Valid Ontario driver’s license,

• Strong applied knowledge of one or more EMR/HER systems currently in use in Ontario and willingness to become proficient in other systems,

• Demonstrates proficiency in programming in a language used to extract data from EMR (e.g. SQL) is required,

• Knowledge of additional report writing and statistical analysis packages (SSRS, SSIS, SSAS or Crystal Reports ) and a demonstrated ability to learn similar packages quickly will be considered an asset,




Why join the HFHT?

Competitive Employee Value Proposition including, but not limited to:

• Healthcare of Ontario Pension (HOOPP)

• Meaningful, purpose-based work

• 12 paid Stat holidays and one (1) extra float day

• Flexible work schedule

• Ongoing green initiatives




Summary

Classification: Non-Union

Primary Location: Hamilton; Hybrid work

Employee Class: Full-Time; 40hrs/week

Schedule: Monday-Friday; 8hrs/day

Salary: $74,600 - $85,226.50




Application Instructions:

Interested applicants please submit résumé and cover letter as one document using naming convention Last name, First name_Position by email: hr@hamiltonfht.ca




Note:

If successful in receiving a job offer with the Hamilton Family Health Team, new hires may be required to provide proof of full COVID-19 vaccination prior to start date as a condition of their employment. If successful candidates are unable to get their COVID-19 vaccination as a result of a medical exemption, they may be required to submit supporting documentation to establish that they are exempt from this requirement.




The HFHT is committed to building a respectful, caring, equitable, and inclusive workplace where staff reflect the diversity of the communities that we serve. Title: Data Analyst, SMB Self-Serve
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data and analytics are at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to support our Self-Serve segment — the fastest-growing part of Lyft's B2B portfolio, serving small and mid-size businesses across North America. This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, dbt) is a plus
Comfortable using AI coding and analytics tools — LLM assistants, agentic SQL/analysis workflows — to accelerate extraction, exploration, and reporting, while reviewing and validating every query, result, and insight before it reaches stakeholders; you own the correctness of the output, not the tool
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Title: Analyst, Data Governance
Description:
What You Will Do


Data Governance Leadership: Support the development, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and enforcement of data governance standards, policies, procedures, and controls to ensure adherence to privacy, compliance, risk, regulatory, and legal requirements. This includes AI Governance to ensure ethical use and compliance with regulatory standards for AI-driven processes.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with leadership, IT departments, business units, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk teams, data producers and consumers, and IT data platform teams to align on data governance goals and support the operationalization of a robust data governance framework.
Promote data literacy by developing materials and conducting training on best practices.
Policy Development: Assist in the creation and enforcement of data management policies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Contribute to shaping the data governance accountabilities and operating model and enable data stewardship.
Data Quality Assurance: Contribute to the enhancement and implementation of robust data quality frameworks and conduct regular audits to maintain high data standards.
Support the development and evolution of data governance metrics and KPIs; monitor & measure the overall efficacy of the data governance program.
Proactively monitor data, metadata, and reference data to ensure quality across the CTB data lifecycle.
Implement and leverage data governance tools and platforms to enable capabilities; manage and maintain metadata and other data governance artifacts such as glossaries, classifications, and lineage.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks related to data governance and develop mitigation strategies.
Support data sharing and collaboration across teams and departments; ensure proper data access, usability, and monitoring of data sharing agreements.
Project Oversight: Contribute to large-scale data governance projects from inception to completion.
Stay updated on industry trends, standards, and regulatory requirements related to data governance; recommend appropriate modifications to existing policies and practices.


What You Bring


Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, or a related field.
Proven experience with corporate data environments supporting cross-functional governance.
Proficient in PL\SQL and confident working in a structured data environment.
Knowledge of business intelligence, modern data warehousing techniques, cloud solutions such as Azure or GCP.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes and modern integration frameworks like API and event streaming.
Experience in IBM Cloud Pak for Data and/or Databricks Unity Catalog.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Visio, PowerPoint, and Excel.
Expertise in creating/enforcing data governance policies to ensure data integrity, privacy, compliance, security.
Ability to work with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Risk partners
Hands-on experience with data analysis, quality assessment, metadata management.
Excellent communication skills for presenting complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to problem-solve and handle ambiguity.
Effective stakeholder management; ability to build trusted relationships and influence decision-making.
Experience in process design/improvement initiatives and leveraging automation.
CDMP certification is an asset.

Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs

Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts

Title: Senior Analyst, Marketing
Description:
Why Meridian?

At Meridian our aspiration is to integrate our purpose into everything we do for people, the planet, and communities. We believe that our greatest opportunity is to create opportunity and meet people where they are.

Factor us into your next career opportunity. We want you to grow with us and have an experience that’s different. This is a place where you can expect the unexpected.

Find our story here: About Meridian

The role: The Senior Marketing Analyst provides proactive, actionable, analytical support and business insight to

marketing department, as well as their stakeholders (LOBs). The role will have significant impact on Meridian’s marketing strategy, as they are responsible for segmenting, deploying and executing the communication of marketing campaigns, product launches and focused research. As a subject matter expert, the Senior Marketing Analyst demonstrates an ability to present complicated analytical material in a concise and compelling manner and, interpret insights in a meaningful way for

management and partners.

The role will support the advancement of analytics and data management, processes, and tools to contribute to the achievement of Meridian’s strategic and in year goals and improve business profitability. In partnership with colleagues, this role will maintain existing marketing reporting while working to improve and refine processes through the integration of AI and automation.

This is an 18 Month Contract opportunity

Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Insights


Measure the effectiveness of Marketing tactics (paid, organic, brand, email, website, social etc.) while you partner with the marketing team to set goals, measure results, and share actionable insights. Build and develop models that help to accelerate marketing’s long term strategic plans.
Analyze, prepare and present scheduled reports (i.e. key business performance indicators, and dashboards) and ad hoc reports (i.e. in support of organizational projects or initiatives) for the marketing team, both proactively and upon request.
Lead the development of management reporting that empowers leaders to take action, by converting data into meaningful information that identifies issues, opportunities and emerging trends.
Foster cross-functional collaboration across all MCU departments—particularly with Enterprise Analytics & Data, Data Governance and Culture, Member Experience Services, and Sales—to streamline communication, gather data, define terms and conditions, and consolidate information from multiple platforms into a centralized source for segmentation and reporting.
Leads qualitative and quantitative analysis of relevant industry and consumer behaviour trends to identify revenue opportunities and grow our capital base.
Assists with the development of various programs by collecting, analysing and collating Member and prospect information ensuring that Meridian delivers a personalized solution that is in relation to their transactional, advice or price-driven relationships while also considering long-term Member value.
Analyze prospect and Member-level information to determine the effectiveness of campaigns and generate additional profitability-enhancing strategies
Networks with other like-minded individuals within the Enterprise Analytics and Data community at Meridian, as well as industry events, to keep abreast of new solutions, resources, and analytical techniques


Execution


Employ Marketing experiments, test-and-learns, A-B testing, etc, with the focus to continually improve our Member experience and increasing KPIs such as response rates, balance growth and cross-sell
Identify key business opportunities for growth by profiling the existing Member base and assessing emerging needs through industry research and competitive analysis.
Proficient in leveraging diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, internal banking systems, Google, Meta) to scope, segment, and prepare audience lists, ensuring accurate and timely system integration and deployments.
Primary lead on verifying data quality, personalization, and quality execution across all transactional and Marketing communications and journeys. Ensuring adherence to industry regulations such as CASL & PII.
Collaborate with Enterprise Analytics team to develop models such as product profitability or propensity models
Support the improvement of marketing attribution using tools such as marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution


Communication & Business Solutions


Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of the organization (operational staff to Executive to Board of Directors) and the ability to obtain required information to support or develop analysis.
Interprets results and delivers information and/or presentations with impact
Effectively demonstrates the ability to explain complex information and concepts to different audiences, including professionals in a manner tailored to the audience and elicits receptivity
Coordinates the acquisition of data from various, relevant data sources and applies analytical skills to convert data into meaningful information.
Demonstrates an ability to leverage technology to streamline processes, tools and analysis and seeks out opportunities to leverage AI and other automation tools to increase department efficiency
Support CRM in partnership with Centre of Excellence on future enhancements and capabilities within the platform.
Review key marketing strategies to collect requirements and design solutions with marketing operations, IT and Digital teams, ensuring the necessary data is integrated into various platforms, such as CRM (Dynamics 365), to support the operation of marketing journeys, processes, and campaign measurement.
In partnership with Marketing Operations, conduct User Acceptance (UAT) and Post-Production testing to ensure proposed solutions work as intended.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong working knowledge of an analytics stack, working with analytics tools, data warehouses and data visualization tools
Strong financial acumen, excellent interpersonal skills and ability interacting with all levels of the organization, including Executive management
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way
Strong process management skills, initiative, ability to manage competing priorities and attention to detail are critical
Technical writing experience in relevant areas, including queries, reports, and presentations
High level of proficiency in designing & developing custom analytics utilizing available or externally obtained data
Business and partnership focused with an understanding of how Marketing enables the business
Aptitude for investigating complex problems and a passion for creative problem-solving. Continuously innovates to achieve great results
A strong business acumen and can translate insights into actionable recommendations that align with business objectives
Ability to establish strong cross functional relationships with proven track record of working successfully with a divergent group of internal business partners
Highly motivated self-starter with high energy and a very positive attitude
Desire to propose changes that proactively seize market opportunities
Forward thinking with an openness to change to identify new opportunities
Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment
Possess a strong attention to detail; be concise without comprising the facts
Experience coaching and mentoring junior teammates
Able to handle confidential and proprietary information with discretion
Member Focus - Personally demonstrating that our Members are our highest priority.
Comfort learning and adopting new digital tools, with an openness to using AI‑enabled technology to enhance productivity, accuracy, and the Member experience


Education, Work Experience, And Professional Designations/Certifications


Degree or diploma in mathematics, statistics or computer science or related discipline
Experience in a financial institution environment with a strong understanding of financial metrics, segmentation and industry drivers.
Five (5+) years' in an analytics driven role with proven analytic skills, including mining, evaluation, analysis, and visualization (ability to analyse large datasets)
Strong SQL and PySpark skills in Fabric environment required, with the ability to learn other analytic tools
Practical experience in statistical analysis through the use of statistical packages including Excel, Power BI and SAS
Working experience in digital analytics using Google Analytics, and Data Studio.
Expert in diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, Google, Meta)
Demonstrated experience working in scripting languages such as Python or R, VBA, to set up automation and integrations is considered an asset.

The role: The Senior Marketing Analyst provides proactive, actionable, analytical support and business insight to

marketing department, as well as their stakeholders (LOBs). The role will have significant impact on Meridian’s marketing strategy, as they are responsible for segmenting, deploying and executing the communication of marketing campaigns, product launches and focused research. As a subject matter expert, the Senior Marketing Analyst demonstrates an ability to present complicated analytical material in a concise and compelling manner and, interpret insights in a meaningful way for

management and partners.

The role will support the advancement of analytics and data management, processes, and tools to contribute to the achievement of Meridian’s strategic and in year goals and improve business profitability. In partnership with colleagues, this role will maintain existing marketing reporting while working to improve and refine processes through the integration of AI and automation.

This is an 18 Month Contract opportunity

Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Insights

  • Measure the effectiveness of Marketing tactics (paid, organic, brand, email, website, social etc.) while you partner with the marketing team to set goals, measure results, and share actionable insights. Build and develop models that help to accelerate marketing’s long term strategic plans.
  • Analyze, prepare and present scheduled reports (i.e. key business performance indicators, and dashboards) and ad hoc reports (i.e. in support of organizational projects or initiatives) for the marketing team, both proactively and upon request.
  • Lead the development of management reporting that empowers leaders to take action, by converting data into meaningful information that identifies issues, opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration across all MCU departments—particularly with Enterprise Analytics & Data, Data Governance and Culture, Member Experience Services, and Sales—to streamline communication, gather data, define terms and conditions, and consolidate information from multiple platforms into a centralized source for segmentation and reporting.
  • Leads qualitative and quantitative analysis of relevant industry and consumer behaviour trends to identify revenue opportunities and grow our capital base.
  • Assists with the development of various programs by collecting, analysing and collating Member and prospect information ensuring that Meridian delivers a personalized solution that is in relation to their transactional, advice or price-driven relationships while also considering long-term Member value.
  • Analyze prospect and Member-level information to determine the effectiveness of campaigns and generate additional profitability-enhancing strategies
  • Networks with other like-minded individuals within the Enterprise Analytics and Data community at Meridian, as well as industry events, to keep abreast of new solutions, resources, and analytical techniques

Execution

  • Employ Marketing experiments, test-and-learns, A-B testing, etc, with the focus to continually improve our Member experience and increasing KPIs such as response rates, balance growth and cross-sell
  • Identify key business opportunities for growth by profiling the existing Member base and assessing emerging needs through industry research and competitive analysis.
  • Proficient in leveraging diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, internal banking systems, Google, Meta) to scope, segment, and prepare audience lists, ensuring accurate and timely system integration and deployments.
  • Primary lead on verifying data quality, personalization, and quality execution across all transactional and Marketing communications and journeys. Ensuring adherence to industry regulations such as CASL & PII.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Analytics team to develop models such as product profitability or propensity models
  • Support the improvement of marketing attribution using tools such as marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution

Communication & Business Solutions

  • Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of the organization (operational staff to Executive to Board of Directors) and the ability to obtain required information to support or develop analysis.
  • Interprets results and delivers information and/or presentations with impact
  • Effectively demonstrates the ability to explain complex information and concepts to different audiences, including professionals in a manner tailored to the audience and elicits receptivity
  • Coordinates the acquisition of data from various, relevant data sources and applies analytical skills to convert data into meaningful information.
  • Demonstrates an ability to leverage technology to streamline processes, tools and analysis and seeks out opportunities to leverage AI and other automation tools to increase department efficiency
  • Support CRM in partnership with Centre of Excellence on future enhancements and capabilities within the platform.
  • Review key marketing strategies to collect requirements and design solutions with marketing operations, IT and Digital teams, ensuring the necessary data is integrated into various platforms, such as CRM (Dynamics 365), to support the operation of marketing journeys, processes, and campaign measurement.
  • In partnership with Marketing Operations, conduct User Acceptance (UAT) and Post-Production testing to ensure proposed solutions work as intended.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Strong working knowledge of an analytics stack, working with analytics tools, data warehouses and data visualization tools
  • Strong financial acumen, excellent interpersonal skills and ability interacting with all levels of the organization, including Executive management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way
  • Strong process management skills, initiative, ability to manage competing priorities and attention to detail are critical
  • Technical writing experience in relevant areas, including queries, reports, and presentations
  • High level of proficiency in designing & developing custom analytics utilizing available or externally obtained data
  • Business and partnership focused with an understanding of how Marketing enables the business
  • Aptitude for investigating complex problems and a passion for creative problem-solving. Continuously innovates to achieve great results
  • A strong business acumen and can translate insights into actionable recommendations that align with business objectives
  • Ability to establish strong cross functional relationships with proven track record of working successfully with a divergent group of internal business partners
  • Highly motivated self-starter with high energy and a very positive attitude
  • Desire to propose changes that proactively seize market opportunities
  • Forward thinking with an openness to change to identify new opportunities
  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment
  • Possess a strong attention to detail; be concise without comprising the facts
  • Experience coaching and mentoring junior teammates
  • Able to handle confidential and proprietary information with discretion
  • Member Focus - Personally demonstrating that our Members are our highest priority.
  • Comfort learning and adopting new digital tools, with an openness to using AI‑enabled technology to enhance productivity, accuracy, and the Member experience

Education, Work Experience, And Professional Designations/Certifications

  • Degree or diploma in mathematics, statistics or computer science or related discipline
  • Experience in a financial institution environment with a strong understanding of financial metrics, segmentation and industry drivers.
  • Five (5+) years' in an analytics driven role with proven analytic skills, including mining, evaluation, analysis, and visualization (ability to analyse large datasets)
  • Strong SQL and PySpark skills in Fabric environment required, with the ability to learn other analytic tools
  • Practical experience in statistical analysis through the use of statistical packages including Excel, Power BI and SAS
  • Working experience in digital analytics using Google Analytics, and Data Studio.
  • Expert in diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, Google, Meta)
  • Demonstrated experience working in scripting languages such as Python or R, VBA, to set up automation and integrations is considered an asset.

  • Critical Thinking – The ability to analyze, evaluate and interpret information from various sources and apply logic and problem solving to make decisions.

Title: Business Insights Analyst
Description:
Employee Type

Permanent

Become a changemaker with Islamic Relief Canada! Join our team and work towards our mission to mobilize Canadians to transform more lives around the world in the most trusted manner.

About The Department

Join our dynamic Marketing Department, where creativity meets purpose. Our team is dedicated to crafting compelling campaigns and content that inspire and engage our community. We strive to amplify our mission, drive donor engagement, and create meaningful impact through innovative strategies and storytelling.

Job Purpose

The Business Insights Analyst serves as a strategic partner to Marketing, Fundraising, Donor Relations, and Senior Leadership teams by transforming data into actionable business insights. This role goes beyond traditional reporting to uncover growth opportunities, predict future outcomes, optimize donor experiences, and drive evidence-based decision making across the organization.

Leveraging advanced analytics, business intelligence, predictive modeling, and emerging AI technologies, the Business Analytics Specialist will identify key drivers of fundraising performance, donor engagement, operational efficiency, and organizational growth. The successful candidate will combine analytical expertise with business acumen to influence strategy and help shape the future direction of the organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


Revenue Growth & Campaign Optimization
Evaluate and optimize fundraising and marketing campaigns using data-driven insights and testing methodologies.
Analyze donor journeys, conversion funnels, and channel performance to improve engagement and conversion rates.
Develop attribution and measurement frameworks to assess marketing effectiveness and return on investment.
Identify opportunities to increase fundraising revenue, donor retention, and overall marketing efficiency.
Advanced Analytics & Predictive Insights
Develop predictive models for donor acquisition, retention, upgrades, reactivation, lifetime value, and campaign performance.
Conduct donor segmentation, propensity modelling, and audience analysis to improve personalization and engagement.
Identify key drivers of fundraising and marketing performance through statistical analysis and data mining techniques.
Analyze donor behaviour and giving patterns to uncover opportunities for growth and long-term supporter value.
Analytics Innovation & Continuous Improvement
Leverage AI, automation, and emerging analytics technologies to enhance forecasting, audience targeting, and organizational decision-making.
Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through proactive analysis of internal and external data sources.
Drive a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement through testing, measurement, and performance optimization.
Recommend innovative solutions that improve organizational effectiveness and create competitive advantage.
Strategic Business Intelligence & Decision Support
Serve as a strategic analytics partner to Marketing, Fundraising, Donor Relations, and Leadership teams, translating business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Develop executive dashboards, performance scorecards, and KPI frameworks that measure organizational success and support strategic decision-making.
Deliver actionable insights and recommendations through clear data storytelling and presentations to stakeholders.
Support strategic planning, forecasting, and resource allocation through advanced analytical modelling and scenario analysis.

Qualifications & Competencies


Education & Experience
Degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, management consulting, strategy, data science, marketing analytics, or related disciplines.
Experience influencing strategic decisions through analytics and business insights.
Experience working with large, complex datasets and translating findings into business outcomes.
Experience within nonprofit, fundraising, consulting, financial services, technology, or corporate environments is considered an asset.
Technical Capabilities
Business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Statistical analysis and predictive modeling.
Data visualization and executive storytelling.
CRM analytics
Familiarity with machine learning and AI-driven analytics.
Advanced Excel and data manipulation skills.

Hybrid Work Policy

IRC has a hybrid model where in-office requirements are based on distance from our Burlington headquarters or a regional office (Surrey, Edmonton, Calgary and Ottawa). Depending on where you live, this can range from two days a week to one day a month.

Commitment To Accessibility

Islamic Relief Canada is committed to providing inclusive employment opportunities. Accommodation requests are invited at all stages of IRC recruitment, hiring, and employment processes. We make every effort to provide reasonable accommodations in a timely manner. If you have any accommodation requests or questions regarding the hiring process, contact us at careers@islamicreliefcanada.org or 1-855-377-4673.

Starting Salary

$67,000.00

Please note: The posted starting salary is intended to provide potential candidates with a general understanding of the compensation associated with the position. The actual salary offered will start at this figure, with adjustments possible based on individual qualifications and other relevant factors.

As a Data Operations Analyst, Investment Data Operations, you will help deliver accurate, timely, and complete market reference data across core systems and business processes. This role supports investment operations, finance, risk, and reporting by applying analytical problem-solving and root cause analysis. In a dynamic, time-sensitive environment, you will be expected to manage multiple priorities, re-prioritize effectively as needs change, and maintain strong attention to detail with a data quality mindset. You will work closely with internal partners and external vendors, using clear communication and cross-functional coordination to resolve data issues, strengthen operational controls, and provide a high-quality data service that enables better business outcomes.

This is a 12-month direct contract opportunity.

You Will Be Responsible For


Support daily market reference data operations, including security setup, onboarding, maintenance, and timely delivery across core systems and reporting processes.
Monitor, investigate, and resolve data exceptions, breaks, and control report issues in partnership with internal teams and external vendors.
Analyze data issues to identify root causes, assess business impact, and recommend practical solutions that improve data quality and operational efficiency.
Support stakeholder requests for data enhancements, operational improvements, and new business requirements.
Document operational procedures, workflows, data definitions, and controls to improve consistency, transparency, and knowledge sharing.
Review and validate pricing and valuation data for public and private investments in line with established policies and data quality standards.
Participate in change initiatives, system upgrades, and testing activities, including data validation, user acceptance testing, and implementation support.
Build strong working relationships across Investment Teams, Risk, Performance, Finance, and Technology to support effective data operations.


Required Skills & Experience


2+ years of experience in data operations, investment operations, middle office, back office, or financial systems support.
Knowledge of investment data domains such as reference data, market data, pricing, valuations, and risk analytics.
Understanding of data management principles, including data quality, controls, governance, and lineage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, assess impact, and communicate findings clearly.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams.


Preferred Skills & Experience


University degree in Finance, Commerce, Mathematics, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with investment platforms, operational data tools, or reporting systems; familiarity with CRD, Calypso, Eagle PACE, or similar platforms is an asset.
Proficiency with Excel and data analysis tools; SQL, Python, Power BI, and workflow tools such as Azure DevOps are assets.

Title: Data Science Specialist
Description:
Exempt Level 3: $87,762- $105,316

Vision

The Toronto Catholic District School Board (TCDSB) is proud to be a significant part of the fabric of publicly funded Catholic education in the province of Ontario. We serve approximately 85,000 students in nearly 200 Catholic schools in the City of Toronto and represent close to 575,000 Catholic school supporters. At the TCDSB, we grow in knowledge, with justice and hope. The TCDSB is an inclusive Catholic learning community that nurtures faith development and academic excellence through the love of God, neighbor, and self.

We fully engage students in learning that supports their academic, spiritual, socio-emotional, and physical growth and development. At TCDSB, we have a long and distinguished history of providing excellence in Catholic education for the Toronto community. The Ontario Catholic School Graduate Expectations our Catholic values, and the Board's Pastoral Plans are foundational to our exemplary approach to teaching and learning in the 21st Century.

With a staff of 14,000, the TCDSB is a dynamic school board and is seeking a permanent position for a Data Science Specialist within the Communications, Research & Policy department.

All interested applicants are welcome to apply, we are an inclusive employer.

Key Accountabilities

Reporting to and under the direction of the Data Science Lead, the successful candidate will contribute to the Research and Analytics department by delivering student achievement, well-being and business analytics products using data from multiple systems and sources.


Transform and structure data into analysis ready formats to support analytics, reporting, and research activities
Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL based data models, views, and datasets from relational data systems in collaboration with ICT services
Support reproducible analytics workflows using SQL and R
Assist with data preparation for internal research, recurring reporting, and external reporting requirements
Maintain clear documentation of data sources, transformations, and assumptions to support reuse and auditability
Contribute to continuous improvement of analytics processes and data assets across the organization


Requirements


Post secondary (Bachelor) in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, or a related field
Minimum two (2) years experience working with SQL and relational database systems combined with relevant operational analytics
Experience with data visualization tools or packages (e.g., PowerBI, ggplot2, R Shiny and Quarto)
Experience preparing clean, well structured datasets for downstream analysis or reporting
Superior oral and written communication skills as demonstrated by success in engaging, understanding and supporting data users, including proven presentation skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets
High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data validation, analysis, and reporting
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and evolving data requirements


Who We Are

Our mission at TCDSB is to inspire learning in every way and support our students and employees. Employees who work in our corporate setting are passionate and have a strong belief in our mission and making TCDSB a leader in public education. We are:

Title: Analyst, Data Strategy
Description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Analyst, Data Strategy

As a Data Strategy Analyst, you will report to the Director, Data Strategy and Product Assurance and work closely with the Manager of Data Strategy, playing a crucial role in supporting the organization's data strategy and governance initiatives. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will gather data requirements, assist in developing and implementing comprehensive data strategies, and ensure the alignment of data usage with business goals.

You will leverage your data analytics expertise to help maintain data roadmaps, build process data flows, manage project management tools, support certification of products based on governance standards and help execute overall data strategy. This position will also work in collaboration with the delivery team, and product managers to ensure the analytics program is enabling the overall data strategy.

This role is based in our temporary location of 20 York Mills Rd, then the Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts, Toronto Corporate Office. This role involves interactions with both internal and external stakeholders at various levels.

What You’ll Be Doing


Support the manager in implementing relevant data governance policies and work closely with product owners to ensure data products are certified for use.
Assist in maintaining the data roadmap, ensuring alignment of data usage with evolving business strategies, emerging technologies, and data sources.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with data stewards, product owners, and other key stakeholders to facilitate collaboration and data stewardship.
Facilitation and maintenance of the ongoing data strategy and roadmap.
Support intake of new data products through stakeholder communication, maintenance of templates, and scheduling of oversight and governance meetings.
Collaborate with project managers and delivery teams to support the development and delivery of data products that provide value to the business.
Assist in strengthening the organization’s data foundation through the implementation of effective policies, standards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Work with the manager to create and maintain training materials, playbooks, and reference guides to promote consistent adoption of data governance practices across teams.
Provide ongoing support and training on product certification requirements.
Oversee implementation of data strategy.
Support the manager in tracking and reporting on budget utilization across data and analytics projects, highlighting key variances and potential risks.
Assist in preparing program level budget and spend summaries to inform planning and prioritization.
Collaborate with D&A teams to create initial cost and resource estimates for new project requests.
Program Budget and Performance Tracking.
Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement in data management processes.
Communicate the value of data-driven decision making and foster a data-driven culture by promoting awareness and understanding of the importance of data.
Proactive research and promote use of data to enable FS strategy.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s in a relevant field (e.g. Data Management, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Informatics).
Strong understanding of data governance frameworks and principles.
Experience managing data lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to align data strategy with business goals.
Experience in data strategy development and implementation.
Ability to adapt data strategies to evolving business needs and changing landscape.
Analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, detect anomalies, and translate complex data sets into actionable insights and strategies.
Experience with data governance tools and technologies such as informatica.
Strong knowledge of data protection regulations, and compliance standards.
Applied experience in data governance and / or data management.
Knowledge of industry leading data governance practices.
Familiar with implementation and use various data governance tools and software.
Familiar with DMBOK principles.
Understand of complete data lifecycle and related data governance requirements.
Understanding of GDPR and related legislation.
Ability to manipulate, analyze and transform large datasets to understand trends and patterns.
Working knowledge of cloud computing platforms. MS Azure preferred (Microsoft Synapse, Azure Data factory, Azure Databricks, PowerBI).
Proficient in SQL or other programming languages.
Experience with data visualization and dashboarding (Power BI, Tableau).
Expert in Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
Working knowledge of project management tools such as Monday.com and Jira.


Who You Are

Business / Analytics Skills


Works to understand the business need and how the data will be used to drive decisions into action plans that will grow the business.
Effectively navigates through ambiguity and complexity to provide clarity for the team and the requester.
Works well under pressure and can manage multiple tasks under time constraints.
Strong with process management including the development of processes and procedures.
Familiar with agile methodology and comfortable working in an agile environment.


Communication Skills


Works to understand the requester needs when building the upfront story to ensure clarity and actionability.
Listens carefully to understand requirements and seeks clarity as needed.
Provides well-structured reports and documents to convey analysis and insights that are clear, concise and reader-friendly.
Demonstrates understanding of the importance of storytelling by incorporating visual enhancements into presentations.
Strong interpersonal skills and team player.


Planning / Organizational Skills


Demonstrates the ability to organize and work with high volumes of data.
Establishes clear expectations to ensure smooth execution.
Handles multiple demands and conflicting priorities by quickly re-allocating time and resources.
Organizes self and the team in setting and managing priorities.
Demonstrates a relentlessly high standard for attention to detail and holds others to the same.
Delivers on commitments on time and on budget.


People Engagement


Takes the time to acknowledge the efforts and contributions of others.
Works to build relationships with colleagues to both provide and receive the best support.


Collaboration Skills


Works productively in a matrix environment to move projects along and foster a positive team attitude.
Proactively asks for input and ideas from others to demonstrate the power of the team.


Salary Range: $70,000 – $85,000 CAD

This role will be a Hybrid working model, which will require 3 days per week at our temporary 20 York Mills Road, Toronto, Ontario location with travel, as needed, to our Four Seasons Corporate Office located at 1165 Leslie Street, Toronto, Ontario

Four Seasons is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

Find Your Limitless with Reliance

By joining Reliance as a Billing Analyst, you’ll become an important Team Member and will be provided with the tools you need to succeed. We have ambitious growth plans and are looking for Team Members who want to grow with us. At Reliance, we pride ourselves on the fact that we provide limitless opportunities for growth and we encourage it by rewarding our Team Members for their success in many ways. If you’re ready to find your limitless – join us!

What do we offer?


The tools you need to succeed – including the tools for the job as well as training and development programs
A successful and knowledgeable team to be part of and learn from
Competitive base pay plus the ability to earn more tied to your success – the only limit is your potential
A great benefits plan for you / your family
Career paths so you can advance in the company
Awarded Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures with a proudly diverse and inclusive team

Become a key resource for the business, develop an understanding of the applications impacting customers, billing & payments, customer communications, etc.
Proactively analyze key trends, identify data integrity issues, risks and opportunities, and support delivery against financial and operational targets

Provide value-add analysis to drive performance

Develop process flows and end to end functional designs
Builds effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Identify opportunities to improve processes and systems, support implementation of best practices, and drive continuous improvements
Drive / Support projects and initiatives as assigned

Self-starter and strong team player, with a sense of urgency and a demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Analytical thinker, action-taker, resilient and resourceful with a keen attention to detail and results focused

Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written

Here, you’ll find a cultural spark in everything we do – from the way we partner with members and employers, to the way we work, collaborate, and grow. It doesn’t just feel different at CAAT. It is different. We’re one of the fastest-growing pensions in the country for a reason. We challenge the status quo, making a real impact on the hundreds of employers we serve – from education institutions to major corporations and household brands. And we’re just getting started. Driven by core values and a shared purpose, we’re fierce champions for better retirement security, known for our can-do culture where everyone plays a role in bringing our vision to life. If this sounds like a fit, we’d love you to be a part of it.




About The Role

We are seeking a Data Management Analyst to work closely with our stakeholders to evaluate business requirements from a data requirement perspective. You will implement data integrations, develop data models and ensure BI reports are aligned with business objectives. You will build advanced SQL scripts and programs, ETL pipelines, reports and dashboards within various platforms such as Oracle databases, MS- Fabric, Power BI and different enterprise IT systems.




As The Newest Member Of Our Team, You’ll

Develop and implement BI solutions using different frameworks, technologies and best practices.
Create and manage datasets by writing scripts and programs using SQL, Python, excel and other reporting tools.
Develop business-focused reports and dashboards using Power BI, leveraging data models aligned with organizational objectives.
Design and Develop ETL processes and unit tests in a data warehouse environment.
Measure and ensure Data Quality improvements by identifying and resolving Data Quality issues.
Participate in data requirements analysis for new projects and enhancement requests and produce technical specification documentation.
Support the overall BI and data solutions delivery and on-going operations.
Effectively collaborate with team members and people from different departments with varying degrees of business and/or technical experience




To Succeed, You Bring

A university degree or college diploma in related discipline or a combination of education, training and experience deemed equivalent.
A minimum of 5 years of experience (MS SQL, T-SQL, or Oracle PL-SQL), Python, working with data warehouse, dimensional / semantic modelling and BI development.
A minimum of 3 years experience with ETL development, Power BI development, DAX, Power Query, data modeling and dashboard design.
Strong experience in analyzing varying levels of business needs and developing appropriate data models.
Proven ability to communicate effectively clearly with team members and be able to convey technical concepts into clear, simple language.
Excellent analytical thinking skills for translating data into informative visuals and reports.
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Certifications in DP-600 Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or DP-700: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate are considered assets.




The target hiring salary for this position is $96,800.00-$113,800.00. Placement within our salary range will be based on factors such as internal equity, market conditions, and the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.




At CAAT, we believe innovation, passion, and purpose are ingredients for a great work environment. We’re incredibly proud of our people and the remarkable impact they have as catalysts for change. We’re committed to attracting and keeping great talent, which means competitive compensation, exceptional benefits, and an environment where people can grow and thrive. When you work with CAAT, you’ll enjoy:

Opportunities to Build a Better You: We never stand still. As we grow, so do you. Enjoy a place that provides endless opportunities to learn and master your skills while cultivating new ones.
Comprehensive & Holistic Care: Be at your best with a Total Rewards program that feeds and prioritizes your physical, mental, and financial wellness. From flexible work arrangements, comprehensive benefits to wellness incentives, and a defined benefit pension plan – we have you covered.
A Place to Collaborate and Win: We’ve built a lively environment where creativity and open communication thrive. It’s why we’re consistently recognized as one of ‘Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures’, one of ‘Greater Toronto’s Top Employers’, and one of the ‘Best Places to Work’.
Work that Truly Matters. You’re giving Canadians the opportunity for better retirement security, and organizations the chance to do more.




If you believe that Canadians deserve a future where a secure lifetime retirement income contributes to their financial and overall well-being, then CAAT could be the right fit for you. Start your journey with us today. Apply now.

Learn more about us by visiting www.caatpension.ca/careers
